Planted negative: a batch built with BOS undeclared must print \(\rho(\hat Q)=1\) on the arm's chain and the solve must raise (V-16); a batch with a constraint set after the query must print discard count \(=512\); and a batch drawn from the unscreened pool at the recorded \(15\) per cent no-op rate must fail clause 9 — the screen's own known-bad control. If killed — link 1, the dial. Move \(t^\star\) to \(2\) or raise the graph depth so that \(t^\star\) lands inside the causal window, and re-run the same census. Hypotheses: the failure line was \(t^\star\) unplaceable or an sd collapse traceable to the depth (the record watched a label's sd fall from \(0.499989\) to \(0.038445\) under a kill rate, READ scale/e4_harmonic.py:425-434). The link is scoped: moving the dial does not touch the no-op rate, so a clause-9 or clause-11 failure routes past link 1 to link 2 directly. Evidence: \(t^\star\) is a tolerance dial read off the hop ladder at E2_DIAL_TOL = 1e-3 (READ scale/negation_scope.py:264). Kill: the census fails again on any line at \(0\) GPU-s. If killed — link 2, the substrate. The jittered bed_1 landscape at \(K=2\) with \(B\) as goal becomes the bed — as an oracle cross-check only, never the shape lane's substrate, because it is undirected (SymmSupport, \(\rho(Q)=0.9408612510154677\), RUN[coord]) and no causal \(\hat P\) equals it (DERIVED: an off-diagonal \(Q_{ij}>0\) forces \(Q_{ji}>0\), which a lower-triangular \(P\) cannot carry). Evidence: its oracle, residual \(4.16\times10^{-17}\), Kirchhoff route \(<10^{-10}\) at \(K=2\) are in the tree (READ ceq/beds/bed_1.py:188-198; MATHEMATICS.md:542-600). Kill: a shape cell on it filed as a capability number — refused by 04.1. This link is more decisive than link 1 because it removes the in-class reading entirely rather than moving a dial. If killed — link 3, the price. \(N\) is repriced from whatever realised sd the first admitted batch shows (04.9), and the bed is filed at that \(N\) or filed unfalsifiable. Hypotheses: the realised paired sd is the first admitted batch's, read from the journal's per-seed differences and not from a pilot or a table; the seed set is the eight of 04.21 step (5), deduplicated in one thread lane. Evidence: the MDE table at its realised-sd rows, \(0.109199\to\mathrm{MDE}_8=0.126238\), \(\mathrm{MDE}_{16}=0.081841\) (READ docs/sources/sections/sec_beds.md:308-313, RUN[VENUS], re-verified RUN[MARS]); the M-3 precedent, pilot \(0.050146\) against realised \(0.109199\), ratio \(2.1776\) (READ MISTAKES.md:464-494). Kill: \(\mathrm{MDE}_{16}\) at the realised \(\sigma_d\) still above every registered effect on the bed — nothing is falsifiable at any \(N\) this canon can afford, and the bed is filed with its sd and no capability number; decided at \(0\) GPU-s from the journalled \(\sigma_d\) before any second batch runs, which is strictly cheaper than link 2's cross-check cell. Terminal. "BED-S at the design point does not admit; the canon files the generator specification, the census with its printed failure line, the floors, the controls and the pricing rule, and no capability number." Withdrawn: every sentence of §5.10 tree A and tree B of docs/PLAN.md on BED-S.

docs.title: 04.3 — Information floors per bed (L-FLOOR)
docs.text: Statement. Every capability number prints beside its information floor, and the floor is one of exactly three objects, assigned per head: $\(\text{vector heads } (q,\ z^\star,\ \Delta z):\ \text{the exact oracle at }0.0,\ \text{with the hop-ladder ceilings }\mathrm{NRMSE}(z_k,z^\star),\ z_k=Qz_{k-1}+R,\ \text{printed per batch};\)$ $\(\text{argmin}:\ \mathrm{floor}_{\rm zeroinfo}=1-\max_a\hat\pi(a^\star)\ \ (=1-1/m_{\rm eff}\text{ at uniform }\hat\pi)\ \text{alone};\)$ $\(\text{BED-K}:\ \text{the Hankel ceiling }\mathrm{err}_1=\sqrt{1-1/d}=0.9746794345\text{ at }d=20;\qquad \text{BED-M}:\ \text{the exact oracle at }0.0,\ \text{with }\sqrt{(t^\star-k)/t^\star}\text{ printed as a capability threshold, never a floor}.\)$ Both Fano forms are retired, on the same ground and by the same arithmetic. The weak form \(1-\ln2/\ln m\) reads \(0.5/0.6667/0.75\) at \(m=4/8/16\), sitting \(0.25/0.2083/0.1875\) below the exact zero-information floor \(0.7500/0.8750/0.9375\); the tight form \((\ln m-I-\ln2)/\ln(m-1)\) at its most binding setting \(I=0\) reads \(0.6309/0.7124/0.7679\), sitting \(0.1191/0.1626/0.1696\) below the same floors (DERIVED from the printed values). Fano is therefore never binding against the exact zero-information floor at any \(I\ge0\) on a deterministic label, for every \(m\ge3\), and retaining the tight form while retiring the weak one on that exact ground was the defect. floor_fano_k1 is struck from 04.15's field list and from the adjudicator of 04.9; floor\(_1\) appears nowhere. Hypotheses. \(\hat\pi\) is the realised class distribution of the batch being scored, never of a neighbouring batch; \(m_{\rm eff}\) counts moves that change the query's committor by more than \(10^{-12}\) (R-08) over the screened pool of 04.2 clause 11, and every floor is derived at the realised \(m_{\rm eff}\), never at \(m\); the argmin label is deterministic given the oracle. Evidence. Exact zero-information floor \(0.7500/0.8750/0.9375\) at \(m=4/8/16\); weak Fano \(0.5/0.6667/0.75\) sits \(0.25/0.2083/0.1875\) below chance (RUN[J], READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md §6 A.3); tight Fano \(0.6309/0.7124/0.7679\) at \(I=0\) sits \(0.1191/0.1626/0.1696\) below the same floors (RUN[J], the gaps DERIVED); the Cover–Thomas form CITED [V] cover-2006-elements §2.10, theorem number [U], retained as the reason Fano is retired and cited for no floor; floor\(_1=0.7071067811865476\) violated by \(13\) of \(40\) banked cells (RUN[WATSON], READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md §6 A.3) and by \(6\) of \(34\) at C15 (READ V20_R15_JOURNAL.md:51 @ 99777ab); the Hankel ceiling DERIVED \(\sqrt{1-1/20}\) (READ V20_R15_LEAP_LEDGER.md:323 @ 99777ab); the exact-oracle numerical noise level \(4.4\times10^{-16}\) (the conservation read of 04.2, RUN[M]). \(I(X_{\le k};a^\star)\) for BED-S is NOT MEASURED — needs the plug-in estimator over the admission census of 04.2 and no floor of this verse depends on it. Mechanism. L-FLOOR, V-10 (a floor an uninformed arm cannot violate is not a floor; a floor an informed arm is supposed to beat is not a kill), V-17, C15. Kill. An uninformed control printing an error below its own floor — the 0-hop control, the random control or the majority control reading below \(\mathrm{floor}_{\rm zeroinfo}\) computed on the batch it was scored on, on \(\ge2\) of \(N\) seeds, \(N\) the seed count 04.9 clause 7's rule fixes at the realised \(\sigma_d\) and provisionally \(8\) (NOT MEASURED — needs $\sigma_d$ from 04.21 step (5)): the floor is not a lower bound and is struck for that head. The count \(2\) is a seed-count rule and the floor is recomputed per batch, so no placeholder \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\) enters this kill; only the denominator waits on \(\sigma_d\). An informed arm printing below the floor is the capability reading L-FLOOR exists to produce, not a defect, and fires nothing: at \(m=8\) an arm with argmin accuracy \(0.90\) prints error \(0.10\), \(0.775\) below the printed floor, on \(8\) of \(8\) seeds, and the earlier unrestricted kill struck the floor on exactly that success. Instrument: the adjudicator of 04.9 reading floor_zeroinfo per cell against the cell's own arm field; price \(0\) GPU-s beyond the cell. Planted negative: an off-by-one-seed floor — the majority control scored against \(\mathrm{floor}_{\rm zeroinfo}\) computed from seed \(j+1\)'s realised \(\hat\pi\) while scored on seed \(j\)'s batch. A majority arm violates that floor by construction whenever the two batches' \(\hat\pi\) differ, so the kill fires on a known-bad case. The matched-batch plants cannot serve: random reads error \(1-1/m\), which is the floor at uniform \(\hat\pi\), and majority reads error exactly \(1-\max_a\hat\pi(a^\star)\) on the batch whose \(\hat\pi\) defines the floor — neither can print strictly below it except by the finite-sample noise the floor is computed from, so both are retained as the V-3 floor row and neither is the kill's control. If killed — link 1. The floor is re-derived at \(m_{\rm eff}\) (R-08's line) and re-printed; every argmin accuracy in the cell is re-floored. Hypotheses: the violation is explained by no-op moves (\(m_{\rm eff}<m\)). Evidence: the \(5.551\times10^{-17}\) no-op instance (RUN[M]). Kill: a violation surviving the re-floor at \(m_{\rm eff}\); price \(0\) GPU-s, the same journal. If killed — link 2. The argmin head carries the exact-oracle floor \(0.0\) only, in \(\varphi\)-NRMSE on the committor vector, and no rate-valued floor is printed. Hypotheses: the committor vector is journalled on \(T\) (04.8); the oracle's own numerical noise on the bed is the conservation read \(4.4\times10^{-16}\). Evidence: NRMSE is non-negative by definition and reads \(1.0\) for the mean predictor (V-17's anchored unit); the noise level \(4.4\times10^{-16}\) (RUN[M], 04.2). Kill: an arm reading \(\varphi\)-NRMSE below \(4.4\times10^{-16}\), the exact-oracle-plus-numerical-noise level — a score under the oracle's own float error is a label leak, not capability, and the head is struck and routed to 04.4's leak guard; decided from the journal at \(0\) GPU-s, cheaper than link 1's re-floor because it reads one number per cell. The claim that this link "cannot be killed" was itself the defect: a link with no kill is a Terminal, not a replacement. Terminal. "Every number on the bed is a distance to the exact oracle at \(0.0\); no argmin floor is claimed and no Fano line is printed anywhere." Withdrawn: every sentence reading "above the Fano floor", in either Fano form.

docs.title: 04.4 — The zero-hop guard and the leak guard, firing both ways
docs.text: Statement. Two guards run at construction on every bed, each with a must-fire half and a must-not-fire half. Zero-hop: the query token carries \(s_0\) only, \(s_0\) drawn uniformly from \(T\) independently of \(a^\star\); the untrained arm reads argmin accuracy within \(1/m_{\rm eff}\pm\) its Clopper–Pearson half-width and committor NRMSE \(\ge1-\mathrm{GATE\_TOL}\), \(\mathrm{GATE\_TOL}=10^{-3}\). The guard's mutual-information half is NOT MEASURED — needs the plug-in estimator for $I(s_0;a^\star)$ over the admission census of 04.2, and until that estimator exists the untrained-arm half — the RED gate at \(1-10^{-3}\), which is the harness's own and runnable today — carries the guard alone; no verse reads \(I(s_0;a^\star)=0\) as an asserted fact. Leak: a corpus-alone linear probe from the token features to \(q\) at order \(0\) reads below the bed's own bar \(R^2_{\rm bar}\), defined as the \(99\)th percentile of the corpus-alone \(R^2\) null distribution over the \(512\) admission draws of 04.2, computed on label-permuted targets and printed with the draws it was computed on. The bar is not imported: the E4′ pair PASS_BAR = 0.5 / FAIL_BAR = 0.9 is E4′'s object in E4′'s units and is V-22 across the bed boundary, so it fixes nothing here and is carried only as the precedent that names the mechanism. Until the \(512\)-draw null is computed the leak verdict is NOT MEASURED — needs the corpus-alone probe over the admission census of 04.2, in both directions: no bed is cleared of leakage and none is convicted of it. The planted leak (a move token carrying its own \(q\)) must read \(R^2\ge0.99\) — [ASSUMED] 0.99, one nine below the M-21 instance that read $R^2=1.000000$ when the target was an input channel, the reason being that the plant differs from M-21's only by the quantisation of the copied channel. Hypotheses. The bed's token list is that of 04.2 (node tokens, edge tokens, move tokens, query token); no token carries anything derived from a solve; the probe is linear at order \(0\); the null distribution is computed on the same \(512\) draws that decide admission, so the bar and the census share a batch and the bar is not an off-batch import. Evidence. The RED gate is the harness's own (READ scripts/k_cert.py:218-222, NaN checked first because float('nan') >= 1.0 is False); \(30\) of \(30\) shapes passed with worst margin \(1.957\times10^{-3}\) (READ COSTS.md:137-139). BED-M's first builder leaked \(1/(t^\star+1)\) at zero hops and aborted three of five rungs; b[s-1] = 0 restored it (READ scale/negation_scope.py:399-415). The E4′ bars PASS_BAR = 0.5 / FAIL_BAR = 0.9 (RUN this session: scale/rips_gate.py:60 is PASS_BAR = 0.5, :61 is FAIL_BAR = 0.9) are E4′'s object in E4′'s units, read \(0.973819\) on its fixed point, and are V-22 and not re-derived: they are struck as this verse's operative threshold and replaced by the \(512\)-draw null bar, which is NOT MEASURED — needs the corpus-alone probe over the admission census of 04.2. The corpus-alone probe precedent: gate \(R^2\) corpus alone \(=1.000000\) on BED-M because the target was an input channel (READ MISTAKES.md:2101-2189, M-21) — the sole source of the planted bar's magnitude. Mechanism. V-10, D-5, V-24, V-7, V-22, M-21, M-2, D-2, P-1. Kill. Zero-hop: the honest query reads below \(1-\mathrm{GATE\_TOL}\) or the untrained argmin accuracy outside \(1/m_{\rm eff}\pm\mathrm{CP}\) — the label is legible at zero hops and the bed is a copy task. Leak: honest \(R^2\ge R^2_{\rm bar}\), the bed's own \(99\)th-percentile null — the one-read claim is void on the bed; planted \(R^2<0.99\) — the detector is blind and no leak verdict is admissible either way. The leak half of the kill is unreachable until \(R^2_{\rm bar}\) exists and is registered as such, and no leak verdict is filed in the interim. Price \(\le1.524\) s (one zero-step forward, [FITTED]) and \(0\) GPU-s for the probes and the \(512\)-draw null, which rides on the census the bed already runs. The planted halves are the controls. If killed — link 1. The argmin head is struck and the committor-vector head alone remains (R-24's route): the flag rule R0 — "pick the move whose clamp target carries the goal flag, else the earliest transient target" — is computed as an oracle-free column; if R0 reads within its interval of \(1/m\) after R-07's restriction, the vector head is admitted alone. Hypotheses: clamp targets are restricted to \(T\) (R-07) so R0 is not exact by construction. Evidence: a clamp into \(\mathcal A_0\) gives \(q^{(0)}=1.0000\) exactly on the judge's draw (RUN[M], READ docs/PLAN.md R-24). Kill: R0 accuracy \(\ge\mathrm{acc}_{\rm shape}-\mathrm{MDE}_N\) at the realised \(\sigma_d\) (04.9 clause 7 — the threshold is frozen as that rule, never as a placeholder number; NOT MEASURED — needs $\sigma_d$ from 04.21 step (5)) on \(\ge6/8\) arena seeds; price \(0\) GPU-s at construction. If killed — link 2. The leak is removed by construction: membership flags are deleted from the node tokens and only the edge tokens remain; the census of 04.2 is re-run and the null bar is recomputed on the new token list, because a bar computed on the old features is the same V-22 import across a feature-set boundary that struck the E4′ pair. Hypotheses: \(P_{\rm env}\) stays a deterministic function of the edge tokens, so the label still needs the solve; the recomputed null is over the same \(512\) draws. Evidence: leak clause (a) was dropped for BED-S on exactly this ground (READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md §6 A.1). Kill: honest \(R^2\ge R^2_{\rm bar}\) against the recomputed bar — the graph itself carries the label at order \(0\) and the bed is a static task (04.5 decides); price \(0\) GPU-s. Terminal. "The label class is registered with printed floors; the leak bar is the bed's own \(512\)-draw null and no leak verdict is filed until it is computed; the bed is a copy task at order \(0\) and no arm is credited on it."

docs.title: 04.5 — The static-task kill, and the label class that leaves the scalar regime (B4)
docs.text: Statement. No bed in this book scores a scalar at one position. The four label classes are \(z^\star\in\mathbb R^{s\times d}\), \(\Delta z(a)\in\mathbb R^{s\times d}\), the reach-avoid tensor \(q(a)\in[0,1]^{K+2}\) per move with the full vector on \(T\) retained, and the argmin over \(m\); the state axis that Q6 lacked exists on every one. A bed is struck as static before any number is quoted if a 0-hop per-position MLP on the candidate's context row reads argmin accuracy inside the shape's Clopper–Pearson half-width at \(N\), \(N\) fixed by 04.9 clause 7's rule at the realised \(\sigma_d\) and provisionally \(8\) (NOT MEASURED — needs $\sigma_d$ from 04.21 step (5); at \(N=8\) nothing is falsifiable, 04.9 clause 6, so the clause is a rule and not the number \(8\)), or if McNemar between the 0-hop MLP and the 1-hop softmax reads \(p>0.05\) on identical draws (K-H2). The second clause names its pair because an unnamed pair is not decidable: under (0-hop MLP, 1-hop softmax) a null result says one hop buys nothing over none, which is the static-bed reading and the only reading this kill carries. A shape-versus-1-hop comparison is an A1 row and belongs to 04.9, never to a bed kill — read as a bed kill it would strike the bed whenever the shape fails to separate, which is the arm's failure and not the bed's. Hypotheses. Matched parameters per arm, the count re-printed once the \([m,K+2]\) head is attached (Ruling 3); McNemar on paired binary outcomes only; \(N=8\) deduplicated in one thread lane. Evidence. Every record bed asked one real at position \(s-1\): equilibrium_oracle returns \(z^\star_{s-1}\) (READ scale/negation_scope.py:286-304) and ArmSMPrime.forward returns shape \([n]\) (READ ceq/arm_smprime.py:577 via V20_R15_THEORY_TABLE.md:213 @ 99777ab); Q6 is F4 on both wings because no state axis exists, \(0\) of \(40\) banked cells journal a distribution (READ V20_R15_THEORY_TABLE.md:210-225 @ 99777ab). The SLR theorems (marion-2025-single-location Cor. 2, duranthon-2026-softmax-advantage Prop. 4.2, CITED [V]) admit \(0\) of \(3\) record beds under their label model and the record ran \(L/d=4.00\) against \(L=o(d)\) (READ MATHEMATICS.md:1044-1057; docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md §3.6). The vector_readout plumbing exists and defaults to False (READ MISTAKES.md:677-708). The record's static beds: both registered oracles were closed-form functions of the input with no fixed point (READ results/capability_table_v1.md Limits (a)). Mechanism. D-1, C8, V-10, M-1 (a vector label voids PUBLISHED_SOFTMAX_8192 and lives in its own lane), V-24. Kill. K-H2 as stated; instrument: the control pair of 04.11 (0-hop MLP, 1-hop softmax) at \(\le1.524\) s per cell, \(\approx0.5\) GPU-min for both at \(N=8\); planted negative: the 0-hop MLP trained on a bed whose label is a flag lookup (BED-S with R-07's restriction removed, where R0 is exact) must read inside the half-width — the kill fires on a known-static plant. If killed — link 1. The dial is moved up: \(t^\star=32\) if placeable, so the label needs more hops than a 1-hop window carries; census re-run. Hypotheses: the DAG depth admits \(t^\star=32\) inside the causal window at \(s=64\). Evidence: the dial's support \(\{2,8,32\}\) and its placement by graph depth (READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md §6 A.2.1). Kill: \(t^\star=32\) unplaceable at \(s=64\) by the DAG's own depth census — decided at \(0\) GPU-s from 04.2's depth read, before any cell runs, and strictly cheaper than the verse's own kill, which needs the control pair at \(\approx0.5\) GPU-min. A link priced at the verse's own kill is neither cheaper nor more decisive and is not a link; re-running the control pair is what link 2 replaces, not what link 1 repeats. If killed — link 2. The bed is re-registered on BED-J (04.6), whose oracle no causal \(\hat P\) equals. Hypotheses and evidence: 04.6's. Kill: 04.6's Bet E at \(\approx30.9\) s (\(2\times8\times1.680+4.0\), 04.11's arithmetic) — more decisive because it removes the per-row class from the bed rather than moving a dial. Terminal. "BED-S is a static task; the label class and floors are filed; no arm is credited." Withdrawn: every A1 sentence on BED-S.

docs.title: 04.6 — BED-J: the joint-consistency bed outside the per-row class
docs.text: Statement. BED-J is the jittered bed_1 landscape (bed_1.build(T=0.25, seed, jitter=0.05)) with \(K=2\) absorbing sets, \(\mathcal A=\{0\}\), \(\mathcal B=\{1\}\), \(|T|=9\), whose environment chain is undirected (SymmSupport); its label is the full fixed point on \(T\), $\(q=(I-Q_{\rm env})^{-1}R_{\rm env}\mathbb 1\in[0,1]^{|T|},\qquad\text{scored by }\ \varphi\text{-NRMSE per coordinate and } r(\hat q)=\frac{\|(I-Q_{\rm env})\hat q-R_{\rm env}\mathbb 1\|_\infty}{\|R_{\rm env}\mathbb 1\|_\infty},\)$ with \(\|(I-Q_{\rm env})^{-1}\|_\infty\) and \(\|I-Q_{\rm env}\|_\infty\) printed beside \(r\) — both in the \(\infty\)-norm \(r\) is written in. The 2-norm pair \(\sigma_{\min}\|e\|_2\le\|(I-\gamma P)e\|_2\le(1+\gamma)\|e\|_2\) and its "lower factor near \(0.06\)" do not bind an \(\infty\)-norm ratio: on \(|T|=9\) the conversion costs up to \(\sqrt9=3\) in each direction, so a factor quoted at \(0.06\) in the 2-norm bounds an \(\infty\)-norm error only to within \(9\times\) (DERIVED from \(\|x\|_\infty\le\|x\|_2\le\sqrt{|T|}\,\|x\|_\infty\)). The 2-norm factors are retained as a separate, labelled 2-norm remark and license no reading of \(r\). The read is registered explicitly, because a per-position causal read of this label is unreachable and an unregistered read makes the Bet E ratio \(0/0\). The chain is SymmSupport (\(Q_{ij}>0\Rightarrow Q_{ji}>0\)), so \(q_i\) depends on neighbours at positions \(j>i\) and a causal arm at position \(i\) cannot see them; a last-position read of a single scalar would make this a one-scalar-at-one-position bed, which is the D-1 mechanism the book exists to leave. The registered read is therefore: the full \(|T|\)-vector is emitted at position \(s-1\) from a \([|T|]\)-wide readout, the state axis supplied by the \(|T|\) coordinates of the readout rather than by the position axis, and that readout's parameter count is printed in params_per_arm on every arm — the head is part of the matched count (Ruling 3), and the count is NOT MEASURED — needs the first BED-J cell until an arm is built. The bed is out of class by one DERIVED line at the operator level: an off-diagonal \(Q_{ij}>0\) forces \(Q_{ji}>0\) under SymmSupport, and no lower-triangular \(\hat P\) carries both, so no causal arm's operator equals the oracle's. That is operator non-containment and it is not non-approximability — CHARTER §5 B7, the record's largest unclosed logic gap. The label is \(9\) real numbers and the registered readout can emit any point of \(\mathbb R^9\), so operator non-containment bounds nothing about \(\|\hat q-q\|\). The creditability claim is therefore NOT MEASURED — needs the D-APPROX bound of book 01 for the causal class against a SymmSupport resolvent, printed at $|T|=9$, $\rho(Q_{\rm env})=0.9409$, and no contrast on BED-J is creditable until that bound exists and is non-vacuous at that geometry. When it exists, the contrast is creditable only in form A2, against the depth skyline in the same row, because a deeper softmax stack computes the same resolvent by iteration. Its floor is the exact oracle at \(0.0\) with the hop ceilings \(\mathrm{NRMSE}(q_k,q)\) printed; its guards are 04.4's with the query carrying \(s_0\) only and the probe target \(q\). Hypotheses. \(\rho(Q_{\rm env})<1\) (Perron certificate on the non-causal chain, isUnit_one_sub_of_perron [S]); the landscape's jitter varies the chain per draw so the label is non-constant (sd printed; V-8); \(t^\star\) read off the hop ladder, never predicted from \(\lambda_2\) (the rate is \(\rho(Q)\), measured \(0.9964\) against \(0.9985\) on LargestJoin_S2Rips_1024, READ PRIOR_ART.md:703-707 @ 99777ab). Evidence. bed_1 oracle residual \(1.04\times10^{-17}\) and the must-fire perturbation to \(10^{-6}\) (ratio \(9.6\times10^{10}\), READ workdonenewseal.md:214-215); \(\rho(Q)=0.9408612510154677\), \(Q^{11}\ne0\) (RUN[coord]); the D-2 separation on undirected substrates (READ docs/sources/design/refute_instrument_occvac.md F-B); the joint claim UNTESTED at READ MATHEMATICS.md:106-127; the residual's 2-norm factors DERIVED \(\sigma_{\min}\|e\|_2\le\|(I-\gamma P)e\|_2\le(1+\gamma)\|e\|_2\) with the lower factor near \(0.06\) at \(\rho=0.9409\) (READ docs/sources/design/refute_falsify_occvac.md §3.12), carried as a 2-norm remark only; the \(\infty\)-norm conditioning factor \(\|(I-Q_{\rm env})^{-1}\|_\infty\) that actually binds \(r\) is NOT MEASURED — needs one read of the built chain, $0$ GPU-s on the bed's own generator; the skyline iteration CITED [V] wang-2024-incontext-td, xie-2026-softmax-rl (abstract level, [U] on theorem numbers). The D-APPROX bound for the causal class against a SymmSupport resolvent at \(|T|=9\), \(\rho=0.9409\): NOT MEASURED — needs book 01, and the creditability of every BED-J contrast waits on it. The generator is PINNED at sha256 f73ca0e6… (READ results/k_data_manifest.json). A jittered draw batch and its census: NOT MEASURED — needs the census of 04.2 run on bed_1.build(jitter). Mechanism. D-2 (the separation is the point), V-26 (the residual is the joint term), V-17 (units printed), R-SKY, D-1. Kill (Bet E). \(r_{\rm softmax}/r_{\rm shape}\le2\) paired by seed and draw at marginal \(\varphi\)-NRMSE within \(\mathrm{MDE}_N\) at the realised \(\sigma_d\) (04.9 clause 7; NOT MEASURED — needs $\sigma_d$ from 04.21 step (5), and the ratio bar \(2\) is this verse's own frozen constant and is unaffected): joint consistency is learnable by a per-row mixture and the sentence at MATHEMATICS.md:106-127 is withdrawn; \((2,10)\) is SPLIT. Instrument: one bed-cell pair, \(\approx30.9\) s (\(2\times8\times1.680+4.0=30.88\) s at two arms and eight seeds on 04.11's arm_smprime cell basis plus the \(4.0\) s arena overhead), classed [ASSUMED] and not [FITTED + RUN] because neither arm of the pair is FOUND on BED-J (04.11's census, RUN this session); the \(\approx34\) s this clause carried is struck as \(10\) per cent above the same arithmetic with no printed overhead term to carry the gap (P-1, M-16); planted negative: an arm emitting the oracle's values permuted must read \(r=O(1)\) while its pooled \(W_1\) reads \(0.0\) (the \(1.421901\) instance, READ V20_R15_THEORY_TABLE.md:221 @ 99777ab) — the residual fires on a known-bad plant and the marginal metric does not. If killed — link 1. The bed keeps its A2 form only: shape against the matched-parameter depth-\(\lfloor\log_2t^\star\rfloor+2\) stack of 04.9 clause 3b (the unmatched-depth stack of clause 3a is printed as \(\Delta_{\rm sky}\) and licenses no A2 sentence), \(\mathrm{acc}\) and \(\varphi\)-NRMSE within \(\mathrm{MDE}_N\) at the realised \(\sigma_d\) predicted (Bet D). Hypotheses: the matched-width skyline cell is FOUND at the same draws with its exact count printed (04.20, 04.9 clause 3b). Evidence: the iteration argument (CITED [V] wang-2024-incontext-td); the matched width NOT MEASURED — needs the reduced-width parameter count; the threshold NOT MEASURED — needs $\sigma_d$ from 04.21 step (5). Kill: the matched-parameter skyline ahead by more than \(\mathrm{MDE}_N\) at the realised \(\sigma_d\) — "one operator" carries no accuracy sentence at all; price \(\approx64.8\) s [ASSUMED]. If killed — link 2. The residual is retained as a diagnostic column and "one read" is repriced as a cost statement (one solve, depth \(s\), \(+50\) per cent causal MACs — the increment \(1.041\) ms/step at \(n=2048\)), decided by 04.10. Hypotheses: the \(1.041\) ms/step increment is a per-op floor measured at \(n=2048\) on the certified device, not an end-to-end step time, and it licenses a cost sentence only inside the dispatch band; the arms are interleaved and the timers synchronised per 04.10. Evidence: the increment \(2.514-1.473=1.041\) ms/step at \(n=2048\) (\(2.312\) at \(4096\), \(4.542\) at \(8192\)), RUN[NEPTUNE]; the dispatch band \(2.0\times\) at the pilot and \(4.4\times\)–\(6.6\times\) at the shipped geometry (READ scale/m3_flops.py:101-121). Kill: the measured increment falling outside the \(2.0\times\)–\(6.6\times\) dispatch band on the certified device — the per-op floor is not a floor for this operation and the cost sentence is struck inside this verse at \(0\) GPU-s from 04.10's own journal, without waiting on 04.10's arena; a link whose kill is delegated wholesale to another verse is not a link. Terminal. "Joint determination in one read is not a differentiator on BED-J; the shape's separate claims are exactness (\(\delta=0\) on the exact route) and cost, and neither is a capability number." Withdrawn: A1 and A2 on BED-J.

docs.title: 04.7 — The chess witness on natural ground, and the local data route before any Kaggle attach
docs.text: Statement. The chess witness is a bed with a categorical state axis whose three labels are recomputed from the board at load and never read from a column: \(\ell(\text{FEN},\text{move})\in\{0,1\}\) legality; \(\text{FEN}'=\text{next}(\text{FEN},\text{move})\); and \(\operatorname{sign}\Delta\mathrm{eval}(\text{FEN},a)\) under a candidate move \(a\), joined to the games by FEN. With \(K\) constraint sets declared as FEN predicates \(\mathcal A_k\) (side-to-move in check; material below a registered threshold; threefold repetition) and a goal predicate \(\mathcal A_0\) (eval above \(+\theta\)), the reach-avoid label per candidate move is defined by rollout, never by the corpus: a fixed rollout policy \(\pi_{\rm roll}\) plays \(h=8\) plies from the post-\(a\) position and the indicator reads whether that rollout enters \(\mathcal A_k\) — a Bernoulli label per \((\text{FEN},a,k)\) whose floor is its base rate at that \(h\). A corpus-defined label is unavailable by construction: a PGN game has exactly one continuation, the one after its played move, so for the \(m-1\) candidates the game did not play no continuation exists and the argmin and the Chebyshev rule would have no label on \(m-1\) of \(m\) candidates. \(\pi_{\rm roll}\) is pinned and hashed per Ruling 7 (generator, seed, sha256 in the manifest beside the bed's) and frozen before any draw, as is the horizon, frozen here at \(h=8\) plies, [ASSUMED] with the reason printed — \(h=8\) matches the \(t^\star=8\) of the synthetic ladder so the two beds ask a comparable number of hops — and neither is fitted to a result (M-2: the horizon is a registered constant of this book, carries an evidence class, and is never re-chosen after a draw). The floor of the capability channel is registered here as a fourth floor object beside the three of 04.3, per constraint set and per horizon: for each \(k\in\{0,1,\dots,K\}\) the floor is \(\mathrm{base}_k(h{=}8)=\max\{p_k,1-p_k\}\), where \(p_k\) is the fraction of \((\text{FEN},a)\) pairs whose \(\pi_{\rm roll}\) rollout enters \(\mathcal A_k\) within \(8\) plies, computed on the \(36\) fixture games and printed in the cell's floor_zeroinfo slot beside the number it floors. Its value is NOT MEASURED — needs one rollout pass of $\pi_{\rm roll}$ over the $36$ fixture games at $h=8$, $0$ GPU-s, an instrument this book specifies and does not write, and no capability number on the channel exists before \(\mathrm{base}_k(8)\) is printed for every \(k\). A horizon without a printed base rate is a label without a floor and is struck by L-FLOOR; a base rate printed at any horizon other than the frozen \(h=8\) is struck by M-2. Legality and next-FEN are rule tasks: their oracle is a rule the control can call, so on those two channels the only creditable reading is learnability against a rule-free 0-hop control, never capability. The eval-\(\Delta\) sign under \(a\) with the \(K\) predicates is the capability channel. The local data route runs first: the hygiene guards on the fixtures in the tree, and no capability cell exists before the two chess sources are PINNED — named by their Kaggle slugs, arevel/chess-games (the move sequences; manifest key lichess_chess_games, which is a misnomer: it is not a Lichess dataset) and lichess/chess-evaluations (the eval shard; manifest key lichess_chess_evaluations). Hypotheses. Splits by GAME never by row; FEN dedupe across splits; oracle labels recomputed by python-chess (chess==1.11.2); the evaluation shard streamed and pinned on one shard; the join by FEN. The join is availability-biased and is censused, not assumed: for an arbitrary candidate move \(a\) the post-move FEN need not appear in lichess/chess-evaluations at all, so \(\operatorname{sign}\Delta\mathrm{eval}(\text{FEN},a)\) is missing for an unmeasured fraction of candidates and the argmin over \(m\) is not formable on a query with a hole. A census line prints the join-hit rate per candidate move on every cell, and the rule is: a query with any missing candidate is discarded, with the discard rate printed beside the cell and beside every number the cell carries. The join-hit rate is NOT MEASURED — needs the pinned eval shard, so no argmin number on the capability channel exists before it is printed. Evidence. RUN this session: python -m pytest -q tests/gate0/test_g05_data.py — 31 passed in 0.73s on torch 2.14.0+cpu (legality and next-FEN agree ply-by-ply with a chess.Board replay; wrecking every stored_* column changes nothing, bitwise; the emitted key set is exactly {fen_before, uci, san, fen_after, legal}). The FEN leak is real before dedupe: \(14\) FENs shared train↔holdout on a correct by-game split, \(0\) after (READ V17_G05_DATA.md:64 @ 99777ab). RUN this session over results/k_data_manifest.json: three entries read UNPINNED_AWAITING_KAGGLE, not two — arevel/chess-games CC0-1.0, \(1.56\) GB (manifest key lichess_chess_games); lichess/chess-evaluations CC0-1.0, \(34.4\) GB (key lichess_chess_evaluations); and alexkarev/tinystories-train-ready CDLA-Sharing-1.0, \(595\) MB (key tinystories_cdla), whose slugs are READ ceq/kdata.py:576,588,615 and kaggle/kernel-metadata.json:11-13. The third gates the LM row of link 2 and nothing on the chess channels: the TinyStories cut is the LM \(\gamma\) cell's corpus, so link 2's "only natural-ground row" is behind that digest as well as behind the author's yes. The witness is not a registered bed: kdata.BED_SPECS reads ['bed_m', 'bed_k', 'bed_1'] (RUN this session; the ledger's "one registered bed" corrected at READ V20_R15_THEORY_TABLE.md:224 @ 99777ab). The fixtures are \(36\) games and \(24\) articles, synthetic (READ V17_G05_DATA.md:375-378 @ 99777ab). The arena clause that named the witness: READ CEQ_V20_R15_CONTRACT.md:118-120 @ 99777ab. Mechanism. V-22 (no threshold crosses the device boundary), P-1, D-2 (a rule-computable label), V-3, M-2 (the horizon frozen at \(h=8\) before any draw), L-FLOOR (the base rate registered as the channel's floor per constraint set), the Kaggle-yes rule (kaggle/README.md:9-11). Kill. Any capability number on the witness before the arevel/chess-games and lichess/chess-evaluations sha256 digests are written into results/k_data_manifest.json — struck as P-1; any number on legality or next-FEN quoted as capability — struck as D-2; any capability number quoted before the join-hit rate and its discard rate are printed, or before the \(h=8\) base rate of each \(\mathcal A_k\) is printed — struck as P-1 (a channel with no floor and a channel with an unmeasured hole are both unscoreable); the eval-\(\Delta\) channel's kill is the base-rate floor: an arm within the Clopper–Pearson half-width of the majority sign at \(N\), \(N\) fixed by 04.9 clause 7's rule at the realised \(\sigma_d\) and provisionally \(8\) (NOT MEASURED — needs $\sigma_d$ from 04.21 step (5)), the half-width computed against \(\mathrm{base}_k(8)\) printed in the same row. Price: \(0\) GPU-s locally; the Kaggle certificate run \(\approx8.7\) GPU-min [ASSUMED] behind the author's yes. Planted negative: the corrupted-column plant already fires (the stored_* wreck leaves labels bitwise unchanged — the instrument that reads columns would be caught by it); and a query built with one candidate's post-move FEN deliberately absent from the joined shard must be discarded by the join census, which is the known-holed case the discard rule fires on. If killed — link 1. The witness is carried as a hygiene bed only: the five guards (split by game, split by article, FEN dedupe, n-gram census, recomputed labels) with their planted violations, and no label channel — so the link survives every defect of the label definition, the horizon and the join, because it drops every label channel. Hypotheses: the fixtures stay synthetic (\(36\) games, \(24\) articles) until a real PGN is attached. Evidence: the planted violations fire today — a row-level split raises HygieneViolation, a boundary moved \(1\) byte raises, contamination reads rate \(1.0\) against \(0.0\) on disjoint text (READ V17_G05_DATA.md:60-68 @ 99777ab; RUN this session \(31\) passed). Kill: a guard whose planted violation does not fire (V-15) — the guard is deleted; price \(0.73\) s (RUN). If killed — link 2. The witness leaves the canon's bed ladder; the LM \(\gamma\) cell (S-73) becomes the only natural-ground row and stays NOT MEASURED behind the yes. Kill: an LM number pooled with a local one (V-22) — struck. Terminal. "The chess witness is a specification with \(31\) passing hygiene tests and no registered bed, no pinned source and no number." Withdrawn: every sentence of the form "on chess the shape reads the safest move".

docs.title: Part II — Labels, heads and metrics
04.8 — Labels and heads for the four classes, with the metric plants
docs.text: Statement. Four heads, four scoring rules, fixed before any arm exists (M-2): | head | object | read at | metric | floor | |---|---|---|---|---| | committor / reach-avoid | \(q(a)\in[0,1]^{K+2}\) per move, full vector on \(T\) | \(\gamma=1\) on the transient block, exact solve \((I-\hat Q)^{-1}\hat R\mathbb 1\) | \(\varphi(p)=2\arcsin\sqrt p\) per entry, position-matched NRMSE (mean, max); \(r(\hat q)\) with units | exact oracle \(0.0\) | | argmin | \(a^\star\in[m]\) | — | accuracy with Clopper–Pearson; McNemar paired on identical draws | \(1-\max_a\hat\pi(a^\star)\) | | state | \(z^\star\in\mathbb R^{s\times d}\) | \(\hat\gamma\) | position-matched per-coordinate NRMSE vector; \(r(\hat z)\) | exact oracle \(0.0\) | | consequence | \(\Delta z(a)\) | \(\hat\gamma\) | the same vector; field cosine and magnitude ratio over coordinates \(\ge i_{\min}\); the sign column with McNemar on the sign only; paired \(t\)/Wilcoxon on the cosine | exact oracle \(0.0\); the no-change predictor's error printed on the position-matched NRMSE column only, which is the column it is scored on | The arm's \(\hat\gamma\) does not enter the committor head. Refused metrics: pooled \(W_1\), Procrustes, position-free OT. The refusal is per column, and its scope is printed, because a head that refuses an arm outright and prints that same arm's error as its floor refuses and scores one object at once (V-10, L-FLOOR). An arm emitting \(\Delta\hat z\equiv0\) makes the field cosine \(0/0\) and the magnitude ratio \(0/\lVert\Delta z\rVert\); it is refused on those two columns and on no other, and it is scored on the position-matched per-coordinate NRMSE vector and on the sign column's McNemar, where both are well defined (\(\lVert\Delta\hat z-\Delta z\rVert\) needs no direction, and the sign of \(0\) is a registered tie handled by the McNemar's discordant-pair rule). The NRMSE the no-change predictor reads on that column is the number the consequence row prints in its floor cell. Every refused cell journals refused_columns = [cosine, magnitude_ratio] (04.15), so the scope of the refusal is auditable and no reader takes an unrefused column's number for a refused one. Hypotheses. The label is the full vector on \(T\) (the residual needs it; a \([m,K+2]\) summary alone is unscoreable on \(r\)); the intervened position is drawn uniformly; coordinates with zero label variance (every coordinate \(<i_{\min}\), and coordinate \(0\) on every draw since row \(0\) is \(e_0\)) are masked from the cosine and their fraction printed — the fraction being 04.2's admission clause 4, "every per-coordinate sd of \(q\) over the admitted query region \(>0.05\), with the fraction of coordinates at zero label variance printed", which is the only registered variance census in this book. The earlier pointer, "04.4's census line 10", named a line that does not exist: 04.4 registers two guards (zero-hop, leak) and no census, and its verse text carries no numbered lines, so the masking rule pointed at nothing (P-4, P-6). Evidence. Discounted read against undiscounted label: reading \(q\) to \(1\) per cent at \(\tau=8\) needs \(\hat\gamma\ge0.99857\), \(1/(1-\hat\gamma)\approx697\) (RUN[F], READ docs/sources/design/refute_falsify_math.md §3.12) — hence the head at \(\gamma=1\). Fisher–Rao chosen before the curve: the record measured Euclidean/Fisher–Rao ratios \(1.418962\) and \(1.209472\) (READ MATHEMATICS.md:69-104). Softmax owns the sign column at \(0.807843\), CP \([0.754044,0.854329]\) (READ MATHEMATICS.md:396-406). The three metric plants: permuted oracle scores \(W_1=0.0\) at NRMSE \(1.421901\); \(W_1\) prefers the permutation to \(\mathrm{oracle}+0.1\sigma\) by \(14.465\times\) (READ V20_R15_THEORY_TABLE.md:221 @ 99777ab). The no-change floor CITED [V] vakalis-2026-interventiongap. Mechanism. V-26, V-17, M-2, V-16, V-8, D-2 (the residual is a score, never a loss). Kill (B-G2). Any of the three plants passing on the registered metric: (i) the permuted oracle scores \(0\); (ii) \(\mathrm{oracle}+0.1\sigma\) is not preferred to the permutation; (iii) \(-\Delta z\) is indistinguishable from \(\Delta z\) — the metric is struck. Instrument: the plant script of docs/PLAN.md S-24 on the oracle alone, \(0\) GPU-s. The plants are the known-bad controls. If killed — link 1. The cosine and ratio are dropped and the position-matched NRMSE vector alone scores \(\Delta z\), with the sign column kept. Hypotheses: the label has non-zero variance on every scored coordinate (04.2's admission clause 4, the per-coordinate sd line with its zero-variance fraction printed; the earlier pointer "04.4's census line 10" named a line 04.4 does not carry — P-4, P-6). Evidence: NRMSE on the permuted oracle reads \(1.421901>1\), on \(\mathrm{oracle}+0.1\sigma\) reads \(0.098296619951725\) (READ V20_R15_THEORY_TABLE.md:221 @ 99777ab). Kill: plant (i) on the NRMSE vector — impossible by construction, so this link is more decisive than the cosine's. If killed — link 2. Any metric added or removed after the first arena cell voids that cell's numbers (M-2); the metric file's hash is part of predictions_hash. Kill: a hash recorded after the first cell's timestamp; price \(0\) GPU-s. Terminal. "Every head is scored by a position-matched per-coordinate error against an exact oracle at \(0.0\); no joint metric is claimed."

docs.title: Part III — The measurement protocol
04.9 — The protocol that measures "more accurate" (A1, A2), and \(N\) from the realised sd (B25, B5)
docs.text: Statement. A capability number in form A1 or A2 exists only when every clause below holds on one journal: 1. Paired seeds. \(N\ge8\) distinct seeds, deduplicated, one thread lane read from the journal; every arm on byte-identical draws (train batch at seed, eval batch at seed + 12345, init from the global generator after torch.manual_seed(seed) — RNG_PLAN, READ scale/identity_manifest.py:78); the pairing asserted as a relation — the seed sets of the two arms equal — never as two marginal counts (V-26). 2. Matched parameters printed. params_per_arm in every table header; never re-architected to close a gap. Ruling 3 fixes only the residual that is matched, not the boundary: its text at READ V17K_RULINGS.md:56-59 @ 99777ab reads "0.032% residual is MATCHED. Print exact counts in every table header + one COSTS line", and it prints no upper bar. The record's sole matched instance is \(25{,}736{,}232\) against \(25{,}728{,}000\), a residual of \(8{,}232\) parameters \(=0.0320\) per cent (CHARTER §5 B19; DERIVED from the two counts). The boundary is therefore frozen here as a new constant of this book: a count differing from the shape's by more than \(0.0960\) per cent after the head is attached is not matched — [ASSUMED] three times the largest matched residual on record, $3\times0.0320=0.0960$, the multiplier printed and the product not rounded, because rounding a frozen threshold away from the instance that motivates it is the V-11 defect this clause exists to avoid. \(0.0320\) per cent is matched by Ruling 3's own text; anything in \((0.0320,0.0960]\) per cent is matched by this book's constant and prints the constant beside it; anything above \(0.0960\) per cent is unmatched and licenses no A1 and no A2 sentence. 3. The skyline in the same row, and the two skyline objects kept apart. Two distinct arms are read, and only one of them can carry an A2 sentence. (3a) \(\Delta_{\rm sky}\), a printed control at unmatched depth and unmatched parameters: the depth-\(\lfloor\log_2t^\star\rfloor+2\) softmax stack (\(3/5/7\) at \(t^\star=2/8/32\)), its number printed beside every matched contrast; it satisfies R-SKY's requirement that the depth skyline be read beside every bed, and it licenses no A2 sentence at all, because CHARTER §1 defines A2 as "at matched parameters against the depth skyline" and this arm's parameter count is printed as unmatched (04.20 Hypotheses). (3b) the matched-parameter skyline, registered here as a fourth skyline arm: the same depth-\(\lfloor\log_2t^\star\rfloor+2\) stack at reduced width, the width chosen before any draw as the largest per-layer width whose total count lands within clause 2's \(0.0960\) per cent of the shape's, the width and the exact count printed in sky_width and params_per_arm (04.15). A2 is read against 3b and against nothing else; A1 is read only where 3a's row is filled. The width that lands inside the bar at the registered geometry (\(d_{\rm model}=16\), \(s=64\), depth \(5\) at \(t^\star=8\)) is NOT MEASURED — needs one parameter-count arithmetic pass over the registered stack once the $[m,K+2]$ head's count is fixed (04.6,params_per_armNOT MEASURED), $0$ GPU-s, and until it is printed no A2 number exists on any bed of this book. 4. \(\mathrm{MDE}_N\) from the realised paired sd. With \(\sigma_d\) the realised sd of the paired per-seed differences, \(\mathrm{MDE}_N\) is the smallest \(\delta\) with power \(0.80\) at two-sided \(\alpha=0.05\) under the noncentral \(t\) with \(N-1\) degrees of freedom and noncentrality \(\delta\sqrt N/\sigma_d\), found by the guarded bisection (the unguarded one returns non-monotone answers because scipy.stats.nct returns nan at large noncentrality). No contrast smaller than \(\mathrm{MDE}_N\) at the realised \(\sigma_d\) is claimed. 5. Distance-to-floor. The contrast is between distances to the bed's floor (04.3), never between raw errors. 6. The noncentral-\(t\) rule for \(N\). If \(\sigma_d\ge0.109199\) — the M-3 precedent's realised value itself, not a rounded multiple of it — \(N\) is repriced from \(\sigma_d\) before any bet is scored; the \(n=16\) column is the first honest count; nothing at \(N=8\) is falsifiable. The ratio to the pilot is printed to four figures, \(0.109199/0.050146=2.1776\), and is a read-out, never the threshold: freezing the rule at \(2.18\times0.050146=0.109318\) would place the bar \(1.19\times10^{-4}\) above the only realised instance that motivates it, so the historical failure would not fire the rule that was written to catch it (V-11, V-15, M-3). 7. The placeholder rule. BED-S has no realised \(\sigma_d\) (04.21), so every numeric \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\) in this book is a placeholder and none of them is a frozen threshold. A kill in this book is frozen as a rule in units of \(\mathrm{MDE}_N\) at the realised \(\sigma_d\) — \(N\) the smallest seed count of 04.9 link 1 whose \(\mathrm{MDE}_N\) at that \(\sigma_d\) falls below the smallest registered effect — and never as the number \(0.039827\) or \(0.126238\). Each such threshold reads NOT MEASURED — needs $\sigma_d$ from 04.21 step (5) until the journal carries it, and a bet scored against a placeholder number is struck by 04.21's Kill. The rule is frozen now (M-2) and the number it evaluates to is filled later; that is the only order in which a threshold can be both frozen and honest on a bed with no cell. Hypotheses. The adjudicator reads only journals (refuses below \(8\) distinct seeds; deduplicates; reads threads from the record; checks predictions_hash against results/arena/PREDICTIONS.sha256 and refuses on a mismatch; refuses any calibration row whose counter field is empty or absent — the counter check is written into this specification here, because 04.17's Kill delegates a refusal to this adjudicator and a refusal the adjudicator's specification does not carry is a refusal nothing performs (P-4); never writes the prediction file). The adjudicator and that file do not exist and are marked as such wherever they are named: NOT MEASURED — needs the arena adjudicator and its frozen prediction file atresults/arena/PREDICTIONS.sha256`,RUNthis sessionls results/arenareadingNo such file or directory, so the directory, the frozen prediction file and the refusal instrument are all absent and their construction is a row of 05 REPAIRS priced there. Every clause of this book that names the adjudicator — clause 1's seed refusal, clause 3's skyline row, 04.1'svoid_contrastsrefusal, 04.3's floor read, 04.17's bare-prediction refusal and 04.21'spredictions_hashcheck — names an instrument that isNOT MEASUREDon those terms, and no verse reads a refusal as having happened (P-1, P-4). Cross-thread drift $2.345\times10^{-3}$, so a margin below $\approx4.7\times10^{-3}$ is indefensible. **Evidence.** The MDE column, guarded bisection, RUN by VENUS and re-verifiedRUN[MARS]to $0.0398266$: paired sd $0.010101\to\mathrm{MDE}_8=0.011677$, $\mathrm{MDE}_{16}=0.007570$; $0.034451\to0.039827/0.025820$; $0.050146\to0.057971/0.037583$; $0.109199\to0.126238/0.081841$ (READdocs/sources/sections/sec_beds.md§6.D.2;MATHEMATICS.md:979-993). At $N=5$ the finest two-sided $p$ is $0.0625$ and unanimity is a sign test $385/385$ (READMISTAKES.md:580-676, M-9).REQUIRED_SEEDS = 8(READscale/it11_verdict.py:59); the thread floor (READscale/it11_verdict.py:130-140). The M-3 precedent: pilot $0.050146$, realised $0.109199$, ratio $2.1776$ to four figures (READdocs/sources/sections/sec_beds.md:313;MISTAKES.md:464-494) — the ratio is printed as a read-out and the threshold is the realised value itself (clause 6, K-P). BED-S's $\sigma_d$:NOT MEASURED — needs the first eight seeds (04.21); **every $\mathrm{MDE}_8$ number above and everywhere else in this book is a placeholder, is markedNOT MEASURED — needs \(\sigma_d\) from 04.21 step (5)at each of its uses, and is not a frozen threshold**; the frozen object is clause 7's rule in units of $\mathrm{MDE}_N$ at the realised $\sigma_d$. The matched-parameter bar of clause 2 is the book's own[ASSUMED]constant $0.0960$ per cent $=3\times0.0320$, the record's only matched residual being $8{,}232/25{,}728{,}000=0.0320$ per cent (CHARTER §5 B19, DERIVED); Ruling 3 at READV17K_RULINGS.md:56-59 @ 99777abprints no bar of its own. The matched-parameter skyline of clause 3b:NOT MEASURED — needs the reduced-width parameter count, and no A2 number exists in this book until it is printed. The it.3 cost ratios withdrawn at C17 are not accuracy numbers and appear nowhere here. **Mechanism.** M-3, M-9, V-5, M-13, V-26, M-10, M-16, Ruling 3, R-SKY, D-1, V-11 (a threshold rounded past the instance that motivates it cannot fire on it), V-15 (the plant must instantiate the kill's own condition), V-17 (a bar with no source is a threshold imported out of its units), P-1. **Kill (K-P).** $\sigma_d\ge0.109199$ on the first eight seeds of the softmax control on BED-S — **the threshold is frozen at the realised value of the M-3 precedent, not at a rounded multiplier**: the precedent's realised sd is $0.109199$ against a pilot $0.050146$ (READdocs/sources/sections/sec_beds.md:313;MISTAKES.md:464-494), the ratio is $0.109199/0.050146=2.1776$ printed to four figures, and the earlier form $\sigma_d\ge2.18\times0.050146=0.109318$ was struck because $0.109199<0.109318$: the one historical instance the kill exists to catch fell $1.19\times10^{-4}$ below its own bar and would not have fired it (V-11, V-15, M-3). Instrument: the arena ofdocs/PLAN.mdS-62 ($7\times8\times1.680+4.0\approx98$ s, and $\approx3.3$ GPU-min with the skyline and InfSA-16, both **[ASSUMED]and not DERIVED**: the arithmetic is arithmetic, but five of the seven arms have no implementation and no record (04.11'skindcensus,RUNthis session), so the $1.680$ s basis is thearm_smprimecell time standing in for cells that do not exist; the arena's price becomes DERIVED only when every arm in it is FOUND, and until then $98$ s is a lower bound on a run that cannot be started). **Planted negative (the one that fires K-P).** An arm pair built deliberately heteroscedastic: both arms are the depth-1 softmax control on byte-identical draws, and arm B alone takes a **seed-dependent learning rate** $\eta(\text{seed})=\eta_0\cdot2^{(j-4)/2}$ at the $j$-th of the eight seeds, a spread of $2^{3.5}=11.31\times$ across the lane, registered before the run and journalled inproducer_cmd. The per-seed differences then inherit the learning-rate spread, the realised $\sigma_d$ of that pair must exceed $0.109199$, and K-P must fire on it — the known-bad plant the kill's own condition instantiates. **Separate control, not the plant.** Two bit-identical arms must return NO VERDICT at every $N$ under this protocol (the TOST branch has no passing verdict at $N=8$: half-width $0.8807\sigma$ against a $0.5\sigma$ margin, READMISTAKES.md:1210-1247, M-13) — this is the **no-false-parity** control and it is at the opposite end of the range from K-P: it reads $\sigma_d=0$, it is about the TOST branch and not about $\sigma_d$, and it certifies that the protocol cannot manufacture parity. It is retained under that name and is not this kill's planted negative. Both plants readNOT MEASURED — needs the first eight seeds (04.21). **If killed — link 1.** $N$ is repriced to the smallest $N$ whose $\mathrm{MDE}_N$ at the realised $\sigma_d$ is below the smallest registered effect; the $n=16$ column first ($\mathrm{MDE}_{16}=0.081841$ at $\sigma_d=0.109199$); price $\approx2\times$ the arena, 1 evening. *Hypotheses:* $\sigma_d$ is stationary across the second eight seeds (checked: the first-eight and second-eight sd printed side by side). *Evidence:* the $n=16$ column (RUN[VENUS],RUN[MARS]). *Kill:* $\mathrm{MDE}_{16}$ still above every registered effect — decided at $0$ GPU-s from the realised $\sigma_d$ before the seeds run. **If killed — link 2.** The paired equivalence tier: TOST at $N=36$ paired if $\sigma_d=\sigma$ (power $0.8014$, Monte Carlo $200{,}000$ draws,RUN[MARS]), $N=70$ two-sample if pairing buys nothing ($0.7975$ at $69$, $0.8073$ at $70$, half-width $0.2799\sigma$), decided only on the $\mathcal A=\emptyset$ parity half; price $119$ s / $228$ s DERIVED, 1 evening. *Hypotheses:* the margin $0.5\sigma$ is fixed before the run (M-2); $\hat\gamma$ is MOVED, else the half is softmax against softmax. *Evidence:* CITED [V]schuirmann-1987-tost`; the sequential anytime-valid form NOT FOUND at [V]. Kill: the \(90\) per cent interval outside \(\pm0.5\sigma\) — parity at trained \(\hat\gamma\) is not claimed; only the \(\gamma=0\) identity bind licenses "contains softmax". This link is more decisive than link 1 because it settles equivalence, which a difference test at any \(N\) cannot. Terminal. "At the realised paired sd, no contrast on the bed is falsifiable at any affordable \(N\); the bed is filed with its sd, its floors and its controls, and no capability number." Withdrawn: A1 and A2 on that bed.

docs.title: 04.10 — The protocol that measures "faster to train" (T1, T2), the timers and the training-noise floor (B25)
docs.text: Statement. "Faster to train" is two numbers per bed, arm pair and head, and nothing else: $\(\mathrm{T1}=\frac{\text{GPU-seconds}_{\rm shape}(\tau)}{\text{GPU-seconds}_{\rm control}(\tau)},\qquad \mathrm{T2}=\frac{\text{draws}_{\rm shape}(\tau)}{\text{draws}_{\rm control}(\tau)},\)$ where \(\tau\) is a distance-to-floor level registered before the run, the first level both arms reach within the step budget is the one reported, and each ratio is taken against the depth-1 control and against the depth skyline in the same row. Two ladders are registered here, one per head class, because a single NRMSE ladder leaves T1 and T2 undefined on two of this book's four heads and on one of its three beds. The ladder \(\{0.9,0.8,0.7,0.5\}\) in NRMSE-to-oracle units is the vector-head ladder and covers exactly the three vector heads of 04.8 — the committor \(q\), the state \(z^\star\) and the consequence \(\Delta z\) — every one of which is scored by a position-matched NRMSE against an exact oracle at \(0.0\) and anchored at \(1.0\) for the mean predictor (04.3, V-17). It covers no rate-valued head: 04.8's argmin head is scored by accuracy with Clopper–Pearson and 04.7's eval-\(\Delta\) capability channel by a Bernoulli sign rate, and neither has an NRMSE-to-oracle, so a \(\tau\) read off the vector ladder on either of them is a threshold imported out of its units (V-17) and the earlier single-ladder Statement was undefined on them. The rate-head ladder is therefore registered here as this book's second \(\tau\) ladder, in distance-to-floor units, with four levels frozen at the same four numbers and the same anchoring: $\(\tau_{\rm rate}=\frac{1-\mathrm{acc}}{\mathrm{floor}},\qquad \mathrm{floor}=\mathrm{floor}_{\rm zeroinfo}=1-\max_a\hat\pi(a^\star)\ \text{on the argmin head (04.3)},\quad \mathrm{floor}=\mathrm{base}_k(h{=}8)=\max\{p_k,1-p_k\}\ \text{on the chess capability channel (04.7)},\)$ $\(\tau_{\rm rate}\in\{0.9,\ 0.8,\ 0.7,\ 0.5\}\ \text{frozen here (M-2), the floor recomputed on the batch being scored, never imported from a neighbouring batch}.\)$ \(\tau_{\rm rate}\) reads \(1\) at chance and \(0\) at the exact oracle, which is the anchoring the NRMSE ladder already has, so the two ladders carry the same four levels without either one being read in the other's units. Which ladder a cell used is printed in the cell, and a T1 or T2 quoted on a rate-valued head against the NRMSE ladder — or on a vector head against the rate ladder — is struck (V-17). T1 and T2 on the argmin head and on the chess capability channel are NOT MEASURED — needs the rate-head ladder's floor: $\mathrm{floor}_{\rm zeroinfo}$ from the first admitted batch (04.3, 04.21 step 5) for the argmin head, and $\mathrm{base}_k(8)$ from one rollout pass over the $36$ fixture games (04.7) for the chess channel** — the ladder is defined and frozen here, and its denominator on each head is the floor that head's verse already owes. Every timed region is bracketed by twotorch.cuda.synchronize()calls; the arms are interleaved (shape, control, skyline, shape, …) in a randomised order recorded per cell; the Spearman correlation of seconds against run index is printed with its $p$; the training-noise floor is measured once per lane as $|\Delta|$ of final loss between two identical-seed chunks and a T1 or T2 difference below that floor is not a difference. A per-step cost model — one triangular solve of depth $s$ against $L$ attention layers, $+s^2d/2$ MACs over $s^2d$ — is DERIVED and licenses no "faster" sentence until the cost law of the kernel book is RUN. **Hypotheses.** The certified device (torch 2.5.1+cu121, RTX 4060 Laptop, $7.996$ GiB — READresults/k_cert_local.json); **$N=8$ seeds per arm, and the Kill's $N$ counts arm-cells in the timing journal, not seeds — the reading is printed here because the two differ and the kill is unreachable under the wrong one.** At $8$ seeds and the three interleaved arms of this verse's own order (shape, control, skyline) the journal holds $8\times3=24$ timings, so the Kill's $N\ge16$ is satisfied at the registered seed count; read as seeds it would demand $16$ seeds the bed does not register and could never fire on the bed as registered (V-11). Every $N$ in this verse names which of the two it counts. The same step budget and batch size per arm; the laptop clock non-stationary at $\pm12$ per cent, so prices are quoted in GPU-minutes to two decimals; determinismwarn_only=Truefor training, bitwise for every deciding forward cell (Ruling 1). **Evidence.** The record's hazard: notorch.cuda.synchronize()inscripts/v15_r1.py, and run order the strongest correlate ofsecsat $\rho=+0.7029$, $p=0.0024$, above the gate correlation $+0.5197$; every GPU-second and cost ratio quoted from it.3 onward ($0.3455$ GPU-h, $10.17\times$, $41.9\times$, $2.85/118.8$) withdrawn at C17 (READV20_R15_JOURNAL.md:53 @ 99777ab). The dispatch gap $2.0\times$ at the pilot and $4.4\times$–$6.6\times$ at the shipped geometry, and the same unit reading $2.0775$ against $3.4372$ s/step in two sessions, $1.65\times$ apart on identical code (READscale/m3_flops.py:101-121). The identical-seed floor $\delta_{\rm nrmse}=0.0$ on $6/6$ pairs on the certified device (RUN[WATSON], READdocs/sources/plan/plan_saturn.mdS-62). The per-op increment $2.514-1.473=1.041$ ms/step at $n=2048$ ($2.312$ at $4096$, $4.542$ at $8192$),RUN[NEPTUNE], a per-op floor. "Faster to train" has never been defined or measured in the record (READdocs/canon/CHARTER.md§5 B25). **The two ladders and their scope:** the vector-head ladder's unit is the position-matched NRMSE against an exact oracle at $0.0$, anchored at $1.0$ for the mean predictor, which is 04.3's own floor object for $q$, $z^\star$ and $\Delta z$ and 04.8's own metric column for all three; the rate-head ladder's denominator is $\mathrm{floor}_{\rm zeroinfo}=1-\max_a\hat\pi(a^\star)$ on the argmin head (04.3, and 04.8's floor cell for that head) and $\mathrm{base}_k(8)$ on the chess capability channel (04.7's fourth floor object), bothNOT MEASUREDon their own verses' terms — $\mathrm{floor}_{\rm zeroinfo}$ needs the first admitted batch (04.21 step 5), $\mathrm{base}_k(8)$ needs one rollout pass over the $36$ fixture games. The four levels $\{0.9,0.8,0.7,0.5\}$ are this book's own frozen constants on both ladders (M-2), registered here and not fitted to any result. Every T1 and T2 on every bed and head:NOT MEASURED — needs the synchronised, interleaved arena (03 KERNEL specifies the timer; this verse specifies the arms, the two ladders and \(\tau\)). **Mechanism.** C17, P-8, M-3, M-8, D-3, M-5 (a process that cannot cross its own threshold: $\tau$ unreachable is VOID, never a loss), V-10 (the level is registered, not read off the worse arm's last step), V-15 (the plant must isolate the confound the kill names, which a cross-arm order does not). **Kill.** Spearman $|\rho|>0.5$ with $p<0.05$ between seconds and run index on the $N\ge16$ interleaved timings, **$N$ counting arm-cells and not seeds** (the Hypotheses' reading: $8$ seeds $\times\ 3$ interleaved arms $=24$ timings, so the requirement is met at the registered $8$ seeds per arm and the kill has a journal on the bed as registered) — every T1 on that journal is struck; or no level of **the head's own registered ladder** reached by both arms — T1 and T2 are VOID on that head and bed; or a T1 difference below the measured noise floor quoted as a ratio; or **a T1 or T2 on a rate-valued head read against the vector ladder's NRMSE-to-oracle units, or on a vector head read against the rate ladder** — struck as V-17, decided by the ladder id printed in the cell against the head's class in 04.8's table, $0$ GPU-s. Instrument: the arena of 04.9 re-run with the timer edits (--seq-lenflag, twosynchronize()calls, randomised order — the edits the record priced at $206$–$537$ GPU-s and never made, READV20_R15_THEORY_TABLE.md:104-109 @ 99777ab); price the band only. **Planted negative — the confound is injected inside one arm, never across two.** The earlier plant (all shape cells first, then all control cells) is **struck as confounded by the very arms it was meant to control**: with a perfectly stationary clock a serial cross-arm order still reads $|\rho|=1$ whenever the two arms differ in per-step cost, and this book's own figure for that difference is $2.514-1.473=1.041$ ms/step at $n=2048$ (RUN[NEPTUNE]), so the plant fires on a clock with no drift at all and certifies nothing about the detector (V-15, C17). The plant that replaces it uses **one arm only**: the same arm — the depth-1 softmax control — is run twice, serially, over $N\ge16$ interleaved cells — $8$ seeds $\times\ 2$ runs $=16$ arm-cells under the Hypotheses' arm-cell reading of $N$, so the plant is affordable at the registered seed count — with an injected **monotone background occupancy ramp** on the device (a competing allocation grown step by step across the run, registered inproducer_cmdand journalled withrun_index), and the requirement is $|\rho|>0.5$ at $p<0.05$ computed **across those same-arm timings alone**. Because both timing series come from one arm, a per-step cost difference between arms cannot produce the correlation, and only the injected drift can; the detector therefore fires on a known-drifting clock and on nothing else. The unramped same-arm pair is retained beside it as the must-not-fire half: the same arm twice with no ramp must read $|\rho|\le0.5$ or $p\ge0.05$. Both plants readNOT MEASURED — needs the synchronised, interleaved arena. **If killed — link 1.** T2 alone: draws-to-floor is order-invariant and needs no timer; the ratio is read from the journal's per-step eval trace. *Hypotheses:* the eval trace is journalled per step (04.15 fieldeval_trace); the identical-seed floor is $0.0$ so a crossing step is exact per seed. *Evidence:* $\delta_{\rm nrmse}=0.0$ on $6/6$ identical-seed pairs (RUN[WATSON]`). Kill: no level of the head's own registered ladder reached by both arms — decided from the same journal at \(0\) GPU-s, cheaper than the timer re-run. If killed — link 2. The per-step cost model stays DERIVED and the sentence "faster to train" is withdrawn; the kernel book's cost law (03) is the only route back. Kill: a ratio quoted from the MAC model as a training-speed number — struck (P-8). Terminal.** "No 'faster to train' sentence is licensed on any bed; the cost model is a MAC count and the measured increment is a per-op floor under a \(2.0\times\)–\(6.6\times\) dispatch gap." Withdrawn: T1 and T2 everywhere.

docs.title: Part IV — Controls, binds, manifests and censuses
04.11 — The control arms per bed, and the column-sink control (B21)
docs.text: Statement. The roster below is a specification, not a set of arms: of its thirteen members exactly one — the depth-1 softmax — is FOUND, and the whole remainder is NOT MEASURED — needs the control-arm implementations (one make_arm branch, one optimizer path and one field emit per control, priced as 04.14 prices the W2 route at $41$–$130$ GPU-s per branch). Under 04.14's own rule an arm is FOUND iff results/ holds a record with its kind, and a named arm is struck; the kind census this session returns \(24\) distinct kinds and not one of them names any member of this roster except softmax, so 04.14 strikes every comparative sentence this verse could carry. The roster, as the specification the branches must implement, on byte-identical draws at matched parameters: the depth-1 softmax with the same head (FOUND, kind softmax, \(227\) records); ChaCAL-diag (the shape with \(\mathcal A=\emptyset\), diagonal kept, at the shape's trained \(\hat\gamma\) — sequential, order stated) NAMED; ChaCAL-published (diagonal removed inside the inverse, sub-stochastic) NAMED; ChaCAL-with-sink-token (a column device standing in for the row condition — the K-E1 control) NAMED; the InfSA-style Neumann read at \(K=16\) without boundaries NAMED; the cached-mixture arm \(O_{\rm cached}=\hat P_{\rm base}(I-\gamma\hat P_{\rm base})^{-1}V_{\rm int}\) (K-G1) NAMED; the argmin controls (0-hop MLP, 1-hop softmax, majority, random, predict-the-mean) NAMED; and the three skylines at unmatched depth, width and decode length NAMED. K-E1's direction is stated the way D-CALIB and the Preface state it, not inverted: K-E1 — a column sink reproduces the row condition — is the counter to this canon's mechanism claim that boundary rows are not a column device, and under D-CALIB the counter is the point estimate for every unscored prediction, so K-E1 is the reported point estimate on every bed of this book until a cell scores it. The canon's own prediction (the two differ) is the unscored side and carries nothing. Hypotheses. ChaCAL-with-sink is defined only after the shape trains (its \(\hat\gamma\)), so the pair is sequential and the order is in the manifest (M-2 in potential form); every control is FOUND under results/ with its own kind before it is named in a table — this second hypothesis is false at the time of writing and is the reason the verse's own kill is unreachable: twelve of the thirteen members have no record and no implementation, so every clause of the Statement that compares two arms is asserted under a hypothesis that does not hold. Evidence. ChaCAL's read and its \(\gamma=0.9\) setting CITED [V] fagnou-2024-chacal Eq. 5, App. C; the sink literature CITED [V] xiao-2023-attentionsinks, gu-2024-sinkemerges, ranmilo-2026-attentionsinks; the record's value-zero column sink V15Fork.Asink (READ lean/CEQ/V15Fork.lean:67-70) is a column device distinct from the row condition; Zhu's clamped nodes CITED [V] zhu-2003-harmonic are the same rows, 23 years old; the successor-representation mechanism momennejad-2017-sr is [U]. The roster's own census, RUN this session: grep -rniE 'chacal|infsa' --include='*.py' . (excluding .venv) returns \(0\) lines — no ChaCAL and no InfSA arm exists anywhere in the tree; and grep -rho '"kind": *"[a-zA-Z_0-9]*"' results --include='*.jsonl' | sort | uniq -c returns \(24\) kinds — arm_smprime 425, arm_pl 422, softmax 227, rung 40, census 31, pivot_signed 11, pivot_unsigned 11, welch 5, summary 4, mc_random_unit 4, kirchhoff 4, probe 3, provenance 2, constant_g 2, windowed_signed 1, scramble_residual_shipped 1, scramble_residual 1, reproduce_check 1, recovery_check 1, real_key_directions 1, not_generated 1, naive_yield 1, halt_demo 1, band_miss 1 — holding \(0\) records for chacal_diag, chacal_published, chacal_with_sink, infsa_neumann_16, the cached mixture, majority, random, predict_the_mean and every skyline. Prices, repriced to what the tree supports: \(1.680\) s per shape cell is [FITTED + RUN] on arm_smprime (READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:2297-2298) and \(1.524\) s per softmax cell is [FITTED]; per ChaCAL cell the figure is [ASSUMED] the arm_smprime cell time stands in for a ChaCAL cell, the reason being that ChaCAL-diag is the shape's own solve at \(\mathcal A=\emptyset\) and differs from it by the boundary rows alone, and the same [ASSUMED] carries the three-arm figure. That figure is \(\approx44.3\) s and not \(\approx52\) s, and the arithmetic is printed here because the verse's own price contradicted itself by \(18\) per cent: \(3\times8\times1.680+4.0=44.32\) s for three arms at eight seeds, where \(4.0\) s is the arena's fixed set-up overhead carried at the same [ASSUMED] class as 04.9's \(7\times8\times1.680+4.0\approx98\) s; no overhead term carries the missing \(7.7\) s, so \(\approx52\) s is struck (P-1, M-16). The same arithmetic prices one pair at \(\approx30.9\) s (\(2\times8\times1.680+4.0=30.88\) s), which replaces the \(\approx34\) s carried in 04.6's Bet E instrument, in 04.5's link 2 and in the kills table. InfSA-16's \(\approx5.12\) s per cell is not derivable from the \(25.409\) ms hop and is no longer classed as if it were: \(16\times25.409\,\mathrm{ms}=0.407\) s, a factor \(12.6\) below \(5.12\) s, so the source's own words "DERIVED from the \(25.409\) ms hop microbenchmark" (READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:1926 @ 99777ab) do not reproduce and a DERIVED class with no steps is a P-1 defect. What reproduces is one multiplication at the registered cell length: \(150\) steps per cell \(\times\ 0.034133\) s/step \(=5.11995\approx5.12\) s (DERIVED, one multiplication), where the \(150\)-step budget is the record's own registered cell length (READ scale/e_ladder.py:140, steps=150) and the \(0.034133\) s/step is \(5.12/150\) read back out of the source figure. The pair is therefore an unreproduced source figure with its class printed — \(\approx5.12\) s enters this book as READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:1926 @ 99777ab, unreproduced, on top of the same assumed basis — and book 06 reads it identically at 06.28. 04.9's \(\approx3.3\) GPU-min arena figure (\(98+8\times7.6+8\times5.12=199.8\) s) rests on the \(5.12\) and inherits that tag beside its own [ASSUMED] basis. The "ChaCAL must emit chance" control deleted (V-2). No price in this verse is [FITTED + RUN] for an arm that has no implementation, which is what the earlier [FITTED + RUN] on the ChaCAL cell was. Mechanism. V-24, V-3, M-13, R-SKY, D-1, P-10, V-2. Kill (K-E1) — registered UNREACHABLE, therefore not a kill. As written K-E1 reads: ChaCAL-with-sink within \(\mathrm{MDE}_N\) at the realised \(\sigma_d\) (04.9 clause 7; NOT MEASURED — needs $\sigma_d$ from 04.21 step (5)) of the shape's committor \(\varphi\)-NRMSE on \(\ge6\) of \(8\) seeds and its harmonic residual within \(2\times\) of the shape's, whereupon component (e) is a parameterisation of a column sink; instrument, the pair of 04.9 at \(\approx30.9\) s [ASSUMED] (\(2\times8\times1.680+4.0\), the pair arithmetic of the Evidence, which replaces the \(\approx52\) s three-arm figure this clause carried out of its own arm count); never "within TOST" at \(N=8\); planted negative, ChaCAL-published's \(A_s\) differing from the shape by \(O(1)\) at every \(\gamma>0\). It cannot fire on the bed as registered, because neither ChaCAL-with-sink nor ChaCAL-diag nor ChaCAL-published exists: \(0\) grep hits in the tree, \(0\) records under results/. Under the CHARTER's Reachability rule a kill that cannot fire is not a kill, so K-E1 is not in force, the verse carries no comparative sentence, and the chain below carries the verse. K-E1 becomes decidable only when at least ChaCAL-diag and ChaCAL-with-sink are FOUND under their own kind; the price of reaching it is link 2's, not \(\approx30.9\) s. If killed — link 1 (operative today): the same question asked of the operator, with no arm at all. The claim "boundary rows are not a column device" is decided on the environment chain the bed already builds, never on a trained arm: for each admitted draw of 04.2, solve the absorbing read \(\Pi_{\rm row}\) — \(\mathcal A\) as identity rows, \(q^{(k)}=(I-Q)^{-1}R_k\mathbb 1\) — and the column read \(\Pi_{\rm col}\) — \(\mathcal A\)'s rows left transient and a value-zero sink column appended in the record's own V15Fork.Asink form — both in float64 on the same \(P_{\rm env}\), and print \(\|\Pi_{\rm row}-\Pi_{\rm col}\|_\infty\) over the transient block per draw. This is a different object (the environment chain, not an arm), a different instrument (one dense exact solve pair on the bed's generator, no training, no seeds, no matched parameters) and a different number (an operator \(\infty\)-distance, not a \(\varphi\)-NRMSE difference against \(\mathrm{MDE}_N\)) — it is not a rename of K-E1 and does not die with it, and its own threshold \(10^{-12}\) is a float-noise constant of the exact solve, not a placeholder waiting on \(\sigma_d\). Hypotheses: \(\rho(Q_{\rm env})<1\) so both reads exist (04.2 gives \(\rho(Q_{\rm env})=0\) exactly, DERIVED); the sink column carries value \(0\) on every indicator channel, which is the record's own device; the comparison is over the transient block only, where both reads are defined. Evidence: the record's value-zero column sink V15Fork.Asink (READ lean/CEQ/V15Fork.lean:67-70) is the column device this link instantiates; the row device's downstream weight statement reads \(\|\Pi_{\rm shape}-\Pi_{\rm ChaCAL\text{-}diag}\|_\infty\ge0.1\) with rows changed \(=[3]\) on the bind B-E1 instance (READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md §6 A.8, 04.13); the two-read comparison itself is NOT MEASURED — needs the two-solve column added to the admission census of 04.2, $0$ GPU-s, no arm and no make_arm branch. Kill: \(\|\Pi_{\rm row}-\Pi_{\rm col}\|_\infty<10^{-12}\) over the transient block on \(\ge95\) per cent of the \(512\) admission draws — the row condition is a column device at the level of the operator, K-E1 is settled in the counter's favour with no arm ever trained, component (e) is struck, and every bed of this book loses its mechanism sentence. Planted negative: a draw built with \(\mathcal A=\emptyset\) must read \(\|\Pi_{\rm row}-\Pi_{\rm col}\|_\infty=0\) bitwise, since with no absorbing row the two constructions are the same matrix — a known-identical plant on which the detector must fire, which is the V-15 control the arena kill never had. Price \(0\) GPU-s, \(0.5\) evening — strictly cheaper than the verse's own unreachable kill and than link 2. If killed — link 2: the FOUND route back, priced as 04.14 prices W2. If the operator read cannot separate or cannot be run, the only route to a comparative sentence is implementation: one make_arm branch per control, an optimizer path and a field emit, on the arm_pl basis of 04.14 (\(5.114\) s per cell, \(41\)–\(130\) GPU-s per branch), taken for ChaCAL-diag and ChaCAL-with-sink first because K-E1 needs exactly those two. Hypotheses: the branch emits its own kind and manifest_hash (04.15), so the census of 04.14 can see it. Evidence: the W2 route and its price READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md §4.4; the two-way calibration of the census (04.14); \(0\) grep hits for chacal today (RUN this session). Kill: after the route is taken the census still reads \(0\) for chacal_with_sink — the branch was written and never run (D-6), the control is permanently NAMED, K-E1 is never decidable on any bed, and component (e) carries no comparative credit ever. Price \(82\)–\(260\) GPU-s for the two branches, \(2\) evenings — not cheaper than link 1, and admitted only on being strictly more decisive: it settles FOUND-ness permanently where link 1 settles one operator distance. Terminal. "No control arm of this roster is FOUND except the depth-1 softmax: the tree holds \(0\) ChaCAL and \(0\) InfSA source lines and \(24\) record kinds, none of them a control of this verse. The canon licenses the roster as a specification with its prices marked [ASSUMED], and licenses K-E1 as the point estimate under D-CALIB with no cell behind it." Withdrawn: every sentence comparing the shape to ChaCAL-diag, ChaCAL-published, ChaCAL-with-sink, InfSA-Neumann-\(16\), the cached mixture, the argmin controls or any skyline; component (e) as a mechanism; and every price in this book that was quoted [FITTED + RUN] for an unimplemented arm.

docs.title: 04.12 — The ChaCAL convention check (B22)
docs.text: Statement. Two control arms of 04.11 depend on one bibliographic fact — whether ChaCAL removes the diagonal inside the inverse — that rests on one HTML fetch. The check is decided by the operator, not by the citation: the arm named ChaCAL-published computes \((1-\gamma)A(I-\gamma A_s)^{-1}V\) with \(A_s=A-\mathrm{diag}(A)\) and must read sub-stochastic row sums; the arm named ChaCAL-diag keeps the diagonal and must read row sums \(1.000\); the manifest field diag_convention ∈ {kept, removed} names which is which on every cell, and the attribution "published" is a label on the manifest, never on the arithmetic. Before typesetting, the sentence is re-read from the arXiv LaTeX source of 2410.05565, never from a rendered page. Hypotheses. \(\gamma>0\); \(A\) a causal softmax at \(\beta=1\) so \(A_s\) is strictly lower and \((I-\gamma A_s)^{-1}\) is a finite sum; \(A_s\mathbb 1=\mathbb 1-\mathrm{diag}(A)<\mathbb 1\). Evidence.
