docs.title: 06.10 — The static-task kill (K-H2)
docs.text: Statement. The kill is read on McNemar at the eval draw count, never on a seed-level equivalence at \(N=8\). Prediction: the 0-hop per-position MLP's paired argmin accuracy is below the shape's by more than \(\mathrm{MDE}_{\rm McN}\), and McNemar on identical draws against the 1-hop softmax reads \(p\le0.05\). Counter: the gap is at or below \(\mathrm{MDE}_{\rm McN}\), or \(p>0.05\) — BED-S is a third static task and every capability sentence on it is struck before a number is quoted. No SPLIT. Deciding numbers: the paired accuracy gap against \(\mathrm{MDE}_{\rm McN}\) and the McNemar \(p\) (S-26). \(\mathrm{MDE}_{\rm McN}\) is fixed here: on \(n_{\rm eval}=4096\) paired draws, McNemar's normal form rejects at \(\lvert b-c\rvert/\sqrt{b+c}>1.96\) and reaches power \(0.80\) at \(\lvert b-c\rvert/\sqrt{b+c}\ge1.96+0.8416=2.8016\), so the minimum detectable accuracy difference is \(\mathrm{MDE}_{\rm McN}=2.8016\sqrt{d/4096}=0.04378\sqrt d\) with \(d\) the realised discordant-pair fraction — \(0.01384\) at \(d=0.10\) and \(0.03095\) at \(d=0.50\) (DERIVED). A non-rejection therefore carries a detectable-effect size and may fire tree C; a non-rejection with no printed \(\mathrm{MDE}_{\rm McN}\) may not. Hypotheses. Matched at the recounted parameter count: \(4{,}769\) is the pre-head count of READ CEQ_V20_R15_CONTRACT.md:119 @ 99777ab, and the post-head count with the \([m,K+2]\) readout attached is NOT MEASURED — needs book 04's recount (READ docs/PLAN.md:314 @ 99777ab: "recounted, never assumed"). Ruling 3's \(0.032\) per cent is not the tolerance at this scale: it was set on the LM pair \(25{,}736{,}232\) against \(25{,}728{,}000\), a residual of \(8{,}232\) parameters, and \(0.032\% \times 4{,}769 = 1.53\) parameters, which no integer \(d_{\rm model}\) reaches (06.20). The match is stated as an absolute parameter gap with both integers printed, or the row says NOT MEASURED. Byte-identical draws; the identity half (oracle argmin equals label argmin on \(100\%\)) declared V-3. The seed-level two-one-sided reading is not run at \(N=8\): at a \(0.5\) margin the two-sample half-width is \(0.8807\sigma\) and the paired half-width \(t_{.95,7}/\sqrt8=1.894579/2.828427=0.669835\,\mathrm{sd}_d\) (both DERIVED, READ MISTAKES.md:1216-1219 @ 99777ab for the two-sample figure, whose own sentence names it two-sample; 06.24 prints the pair of numbers with each design named), so the interval is wider than the window at either design; the two-sample form first drops below \(0.5\) at \(N=23\) and reaches power \(0.80\) at \(N=70\) (same source), and the paired form at \(N=13\) and \(N=36\) respectively (06.24). No non-rejection at \(N=8\) seeds may fire tree C (M-13). Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:501-507 (S-26), :941 (R-06); the C8 correction of the journal (git show 99777ab:V20_R15_JOURNAL.md, the "static task" row). Mechanism. C8, V-10, V-24, V-3 (MISTAKES.md:72). Kill. The prediction dies at a gap \(\le\mathrm{MDE}_{\rm McN}\) or \(p>0.05\); the counter at a gap \(>\mathrm{MDE}_{\rm McN}\) with \(p\le0.05\); \(\approx0.5\) GPU-min (two control arms at \(\le1.524\) s per cell, eight seeds each), \(1\) evening. Planted negative: the 0-hop MLP on a bed whose label is a flag lookup (the R-24 plant of 06.9) must read a gap below \(\mathrm{MDE}_{\rm McN}\) with \(p>0.05\) and fire the kill; on a \(t^\star=8\) label with the flags removed it must read at the exact zero-information floor \(0.875\) error with \(p\le0.05\); both \(\mathrm{MDE}_{\rm McN}\) and the realised \(d\) are printed with each. If killed (the counter). Tree C's sentence with the cause named: "BED-S at the design point is decidable at zero hops by a per-position MLP; the bed is registered with its floors and no capability number." The replacement bed is book 04's joint-consistency bed outside the per-row class, whose label is the full vector on \(T\) and whose 0-hop control is the per-position MLP on the vector — Hypotheses: a vector label voids the per-row shortcut only if the harmonic residual of the per-row read is \(O(1)\); Evidence: READ MATHEMATICS.md:106-127 (the untested joint-determination claim); Kill: the per-row MLP's residual within \(2\times\) the shape's (06.21's counter) — decided inside one pair, \(\approx34\) s, more decisive than the accuracy comparison because it reads the mechanism, not a rate. Terminal. No capability sentence on any per-row-decidable bed; the canon licenses the identities and the controls.

docs.title: 06.11 — The Lean set (Bet K)
docs.text:
Statement. The prediction is filed on the seven admissible bare-[M] targets of docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md §A.8.2 — the bare-[M] rows that carry no depends on entry — and not on ten, and not on the eight this verse counted at its previous writing. The section's own heading is the rule: "A.8.2 Lean targets, restated (P0.1; grades [M]/[S]/[D]; every [M] resting on a [U] Mathlib name is [S] until lake build is green — P-11)" (READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:2600 @ 99777ab). Under that rule any prediction filed over a set containing a [U]-dependent row is refuted at its own Evidence pin before a build runs, and its counter is satisfied by construction (P-11: a contract may not cite its own [M]-tagged theorem as settled; V-10: a gate whose outcome is fixed by construction; L-LEAN).

The denominator, recounted from the source, is nine and not eight. The section carries nine bare-[M] rows: gamma_zero_is_softmax (:2604), bos_row_is_absorbing (:2605), later_boundary_unreachable (:2606), softmax_corner_not_nilpotent (:2607), cut_makes_segment_head_absorbing (:2610), displacement_identity (:2611), committor_is_resolvent_read (a) (:2618), (b-causal) isUnit_one_sub_transient_causal (:2619), lowerTriangular_ne_symmSupport (:2622), all READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md @ 99777ab. (a) and (b-causal) are two declarations, not one target: they are separate rows with different statements — (a) q = Q*ᵥq + r, IsUnit (1 − Q) ⇒ q = (1−Q)⁻¹ *ᵥ r; (b-causal) for lower-triangular Q with Q i i < 1 on T, IsUnit (1 − Q) — different depends on entries (none; lower_triangular_isUnit) and different shipped refusals (none; bos_undeclared_singular). Merging them is what produced the count of eight, and it is corrected here.

Two of the nine are [U]-blocked by the heading's own rule, so the admissible set is seven. The depends on column reads lower_triangular_isUnit for :2606 later_boundary_unreachable and for :2619 (b-causal), and lower_triangular_isUnit, diag_one_sub_smul_pos is itself graded "[M]→[S] until Matrix.det_of_lowerTriangular [U] is confirmed" (:2608). The seven that carry no depends on entry are gamma_zero_is_softmax, bos_row_is_absorbing, softmax_corner_not_nilpotent, cut_makes_segment_head_absorbing, displacement_identity, committor_is_resolvent_read (a), and lowerTriangular_ne_symmSupport.

Prediction: those seven elaborate under lake build with exit \(0\), zero sorry, zero sorryAx, and the axiom set \(\{\)propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound\(\}\) only: \(7/7\). Counter: at most \(6/7\). The four [U]-blocked rows are carried separately and are never cited as proved: the two bare-[M] rows blocked through their dependency, later_boundary_unreachable (:2606) and (b-causal) isUnit_one_sub_transient_causal (:2619); and the two rows the source itself grades conditionally, lower_triangular_isUnit, diag_one_sub_smul_pos (:2608, blocked on Matrix.det_of_lowerTriangular [U]) and resolvent_fromBlocks, segmentation_blockdiag (:2609, blocked on inv_fromBlocks_zero₂₁_of_isUnit_iff [U]). The counter's point estimate is therefore \(7/9\) on the nine bare-[M] rows and \(7/11\) on the eleven rows the section grades [M] or [M]→[S], with all four blocked names listed — never \(8/10\) with two, and never \(8/8\) on a set of eight, both of which this verse printed before and both of which name a denominator the source does not have (L-SIGN: a counter that names fewer blocked rows than the source demotes is not of equal specificity). No SPLIT. Deciding number: the green count out of the seven admissible bare-[M] targets (J-L18), with the four blocked rows' status printed beside it. Hypotheses. Lean leanprover/lean4:v4.7.0 as the record's toolchain; the census file gives per theorem the fraction of the corpus satisfying its hypotheses, and a \(0\%\) line demotes the theorem to decoration on that bed (L-DOM); a [U]-blocked row becomes scorable in the seven only when its Mathlib name is confirmed, which is a separate row, filed then and not now; "admissible" is decided by one column of one table — a bare-[M] grade and an empty depends on cell at :2604-2622 — so the denominator is read, never chosen. Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:228-235 @ 99777ab (J-L18); :1007-1033 (§5.8); READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:2600 @ 99777ab (the heading's [U]-demotion rule, quoted above), :2604-2626 @ 99777ab (the target list with grades and the depends on column: nine bare [M], two [M]→[S], and the two lower_triangular_isUnit dependencies at :2606 and :2619); the record's 169 theorems over 12 files at READ docs/PLAN.md:231 @ 99777ab (the *measure* line; the pin :232 this verse carried at filing is J-L18's PASS/KILL line and is corrected here, P-6). Mechanism. P-11 (MISTAKES.md:1597), L-LEAN, L-DOM, V-25 (:1954), V-10, V-9 (the count of eight was the count of ten renamed, and is struck here rather than moved again). Kill. The prediction dies at any of the seven admissible bare-[M] targets not building; the counter at \(7/7\); \(0\) GPU-s (CPU minutes), \(1\) evening. Planted negative: a target with a deliberately wrong hypothesis (\(\gamma=\tfrac12\) in gamma_zero_is_softmax) must fail to elaborate, and gamma_half_is_not_softmax must build as its refusal — the gate reads red on the wrong statement and green on its negation. Second planted negative, for the denominator itself: later_boundary_unreachable must be absent from the seven the harness builds, and a harness that builds it and reports \(8/8\) must be refused at the depends on column, so the admissible set is known to be read from the table rather than asserted. If killed (the counter). The demoted row carries [S] with its numeric instance (RUN[coord] \(1.7763568394002505\times10^{-15}\) for the solve, \(0.0\) for corner 3), the "machine-checked" sentence of component (k) is narrowed to the rows that build, and — L-LEAN — no arm trains until parity and the unit are green. Hypotheses: parity carries no depends on entry (:2604), and the unit's greenness is gated on one Mathlib confirmation, filed as its own row. Evidence: READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:2604, :2608 @ 99777ab. Kill of the replacement: parity red, or Matrix.det_of_lowerTriangular not confirmed after the search — decided by the same build plus one grep of Mathlib, and then S-20 is blocked and every arena row is VOID (not COUNTER) for one evening per repair. docs.title: 06.12 — The \(\gamma\) instrument's own plants (S-61)
docs.text: Statement. Prediction: the likelihood-ratio instrument reads PINNED on \(8/8\) synthetic seeds at \(\gamma_{\rm env}=0\) and MOVED on \(8/8\) at \(\gamma_{\rm env}=0.6\), under the boundary null \(\tfrac12\chi^2_0+\tfrac12\chi^2_1\) with 95 per cent point \(2.705543\), MOVED at \(\Lambda>\ln4096=8.318\). Counter: either count below \(8/8\) — the instrument cannot decide Bet C, and row C-12 is VOID until repaired. No SPLIT. Deciding number: the two plant counts. Hypotheses. \(\gamma\) trained on \([0,1)\) so \(\gamma=0\) is a boundary; the held-out set \(n_{\rm eval}=4096\) declared before training; the \(|\hat\gamma|<0.05\) rule deleted (M-20). Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:327-334 (S-61); the quantile RUN[J], RUN[MARS], RUN[MERCURY] at :329; the citation for the boundary null is owed, and the search that shows it is printed in full so a reader can repeat it. RUN this session, exact commands and their outputs: grep -c 'chernoff' docs/references.bib reads \(0\); grep -c 'self-liang' docs/references.bib reads \(0\); the widened grep -niEc 'chernoff|self.?liang|chibar|chi-bar' docs/references.bib reads \(0\). The two candidate keys searched are the key strings chernoff-1954-boundary and self-liang-1987-boundary, and neither exists in the bibliography. The theorem is named here so a reader can supply the reference without guessing what is missing: the asymptotic null distribution of the likelihood-ratio statistic when the tested parameter lies on the boundary of the parameter space is the half–half mixture \(\tfrac12\chi^2_0+\tfrac12\chi^2_1\), whose \(95\) per cent point is \(2.705543\) — the result the record attributes to no source, classically Chernoff (1954) and Self and Liang (1987, boundary case 5), both NOT FOUND at [V-eq] in this tree. What the absence blocks, named: the PINNED half of every \(\gamma\) verdict — \(\Lambda\le2.705543\) in this verse, in 06.16 (Bet C's counter) and in 06.35 — because the threshold is the mixture's quantile and nothing else in the tree derives it; the PINNED plant count of this verse's own \(8/8\) at \(\gamma_{\rm env}=0\) rests on it as well. It does not block the MOVED threshold: \(\ln 4096=8.317766\) is read off the declared held-out set size \(n_{\rm eval}=4096\) and stands without the null. Until the reference is supplied at [V-eq] with its hypotheses and one numeric instance, the PINNED threshold carries the class NOT FOUND at [V-eq] — the boundary-null quantile is owed (L-EQ, P-10), and a PINNED verdict quoted without that class is refused at the journal. Mechanism. Ruling 10′, V-9, M-2, M-20, V-24, V-17. Kill. The prediction dies at either plant below \(8/8\); the counter at both \(8/8\); seconds, \(1\) evening. The plants are the planted negative and positive: a \(\gamma_{\rm env}=0\) generator must not be read MOVED, a \(0.6\) generator must not be read PINNED. If killed (the counter). The replacement instrument is the ablation alone — \((I-\hat\gamma\hat P)^{-1}\to I\) at trained weights, MOVED iff NRMSE moves by more than one seed sd — with Hypotheses (seed sd from the same lane), Evidence (READ docs/PLAN.md:697) and Kill (the ablation on the \(\gamma_{\rm env}=0\) plant reading a move above one seed sd — decided at \(\le17.4\) s, cheaper than the LR plants because it needs no held-out likelihood). Terminal. Bet C is VOID; the horizon dial is a definition (Proposition 9) and no pinning sentence is written.

docs.title: 06.13 — Parity, the price band and strict mode (S-20)
docs.text:
Statement. Prediction: torch.equal(O(0), PV) reads True against the lane's own softmax routine (ceq/lm.py:5, :66), the four plants read \(O(1)\) (\(\gamma=0.5\): \(2.3002850040264393\) at \(s=64\); \(\beta=0\): gap \(>0.5\); ChaCAL-published's \(A_s\): \(O(1)\) at every \(\gamma>0\); a dense non-triangular \(M\): disagrees with the dense inverse), the ChaCAL-diag cell at \(\gamma=0.9\) lands inside \([-1.8,+14.4]\) per cent of the DERIVED \(1.71990\) s shape cell (06.28), and the forward repeats bitwise over 8 repeats under use_deterministic_algorithms(True). Counter, in two named branches that together with the prediction band and the SPLIT band exhaust \([0,\infty)\): COUNTER-dear, the cell at or above \(2.2\times\) the DERIVED cell (\(\ge3.78378\) s; the dispatch gap of \(2.0\times\)–\(6.6\times\) realised as the cell), or the strict-mode forward not bitwise, signed +; COUNTER-cheap, the cell below \(0.982\times\) the DERIVED cell (\(<1.68894\) s), signed −. SPLIT: the cell in \((1.144,2.2)\times\) the DERIVED cell, \((1.96757,3.78378)\) s, with the identity and the plants passing. Deciding numbers: torch.equal; the cell wall-clock over the DERIVED \(1.71990\) s; the strict-mode forward repeat.

The band's centre is the re-tagged cell, not \(1.680\) s. The \(1.680\) s per shape cell of READ docs/PLAN.md:594-600 @ 99777ab carries the [FITTED + RUN] tag 06.28 strikes, and \(1.680/150=0.011200\) s is the superseded step \(0.011206\) s to five places, so a band centred on it is a band centred on the struck constant under the struck tag (M-8, P-3, M-2). The centre is therefore the DERIVED \(150\times0.011466=1.71990\) s (06.28), and every endpoint below is recomputed from it.

The fourth branch, and why the partition had a hole without it. The prediction band is \([-1.8,+14.4]\) per cent of \(1.71990\) s, i.e. a multiplier in \([0.982,1.144]\) and an interval \([1.68894,1.96757]\) s; the SPLIT band is \((1.144,2.2)\), i.e. \((1.96757,3.78378)\) s; the counter as filed began at \(2.2\). The interval \([0,0.982)\) — a cell cheaper than the DERIVED cell by more than \(1.8\) per cent — therefore fell in no branch, and 06.36's own Kill declares the tree refuted when "a scored outcome has no branch" (M-7, a pre-registration with a hole; D-7; M-20). The same hole stood in 06.28 and in rows C-9 and C-24 of 06.3. It is closed here in the direction the canon most wants, so the optimistic outcome carries a verdict rather than escaping one: a cell below \(0.982\times\) the DERIVED cell (\(<1.68894\) s, frozen here) is COUNTER-cheap, scored COUNTER, and its sentence is "the DERIVED cell over-predicts the measurement by \([\cdot]\) per cent; every price in this book is re-derived from N-02's producer before any GPU-minute is quoted, with the sign of the miss printed — the derivation was too dear, not too cheap."

The signs of the two counter branches are corrected here, and they run the other way from the previous writing. 06.1 defines the sign of a miss against the project — + credits the project more than the measurement supports (READ V16_CALIBRATION.md:24-31) — and the object scored is the claim, not the outcome. A cell dearer than the claim means the claim was too cheap and credited the project more than the measurement supports: COUNTER-dear is +. A cell cheaper than the claim means the claim was too dear and credited the project less: COUNTER-cheap is −. The parenthesis printed before — "a cell cheaper than the law flatters every price in this book" — scored the outcome rather than the claim and is deleted; it inverted both signs, and because C-9 and C-24 both sit in 06.4's tree-C pool the inversion moved up to two of the eight signs the eighth-row test reads, in the direction that inflates the + count. The re-tag COUNTER-cheap triggers is the same one COUNTER-dear triggers, and the two branches differ only in the sign the column records.

The backward half is removed from this verse's prediction, and why. The verse as filed predicted solve_triangular bitwise forward and backward under use_deterministic_algorithms(True) and cited the device certificate for it. The certificate does not carry that: it records the gradient bitwise with the determinism flag off and the gradient not executable with the flag on, on an arm that is not the one the sentence names. results/k_cert_local.json (arm arm_smprime, git ab5b485) reads determinism.flag_off.gradient \(=\{\)bitwise: true, max_abs: 0.0, repeats: 8\(\}\) and determinism.flag_on.gradient \(=\{\)executable: false, error: "RuntimeError: cumsum_cuda_kernel does not have a deterministic implementation"\(\}\), with the file's own note that arm_smprime reduces with CUMPROD and cumsum is measured only as the contrast. Citing flag_off for a flag_on claim is V-16, an instrument that cannot measure reporting a pass. The strict-mode backward is therefore not predicted here; it is 06.34's cell on the re-certified stack, and the record's own sentence for it — "solve_triangular ran bitwise forward and backward over 8 repeats under strict mode on this card with no torch-documented guarantee" (READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:2680 @ 99777ab, RUN[NEPTUNE]) — is an undocumented single-producer reading, which is exactly B13, and is filed as NOT MEASURED — needs N-01 on the re-certified stack (06.34). Hypotheses. The cuBLAS workspace exported before process start; synchronize() bracketing; BED-M e3_t2 as the host; no capability number is read (BED-M is contained, D-2). Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:459-465; RUN[coord] at docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:356-360; the determinism block split by flag, READ results/k_cert_local.json (arm arm_smprime, git ab5b485, \(n=512\), reduction length \(64\)): flag_off.forward, .hop and .gradient all bitwise: true, max_abs: 0.0, repeats: 8 — flag off; flag_on.forward and .hop bitwise: true, max_abs: 0.0, repeats: 8, and flag_on.gradient executable: false with error: "RuntimeError: cumsum_cuda_kernel does not have a deterministic implementation" — so the strict-mode forward claim of this verse is cited at flag_on.forward and the strict-mode backward is cited nowhere, because it does not execute for this arm; the record's solve_triangular strict-mode forward-and-backward sentence is pinned to its own producer, READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:2680 @ 99777ab (RUN[NEPTUNE], undocumented, B13), and is not used as evidence here; the re-certified value NOT MEASURED — needs N-01 (06.34); the \(2.2\times\) is the record's own re-tagging threshold (READ docs/PLAN.md:463). Mechanism. V-24, V-3, M-8 (MISTAKES.md:544), P-8 (:387), V-16 (:828), D-2. Kill. The prediction dies at torch.equal False, any plant passing, the cell \(\ge2.2\times\) (COUNTER-dear, frozen here at \(\ge3.78378\) s), the cell \(<0.982\times\) (COUNTER-cheap, frozen here at \(<1.68894\) s), or the strict-mode forward reading max_abs > 0 over 8 repeats; the counter at all four passing inside the band. A strict-mode backward raise does not decide this verse — it is the expected reading for a cumsum/cumprod reduction and is 06.34's number on the re-certified stack; \(\approx1.72\) s for one cell and \(\approx17.76\) s for eight seeds (DERIVED, \(8\times1.71990+4.0\) fixed, re-derived from 06.28's re-tag; the \(\approx1.7\) s and \(\approx17.4\) s printed before were \(1.680\) s per cell and carried the struck tag), \(1\) evening. Planted negative: the struck plant — a non-causal \(W\) — must pass at \(\gamma=0\) (\(I-0\cdot W=I\)) and is recorded as struck, so the battery is known to contain one plant that cannot fire and does not count it. If killed (the counter). Two routes by cause. Cell out of band: every [FITTED + RUN] price in this book is re-tagged the P-8 floor it was declared to be and re-measured by N-02's producer before any GPU-minute is quoted; the T1 ranges of 06.29 and 06.30 carry the measured per-step ratio in place of the DERIVED \(1.1280\) (06.28). Strict-mode forward not bitwise: Ruling 1's warn_only=True lane runs, the sentence "the first gated wing whose training step runs strict" is deleted — it rested on docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:2680's single undocumented producer, not on the certificate — and every deciding forward cell is bitwise by replay in one lane or the cell is refused. Hypotheses: the forward is bitwise regardless (observed true at results/k_cert_local.json). Evidence: READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:2970-2975. Kill of the replacement: the forward not bitwise over 8 repeats on the re-certified stack — 06.34's cell, seconds, more decisive because it is bitwise or not. Terminal. The containment sentence survives only as the Lean row (gamma_zero_is_softmax [M]); every price is a band; no determinism sentence about training.

docs.title: 06.14 — The capped seeds (Bet I)
docs.text: Statement. Prediction: arm_pl on e3_t2 at the three NO-READING seeds 2, 3, 7 (\(1.152430\), \(1.113403\), \(1.139404\) eval NRMSE uncapped; \(\hat a_{\max}\) \(20.3090\), \(49.6613\), \(285.0719\)) with the magnitude capped at \(1.0\) crosses the one-hop threshold \(0.7071067811865476\) on \(3/3\): divergence was the cause. Counter: at most \(1/3\) crosses — the split is not the cap's and the mechanism stays unresolved, the Q3/W3 cell TERMINAL as graded. SPLIT: \(2/3\). Deciding number: the crossing count. Hypotheses. Same thread lane and flag regime as the retake journal; synchronize() bracketing; randomised order; the threshold is a capability threshold and never a floor — \(13\) of \(40\) banked cells sit below it (C15, READ docs/PLAN.md:644 @ 99777ab — the M-3.7 line that prints the one-hop threshold and the 13 of 40; the pin :950 this verse carried at filing names the R-16/K-D2 row and is corrected here, P-6). Evidence. git show 99777ab:V15_R1.md:177-188 (the seed table; seeds 0, 1, 4, 5, 6 crossed at \(0.634002\)–\(0.662021\)); READ workdonenewseal.md:143-147; READ docs/PLAN.md:522-528 (S-52). Mechanism. M-6 (MISTAKES.md:518), D-6 (:1050), P-3, C17. Kill. The prediction dies at \(\le2/3\); the counter at \(\ge2/3\); \(\approx9.65\) s (\(3\times1.884+4.0\)), \(0.5\) evening. Planted negative: seed 0 re-run under the cap must still cross (the cap is inert where \(\hat a_{\max}=1.4107\)), so a cap that changed the crossing seeds would be detected. If killed (the counter). The account of R1 keeps "3 of 8 NO READING, mechanism unresolved" and the canon's book 02 verse on divergence under the corner descent (B12) loses its cheapest evidence and stands on the \(\hat\gamma\) trajectory alone. Hypotheses: the R1 seeds are a different arm (arm_pl) from the shape. Evidence: the three uncapped rows. Kill of the replacement: none needed — a stale question dies cheaply either way and the shape's sentences are untouched (READ docs/PLAN.md:527). Terminal. The record's negatives section carries the three seeds with both readings; no sentence about divergence as a cause.

docs.title: III. The arena
06.15 — Identification, not copy (K-D2; B5)
docs.text:
Statement. Prediction: \(\|\hat P-P_{\rm env}\|_\infty\in[10^{-3},10^{-2})\) on at least 6 of 8 seeds — the trained arm identifies the environment chain without copying it, the first trained CEQ arm the record holds (B5). Counter: \(\ge10^{-2}\) on at least 6 of 8 — the arm did not learn the chain at 150 steps and every capability reading on BED-S is a learnability negative. VOID (not SPLIT): \(<10^{-3}\) on at least 6 of 8 — the arm copied the environment and every contrast is a copy-versus-no-copy statement, filed as identification only.

The scoring rule is the modal band with its count, because "at least 6 of 8" on three bands is not a partition. Three bands each requiring \(\ge6/8\) leaves reachable seed splits with no token and lets one clause name two bands at once: the split \((3,3,2)\) — three seeds identified, three counter, two VOID — reaches \(6/8\) in no band and would have been scored by none, while \((5,3,0)\) and \((3,5,0)\) each sit in the filed SPLIT window "\(3/8\) to \(5/8\)" for two bands simultaneously (M-7, a pre-registration with a hole; D-7; M-9). The rule frozen here: the eight per-seed sup-norms are binned into the three bands, the modal band and its count are printed, and the token is the modal band's — HOLDS if the modal band is \([10^{-3},10^{-2})\) at a count \(\ge6/8\), COUNTER if the modal band is \(\ge10^{-2}\) at \(\ge6/8\), VOID if the modal band is \(<10^{-3}\) at \(\ge6/8\). Every other configuration is SPLIT, including every tie for the mode, and a SPLIT row prints all three counts as an ordered triple \((\,\text{identified},\text{counter},\text{VOID}\,)\) so the reading is recoverable from the row. Exactly one token is reachable per outcome, and the eight seeds always produce one: \((3,3,2)\) is SPLIT with its triple printed, \((5,3,0)\) is SPLIT, \((6,2,0)\) is HOLDS. This is row C-11 of 06.3 as it stands, and verse and column now say the same thing. Deciding number: the per-seed sup-norm, sorted, from S-62, binned as above with the modal count printed. Hypotheses. Adjacency rows as multi-hot node features so \(\hat P=P_{\rm env}\) is representable at \(d_{\rm model}\ge n_{\rm nodes}\); the DAG substrate, on which the D-2 separation holds (lowerTriangular_ne_symmSupport); the VOID-contrast list in every cell's manifest. Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:371-379 (S-13), :626-633 @ 99777ab (S-62, whose KILL line is K-P and whose measure block carries the K-D2 statistic; the pin :640-645 this verse carried at filing names the S-51 tail and S-50 and is corrected here, P-6); READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:1191-1197 (the FOUND-not-NAMED census, arm_phase \(0\)); RUN this session, grep -rhoE '"kind": *"[A-Za-z0-9_]+"' results --include='*.jsonl' | sort | uniq -c reads arm_smprime 425, arm_pl 422, softmax 227, arm_phase absent — no record with the shape's kind exists, so the shape is NAMED today and becomes FOUND at the first S-62 row. Mechanism. D-2 (MISTAKES.md:710), M-7 (:529), V-10, FOUND-not-NAMED. Kill. The prediction dies at a modal band of \(\ge10^{-2}\) on \(\ge6/8\), at a modal band of \(<10^{-3}\) on \(\ge6/8\), or at no band reaching \(6/8\) (SPLIT, scored wrong with the sign of the optimistic half by 06.1); the counter at the identified band modal on \(\ge6/8\); inside the arena's \(\approx98\) s, \(1\) evening. Planted negative: an arm initialised at \(\hat P=P_{\rm env}\) (the copy plant) must read \(<10^{-3}\) on \(8/8\) and be filed VOID; an arm with \(d_{\rm model}<n_{\rm nodes}\) must read \(\ge10^{-2}\) on \(8/8\), so the band has a floor and a ceiling that both fire. If killed (the counter). The sentence: "At 150 steps the arm reads \(\|\hat P-P_{\rm env}\|_\infty=[x]\) on \([k]\) of 8 seeds; no BED-S number is a capability number; the reading is filed as learnability." The replacement route is the ladder (06.27) on the identification metric alone — Hypotheses: the metric is monotone in steps; Evidence: READ docs/PLAN.md:775-780; Kill: \(\ge10^{-2}\) at step \(9{,}600\) on \(\ge6/8\), decided at \(32\)–\(36\) min per pair, more decisive because it exhausts the budget the record ever spent on one pair. Terminal. B5 is closed by the row's existence: a FOUND record with the shape's kind, its manifest and its sup-norm; the canon licenses "trained and not identified" and withdraws every capability contrast on BED-S.

docs.title: 06.16 — The horizon dial (Bet C)
docs.text: Statement. Prediction: \(\hat\gamma\) MOVED (\(\Lambda>8.318\)) on at least 6 of 8 seeds and the ablation \((I-\hat\gamma\hat P)^{-1}\to I\) moves NRMSE by more than one seed sd. Counter: PINNED (\(\Lambda\le2.7055\)) on at least 6 of 8 — softmax wearing a name on this bed; the corner descent of B12 realised. SPLIT: \(3/8\) to \(5/8\) MOVED, or interval verdicts. Mirror kill: \(\hat\gamma>0.99\) on at least 6 of 8 prints \(1/(1-\hat\gamma)>100\) beside every \(\delta\) and the certificate is vacuous on the \(z\)/\(\Delta z\) channel. Deciding number: \(\Lambda\) per seed on the declared held-out set (R-21). Hypotheses. 06.12's plants both \(8/8\); \(\gamma\in[0,1)\) one learnable scalar per head; the committor head reads at \(\gamma=1\) on \(\hat Q\) and is untouched by the verdict. Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:914 (Bet C), :694-699 (R-21), :1056-1058 (tree B's "PINNED on at least 6 of 8"); the record's precedent — no \(\gamma\) beat \(0\) on the hop-2 sweep, \(4/4\) blind predictions held (READ docs/sources/design/design_falsify.md:392); R1's \(\hat a_{\max}\) up to \(285.0719\) on 3 of 8 seeds (06.14). Mechanism. Ruling 10′, V-9, M-20, V-17, B12. Kill. The prediction dies at PINNED on \(\ge6/8\) or the ablation moving less than one seed sd; the counter at MOVED on \(\ge6/8\) with the ablation moving more; \(0\) GPU-s (a journal read) plus the ablation \(\le17.4\) s, \(1\) evening. Planted negative: 06.12's \(\gamma_{\rm env}=0\) generator inside the arena harness must read PINNED \(8/8\). If killed (the counter). The horizon-dial sentence retires to a definition; ChaCAL-with-sink at \(\hat\gamma=0\) is softmax, so 06.22 and 06.24 are VOID; the LM claim of 06.35 is retired before it is made; regime N at \(\gamma=1\) (corner 3, exact without a dial) and the constant-value plant are kept. The replacement is book 02's pre-written fixed-\(\gamma\) regime: \(\gamma\) frozen at the bed constant \(\gamma_{\rm env}\) for the \(z\)/\(\Delta z\) channel and the committor head at \(\gamma=1\), so the read is exact without descent — Hypotheses: \(\gamma_{\rm env}\) registered before training (M-2); Evidence: READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:336-342 (Definition 7's discounted read at a bed constant); Kill: at fixed \(\gamma_{\rm env}=0.6\) the paired \(\varphi\)-NRMSE against ChaCAL-diag at the same fixed \(\gamma\) is within \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\) (the dial did nothing that the fixed value does not) — decided inside one pair, \(\approx34\) s, more decisive because no likelihood is involved. Terminal. \(\gamma\) is a bed-side dial; the equilibrium sentence is withdrawn; the exact solve at \(\gamma=1\) on the transient block is the only read the canon licenses as "next state toward equilibrium".

docs.title: 06.17 — The consequence field (Bet A)
docs.text: Statement. Prediction: \(\cos_{\rm shape}-\cos_{\rm softmax}>\mathrm{MDE}_8(\cos)\) on the paired test over byte-identical draws, the cosine's own realised sd. Counter: within \(\mathrm{MDE}_8(\cos)\) — a per-row mixture learns the displacement coordinate by coordinate as well as the joint read. No SPLIT: two-sided on the sign of the miss. Deciding number: the paired cosine difference against the cosine's realised sd (M-4.2). Hypotheses. Coordinates with label variance \(0\) masked and their fraction printed; an arm emitting \(\Delta\hat z\equiv0\) is refused, not scored (V-16); the intervened position drawn uniformly; the no-change predictor's error printed beside every \(\Delta z\) number (vakalis-2026-interventiongap [V]). Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:910 (Bet A), :700-704; softmax owns the sign column at \(0.807843\) (READ MATHEMATICS.md:396-406, seed 0 only); the cosine's sd NOT MEASURED — needs S-62 (book 04). Mechanism. D-1 (MISTAKES.md:677), V-26 (:2190), V-17, V-16. Kill. The prediction dies at a difference \(\le\mathrm{MDE}_8(\cos)\); the counter at \(>\); inside the pair \(\approx34\) s, \(0.5\) evening. Planted negative (B-G2): the permuted oracle must not score \(0\); \(-\Delta z\) must be distinguished from \(\Delta z\); oracle + 0.1σ must be preferred to the permutation — three plants the metric must fail at \(O(1)\). If killed (the counter). "Consequence as a field" retires to a label class: the canon keeps \(\Delta z=(I-\gamma P')^{-1}(\Delta V+\gamma\Delta P z)\) as algebra (Proposition 7, displacement_identity [M]) and the channel as a cost statement (one extra solve). Hypotheses: the identity holds on every draw (\(V\equiv\mathbf 1\Rightarrow\Delta z\le10^{-15}\)). Evidence: READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:456-476. Kill of the replacement: the C6 identity residual above \(10^{-12}\) on any draw of the cell — decided at seconds, bitwise-class. Terminal. The displacement is an identity and a price; no fidelity sentence against softmax.

docs.title: 06.18 — The argmin floor (Bet B)
docs.text:
Statement. The deciding floor of this verse is the exact zero-information floor \(\mathrm{floor}_0=1-\max_a\hat\pi(a^\star)\), \(0.875\) at the realised class distribution when it is uniform at \(m=8\) — not the tight restricted-view Fano. Prediction: \(\mathrm{CP}_{\rm upper}(\mathrm{err}_{\rm shape})<0.875\) at \(N=8\). Counter: \(\mathrm{CP}_{\rm lower}\ge0.875\) — the joint read is no better than knowing nothing about the query. SPLIT: the straddle \(\mathrm{CP}_{\rm lower}<0.875\le\mathrm{CP}_{\rm upper}\) (the R1 precedent straddled \(0.7071\) with \([0.617075,1.041227]\)). Deciding number: the Clopper–Pearson interval against \(0.875\) at the realised \(\hat\pi\).

Why the Fano row is not the floor here, stated in the verse it used to decide. The tight restricted-view bound \((\ln m-I(X_{\le1};a^\star)-\ln2)/\ln(m-1)\) is admissible in its source only where \(I(X_{\le k};a^\star)>0\) (READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:2491 @ 99777ab). This bed's own Hypotheses register \(I(s_0;a^\star)=0\) by plug-in (06.7, 06.8), so the instance the verse evaluated — \(0.7124=(\ln 8-\ln 2)/\ln 7\) at \(m=8\), \(I=0\) — is the one instance the source excludes: L-DOM, a theorem read outside its domain census, which the source's census makes decoration and not a floor. It is also \(0.1626\) looser than the floor the bed actually has, so deciding against it would license a capability sentence at an error rate the zero-information floor already forbids. The Fano number is therefore printed as a row and never as the deciding number, and it is printed only where the plug-in \(I\) over the one-hop view reads strictly positive with its sampling error; where \(I\) reads \(0\) the row prints "\(I=0\): Fano decoration, not a floor (L-DOM)" in place of a value. Book 04 records the same conclusion at the journal: floor_fano_k1 is struck from the mandatory field list and a cell carrying it is refused (READ 04_BEDS_AND_INSTRUMENTS.md:233). Hypotheses. \(\mathrm{floor}_0\) computed at the realised class distribution on the census draws, not assumed uniform; \(0.875\) is its value at uniform \(m=8\) and the row prints the realised value beside it; the weak Fano \(0.6667\) retired (\(0.208\) below chance); R-08's \(m_{\rm eff}\) correction applied to \(\hat\pi\) before \(\mathrm{floor}_0\) is read; the plug-in \(I\) with its sampling error printed whenever the Fano row is printed at all. Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:911, :2487-2499 of docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md (A.3); RUN of the three floors at docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:2491, which is also the line carrying the restriction "used only where \(I(X_{\le k};a^\star)>0\)"; READ 04_BEDS_AND_INSTRUMENTS.md:233 (floor_fano_k1 struck from the journal's field list); the realised \(\hat\pi\) NOT MEASURED — needs the S-12 census (book 04). Mechanism. L-FLOOR, L-DOM, V-10, V-25, M-2, V-17, P-10. Kill. The prediction dies at \(\mathrm{CP}_{\rm upper}\ge0.875\); the counter at \(\mathrm{CP}_{\rm lower}<0.875\) with the upper below; inside the pair, \(0.5\) evening. Planted negative: the random arm reads \(1/m\) and majority reads \(\max_a\hat\pi(a^\star)\) by construction (declared V-3) and both must sit on the zero-information floor row within their intervals; a floor that random beats is not a floor. Second plant, for the Fano row itself: on a generator whose one-hop view carries the membership flags (06.9's flag plant, \(I>0\) by construction) the Fano row must print a value strictly below \(0.875\) and the plug-in \(I\) strictly above \(0\); on the registered bed it must print the decoration line and no value — so the row is known to be printed only inside its domain. If killed (the counter). The argmin is repriced to \(N=16\) (\(\approx68\) s) before any argmin sentence, and the reading at \(N=8\) is filed as "no better than knowing nothing about the query licenses" with \(\mathrm{floor}_0\) printed and the Fano row printed only if \(I>0\). Hypotheses: the straddle at \(N=8\) is the median outcome (tree B). Evidence: READ docs/PLAN.md:1054 @ 99777ab (tree B's sentence, "the median outcome"; the pin :1058-1060 this verse carried at filing names the smaller-deaths heading and its table header and is corrected here, P-6). Kill of the replacement: the \(N=16\) interval still straddling or above — decided by one more batch of eight seeds, \(\approx34\) s, and then 06.9's committor-vector-only route. Terminal. The argmin column is derived and floored only by the exact zero-information floor \(0.875\); the Fano row is decoration at \(I=0\) and is printed as such; the committor vector with the exact oracle at \(0.0\) is the only head with a floor the bed itself supplies.

docs.title: 06.19 — A1 on the argmin: the shape against depth-1 base self-attention at matched parameters
docs.text:
Statement. The canon's licensed form A1 (CHARTER.md §1) on BED-S is the argmin contrast shape − 1-hop softmax (creditable by S-13; the committor-head contrast is VOID). Prediction: \(\Delta_{A1}=\mathrm{acc}_{\rm shape}-\mathrm{acc}_{d1}\in[0.40,0.85]\) with \(\mathrm{acc}_{\rm shape}\ge0.90\) and \(\mathrm{acc}_{d1}\le0.50\), the depth-5 skyline's accuracy printed in the same row. Counter: \(\Delta_{A1}\le\mathrm{MDE}_8(\mathrm{acc})\) — either \(\mathrm{acc}_{d1}\ge0.85\) because the one-hop view carries the move tokens and membership flags (R-24's lookup) or \(\mathrm{acc}_{\rm shape}\le0.50\) because 06.16's counter holds and the shape reads one hop. SPLIT: \(\Delta_{A1}\in(\mathrm{MDE}_8(\mathrm{acc}),0.40)\).

The range is two-sided and both ends kill. The sentence this verse carried at filing — "\(\mathrm{acc}_{d1}>0.50\) (the lower end fails) or \(\mathrm{acc}_{\rm shape}<0.90\) (the upper end fails)" — named both directions backwards and left the upper end unfalsifiable: \(\Delta_{A1}=\mathrm{acc}_{\rm shape}-\mathrm{acc}_{d1}\) decreases in \(\mathrm{acc}_{d1}\) and increases in \(\mathrm{acc}_{\rm shape}\), so \(\mathrm{acc}_{d1}>0.50\) and \(\mathrm{acc}_{\rm shape}<0.90\) both break the lower end, and no number named there could ever break the upper one. Corrected and frozen:

  • lower break, \(\Delta_{A1}<0.40\): reached at \(\mathrm{acc}_{d1}>0.50\) with \(\mathrm{acc}_{\rm shape}\) at \(0.90\), or at \(\mathrm{acc}_{\rm shape}<0.90\) with \(\mathrm{acc}_{d1}\) at \(0.50\);
  • upper break, \(\Delta_{A1}>0.85\), scored SPLIT and signed + (06.1's SPLIT covers any region a verse declares outside both halves; the sign is + because the reading credits the project more than the measurement supports — the contrast is a reproduction-versus-non-reproduction contrast and VOID as a capability number, so a row quoted from it would flatter): reached whenever \(\mathrm{acc}_{d1}<\mathrm{acc}_{\rm shape}-0.85\), and reachable on the bed as registered — at \(\mathrm{acc}_{\rm shape}=1.00\) (the exact solve on an exactly-solvable label) and \(\mathrm{acc}_{d1}\) at the \(m=8\) chance rate \(1/8=0.125\), \(\Delta_{A1}=0.875>0.85\) and the prediction is refuted by the outcome most favourable to the project.

Deciding number: the paired accuracy difference with Clopper–Pearson intervals, McNemar on identical draws, at matched parameters. The matched count is written the same way here as in 06.10 and 06.20, and it is two numbers, not one. \(4{,}769\) is the pre-head count and carries the class READ CEQ_V20_R15_CONTRACT.md:119 @ 99777ab ("4,769 params matched (exact counts printed)"). The post-head count, with the \([m,K+2]\) readout attached, is NOT MEASURED — needs book 04's recount: the source of \(4{,}769\) is the line that demands the recount, not the recounted number — READ docs/PLAN.md:314 @ 99777ab reads "the \(4{,}769\) of READ CEQ_V20_R15_CONTRACT.md:119 recounted, never assumed, once a \([m,K+2]\) head or a vector readout is attached". The sentence this verse carried at filing — "\(4{,}769\) recounted per arm with the \([m,K+2]\) head" — asserted the recount as performed and is struck here (P-3, a stale claim never retracted; Ruling 3; M-2). Until the post-head integers exist, every A1 row prints the pre-head count with its pin and the post-head count as NOT MEASURED, and no row prints one integer as though it were both. Hypotheses. 06.7, 06.8, 06.9 and 06.10 hold (the argmin is not a static task, not a leak, not a flag lookup); \(\mathrm{MDE}_8(\mathrm{acc})\) is the \(n=8\) cell of the realised paired sd of accuracy across seeds, NOT MEASURED — needs S-62 (book 04); the exact zero-information floor \(0.875\) printed in the row, and the tight Fano row printed only where the plug-in \(I\) over the one-hop view reads strictly positive (06.18, L-DOM). Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:371-379 (the creditable list), :582-588 (S-30); READ CHARTER.md:64-74; D-1's theorem is asymptotic under \(d\to\infty\), \(L=o(d)\), predictor erf, and the record ran \(L/d=4.00\) (READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:1301-1309), so "provably optimal" is not earned by softmax here either. Mechanism. D-1, R-SKY, Ruling 3, V-10, D-5. Kill. The prediction dies at \(\Delta_{A1}\) outside \([0.40,0.85]\) — at \(\Delta_{A1}<0.40\) or at \(\Delta_{A1}>0.85\), both frozen here (M-2); the counter at \(\Delta_{A1}>\mathrm{MDE}_8(\mathrm{acc})\); inside the arena, \(0.5\) evening. Planted negative: on the R-24 flag-lookup plant both arms must read \(\ge0.85\) and \(\Delta_{A1}\) must read inside \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\), so the A1 instrument reports no margin where a lookup decides the label; and on the copy plant of 06.15 (the arm initialised at \(\hat P=P_{\rm env}\)) with the one-hop control at chance, \(\Delta_{A1}\) must read strictly above \(0.85\) and fire the upper kill, so the upper end is known to be reachable and is not decoration. The plant read "\(\ge0.85\)" at the previous writing and is corrected to "\(>0.85\)" here: the kill is strict, so a plant that reads exactly \(0.85\) satisfies the prediction rather than firing the kill it was planted to fire (V-15). At \(\mathrm{acc}_{\rm shape}=1.00\) and \(\mathrm{acc}_{d1}=0.125\) the plant reads \(0.875>0.85\) and fires. Every outcome now carries exactly one token: \(\Delta_{A1}\le\mathrm{MDE}_8\) COUNTER, \((\mathrm{MDE}_8,0.40)\) SPLIT signed +, \([0.40,0.85]\) HOLDS, \((0.85,\infty)\) SPLIT signed + with the reproduction clause printed. If killed (the counter, the lower break, or the upper break). On the counter or the lower break the A1 sentence is withdrawn on BED-S with the cause named by which end failed: "depth-1 softmax reads the argmin at \([a]\) against the shape's \([b]\) at a pre-head matched count of \(4{,}769\) (READ CEQ_V20_R15_CONTRACT.md:119 @ 99777ab), the post-head counts printed as two integers or the row unscored; the difference \([\Delta]\) is within \(\mathrm{MDE}_8=[\cdot]\)." On the upper break the sentence is different and is written here so the outcome cannot be quoted as a success: "\(\Delta_{A1}=[\Delta]>0.85\) at \(\mathrm{acc}_{d1}=[a]\); the one-hop control read at or below the \(m=8\) chance rate \(0.125\), so the contrast is a reproduction-versus-non-reproduction contrast and is VOID as a capability number (CHARTER.md §1, docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md §3.8); the filed range was wrong and the row is scored against the prediction." In every case the replacement is A1 on the committor vector's \(\varphi\)-NRMSE against the exact floor \(0.0\) — VOID as a capability number by S-13 but licensed as a reproduction reading with the identification sup-norm beside it (06.15). Hypotheses: \(\|\hat P-P_{\rm env}\|_\infty\) in the identified band. Evidence: READ docs/PLAN.md:374. Kill of the replacement: 06.15's counter, inside the same pair, more decisive because it is a sup-norm on the operator rather than a rate on its output. Terminal. No "more accurate" sentence in form A1 on BED-S; the canon licenses "the exact solve at \(\gamma=1\) reproduces the environment's committor to \([x]\) when \(\hat P\) identifies \(P_{\rm env}\) to \([y]\)".

docs.title: 06.20 — A2 and Bet D: the depth skyline, matched and unmatched
docs.text:
Statement. Two readings in one row, and the first of them does not run on this bed.

(i) A2 as licensed (CHARTER.md §1) is UNREACHABLE at BED-S scale and files no row in 06.3's column. Ruling 3's tolerance is a per-cent number set at LM scale: it was fixed on the pair \(25{,}736{,}232\) against \(25{,}728{,}000\), an absolute residual of \(8{,}232\) parameters, \(8{,}232/25{,}728{,}000=0.032\%\), and its operative sentence is absolute — "Do NOT re-architect to close \(1.5\)k params" (READ V17K_RULINGS.md:56-59 @ 99777ab). Imported to a \(4{,}769\)-parameter arm — \(4{,}769\) being the pre-head count, READ CEQ_V20_R15_CONTRACT.md:119 @ 99777ab, with the post-head count NOT MEASURED — needs book 04's recount (READ docs/PLAN.md:314 @ 99777ab: "recounted, never assumed"; the recount is the instruction, not the result, and no verse of this book may print it as performed — P-3, Ruling 3) — the per-cent form demands a match to within \(0.032\%\times4{,}769=1.526\) parameters, which is V-17, a threshold carried out of its units: a depth-5 stack's count moves in steps of order \(d_{\rm model}\) per layer as \(d_{\rm model}\) is reduced, so no integer setting lands within \(1.53\) of \(4{,}769\) and the cell cannot fire on the bed as registered (V-11). Restated as the absolute count band Ruling 3's own text licenses: the two forms are simultaneously satisfiable only where \(1{,}500/p\le0.032\%\), i.e. at \(p\ge4{,}687{,}500\) parameters (DERIVED, \(1{,}500/0.00032\)). The LM pair at \(25{,}728{,}000\) clears it; BED-S at \(4{,}769\) misses it by three orders of magnitude. The matched-parameter A2 instance is therefore declared unreachable at \(4{,}769\) and is routed to book 04's joint-consistency bed, whose count is chosen at or above \(4{,}687{,}500\) so that a \(\le1{,}500\)-parameter gap is a \(\le0.032\%\) residual and integer \(d_{\rm model}\) steps land inside the band. The match there is stated as an absolute count with both exact integers printed in the table header and the residual reported in parameters, never in per cent: the two integers are NOT MEASURED — needs book 04's recount of the shape with the $[m,K+2]$ head attached and of the depth-5 stack at the joint bed's width (READ docs/PLAN.md:314 @ 99777ab: "recounted, never assumed"). Until those integers exist there is no A2 prediction on any bed, and this verse files none.

(ii) Bet D as filed — the reading that does run. The unmatched depth-5 stack at \(d_{\rm model}=16\): prediction, within \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\) of the shape (the honest control holds); counter, the shape short by more than \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\) — the bed needs something the hop construction does not supply; third outcome, sign logged: the shape ahead by more than \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\), which is not A2 (the stack is unmatched) and is reported as \(\Delta_{\rm sky}\) only. Deciding number: \(\mathrm{acc}_{\rm shape}-\mathrm{acc}_{\rm sky}\) at the unmatched stack (S-35), read as row C-16. Hypotheses. Depth fixed before the arena by analogy with sanford-2024-logdepth Thm 4.2, whose \(\mathrm{hop}_k\) task is not the committor (the reduction NOT FOUND, docs/sources/sweep/sweep_expressivity.md:495-513); a deeper softmax stack computes the same resolvent by iteration (wang-2024-incontext-td, xie-2026-softmax-rl [V], abstract level), so "beats softmax" is banned either way and the row carries \(\Delta_{\rm sky}\) only; the matched-parameter instance of the depth-5 stack at \(4{,}769\) parameters is unreachable, not merely unmeasured, for the reason derived in the Statement, and the table says so in place of a number; the wide skyline has no matched instance at \(d_{\rm model}=16<s=64\) and the table says so. Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:619-625 @ 99777ab (S-35, the pin 02_THEORY_TRAINING.md:467 also uses; the pin :611-617 this verse carried at filing names the S-33 tail and S-34 and is corrected here, P-6), :913 (Bet D); READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:751-781 (§3.7), :2506-2513 (A.4 skyline rows); price \(\approx7.6\) s per cell [ASSUMED linear in depth], \(\approx64.8\) s at eight seeds. Mechanism. D-1, R-SKY, P-10, V-25 (the skyline table is the only place a "cannot" sentence may stand, with its vacuity line: chen-2024-multilayer reads \(64^{1/16}=1.2968\) against \(Hdp=512\), vacuous), M-2 (a depth chosen after the arena strikes the row). Kill. For (i) there is no kill on this bed, because there is no reachable cell: the unreachability itself is the decidable statement and is decided by one recount at \(0\) GPU-s — a recounted pair whose absolute gap is at or below \(1{,}500\) parameters and at or below \(0.032\%\) of the smaller count refutes the unreachability claim and restores an A2 row here; on a \(4{,}769\)-parameter arm that requires a gap of at most \(1\) parameter, which is why the claim is filed as unreachable. For (ii): the prediction dies at the unmatched stack short by \(>\mathrm{MDE}_8\) or the shape ahead by \(>\mathrm{MDE}_8\) (either direction refutes "the honest control holds"); the counter at short by more; \(\approx64.8\) s per stack, \(1\) evening. Planted negative: the depth-1 control read as a "skyline" of depth 1 must reproduce S-30's own number bitwise (the same cell), so the skyline instrument is known to read the arms it is given; and a stack whose \(d_{\rm model}\) is stepped by one from \(16\) must print a parameter count differing from \(4{,}769\) by more than \(1.53\), so the unreachability is demonstrated by the instrument rather than asserted. If killed (either half of (ii), or the recount refuting (i)'s unreachability). The A2 sentence is withdrawn on BED-S in the form the bed can support: "a depth-5 softmax stack at \(d_{\rm model}=16\) — unmatched, \([p_{\rm sky}]\) parameters against the shape's \([p_{\rm shape}]\), gap \([\,p_{\rm sky}-p_{\rm shape}]\) parameters — reads the argmin at \([\cdot]\) against the shape's \([\cdot]\); A2 is not read on this bed because no matched instance exists at \(4{,}769\) parameters; the shape's separate claims are exactness (\(\delta=0\) on the exact route), one-read cost (one solve, depth \(s\), \(+50\%\) causal MACs, 06.28) and the boundary-row mechanism (06.22)." The replacement A2 target is book 04's joint-consistency bed at a count at or above \(4{,}687{,}500\), where the label is the full vector on \(T\) and the skyline's per-row hops must also satisfy the harmonic residual — Hypotheses: 06.21's prediction holds there, and the bed's count clears the band derived above; Evidence: READ MATHEMATICS.md:106-127; READ V17K_RULINGS.md:56-59 @ 99777ab; Kill: 06.21's counter (\(r_{\rm softmax}/r_{\rm shape}\le2\)), inside one pair, more decisive because it reads the mechanism the stack lacks rather than the rate it reaches, and reachable because the residual there is stated in parameters against a count where \(1{,}500\) parameters is a \(0.032\%\) match. Terminal. No "more accurate" sentence in form A2 on any bed of this canon; A2 at matched parameters is unreachable at BED-S scale and unbuilt at joint-bed scale; the depth skyline's number is printed in every capability row as \(\Delta_{\rm sky}\) at unmatched parameters, and the canon licenses "the same resolvent, computed in one solve rather than five learned layers" as an arithmetic statement and not as a margin.

docs.title: 06.21 — Joint consistency (Bet E)
docs.text: Statement. Prediction: \(r_{\rm softmax}/r_{\rm shape}\ge10\) at marginal NRMSE within \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\), where \(r(\hat z)=\|(I-\gamma P_{\rm env})\hat z-V\|_\infty/\|V\|_\infty\) is printed beside \(\sigma_{\min}(I-\gamma P_{\rm env})\) and \(\|I-\gamma P_{\rm env}\|_\infty\le1+\gamma\). Counter: \(\le2\) — joint consistency is learnable by a per-row mixture and the untested sentence at MATHEMATICS.md:106-127 is withdrawn. SPLIT: \((2,10)\). Deciding number: the paired ratio with both unit factors printed (M-4.2). A ratio at or above \(10\) at unequal marginal error is a statement about which mode the control mislearns and is reported as such, never as joint consistency. Hypotheses. The residual is a score, never a loss (D-2); the environment's \(Q_{\rm env},R_{\rm env}\) are the bed's; the label is the full vector on \(T\). Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:915 (Bet E), :700-704; READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:2520-2525 (A.5). Mechanism. V-26, V-17, D-2. Kill. The prediction dies at ratio \(<10\); the counter at \(>2\); inside the pair, \(0.5\) evening. Planted negative: the must-fire perturbation of B-H1 drives harmonic_residual from \(1.04\times10^{-17}\) to \(10^{-6}\) (ratio \(9.6\times10^{10}\)), so the residual instrument reads a broken joint solution as broken. If killed (the counter). "Joint determination in one read" is withdrawn; the residual stays as a diagnostic; "one read" is repriced as a cost statement (one solve, depth \(s\)). Hypotheses: the cost statement's own kill is 06.28's. Evidence: READ docs/PLAN.md:1074 ("Bet E at or below 2"). Kill of the replacement: 06.28's band check, \(\approx1.7\) s, cheaper than the pair. Terminal. The residual is a column; no joint-consistency capability sentence; the per-row mixture is credited with what it does.

docs.title: 06.22 — The boundary mechanism against a column sink (Bet F, K-E1)
docs.text:
Statement. Prediction: the shape's committor \(\varphi\)-NRMSE below ChaCAL-with-sink-token's by more than \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\) on at least 6 of 8 seeds and its harmonic residual smaller by more than \(2\times\). Counter: within \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\) on at least 6 of 8 and residual within \(2\times\) — component (e) is a parameterisation of a column sink; escalate once to \(N=16\) (S-64, seeds 8 to 15, same lane, same hash, \(\mathrm{MDE}_{16}\)), never "within TOST" at \(N=8\) (M-13). Holding at \(N=16\): the boundary-row mechanism dies as a capability and the paper is tree B. Deciding numbers: the paired \(\varphi\)-NRMSE gap and the residual ratio, at \(N=8\) then \(N=16\). Hypotheses. 06.16's prediction holds (at \(\hat\gamma=0\) the sink arm is softmax and the row is VOID); ChaCAL-diag is the shape at \(\mathcal A=\emptyset\) with diag_convention = kept declared (V-3); ChaCAL-published's diagonal convention rests on one HTML fetch and is re-read against the PDF before typesetting (B22); the sequential pair order (shape first, its \(\hat\gamma\) handed to the ChaCAL arms) is in the manifest. Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:594-600 @ 99777ab (S-31, the two ChaCAL arms and the sink-token arm; the pin :589-595 at filing named S-30 and is corrected here), :682-687 @ 99777ab (S-64, the E1 escalation to \(N=16\); the pin :688-693 at filing named S-65 and is corrected here — both P-6), :916 (Bet F); READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:2849-2860 (§7.2, component (e)); the prior evidence against the shape: sinks already act as key biases storing non-informative mass (READ docs/sources/design/design_falsify.md:393). Mechanism. V-24, M-13 (MISTAKES.md:1210), M-7, D-7, K-E1. Kill. The Statement is a conjunction, so the Kill is one: the prediction dies if either half fails — at the \(\varphi\)-NRMSE gap within \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\) on \(\ge6/8\), or at the residual ratio at or below \(2\times\), either one alone. The counter is the opposite conjunction and dies if either of its halves fails: at the gap separated by more than \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\) on \(\ge6/8\), or at the residual ratio above \(2\times\). The two mixed outcomes are neither, and each is a named branch with its own licensed sentence, so no outcome falls through:

branch reading verdict the sentence it licenses HOLDS gap \(>\mathrm{MDE}_8\) on \(\ge6/8\) and ratio \(>2\) prediction the boundary rows separate the read and condition the joint solve; escalate nothing COUNTER within on \(\ge6/8\) and ratio \(\le2\), holding at \(N=16\) counter tree B's sentence below SPLIT-sep (separated, not residual) gap \(>\mathrm{MDE}_8\) on \(\ge6/8\), ratio \(\le2\) SPLIT, signed + "the boundary rows separate the committor read from a column sink by \([\cdot]\) at \(\mathrm{MDE}_8=[\cdot]\); the harmonic residual is within \(2\times\), so component (e)'s residual claim dies and only the read claim escalates to \(N=16\)" SPLIT-res (residual, not separated) ratio \(>2\), gap within \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\) on \(\ge6/8\) SPLIT, signed + "the shape's joint solve is better conditioned by \([\cdot]\times\) while its committor read is within \(\mathrm{MDE}_8=[\cdot]\) of a column sink's; the capability sentence is withdrawn and the residual is filed as 06.21's diagnostic column, not as a boundary-row capability" SPLIT-seeds (no seed majority either way) the modal side of the eight per-seed gap readings reaches only \(\le5/8\) SPLIT, signed + "the eight per-seed \(\varphi\)-NRMSE gaps split \([\,\text{separated},\text{within}\,]\) with the residual ratio at \([\cdot]\times\); no seed majority exists in either direction, so neither the separation nor its absence is read, and the row escalates nothing"

The seed-count rule is a partition, not four predicates, and the fifth branch is what makes it one. Every one of the first four rows requires a \(\ge6/8\) seed majority on the gap, so an outcome such as (4 seeds separated, 4 seeds within, ratio \(>2\)) reaches \(6/8\) in neither direction and satisfied none of the four — the same M-7 hole 06.15 closed with a modal-band rule and a printed count, and which was not swept here. 06.15's rule is applied to this verse: the eight per-seed gap readings are binned into separated (gap \(>\mathrm{MDE}_8\)) and within, the modal side and its count are printed, a separated or a within verdict requires the modal count to reach \(\ge6/8\), and every configuration whose modal count is \(\le5/8\) is SPLIT-seeds, with the ordered pair (separated, within) and the residual ratio printed so the reading is recoverable. Exactly one of five branches is reachable per outcome and every outcome reaches one: \((6,2)\) with ratio \(>2\) is HOLDS, \((2,6)\) with ratio \(\le2\) is COUNTER, \((6,2)\) with ratio \(\le2\) is SPLIT-sep, \((2,6)\) with ratio \(>2\) is SPLIT-res, and \((4,4)\) at any ratio is SPLIT-seeds. All three SPLIT branches are scored wrong with the sign of the optimistic half (06.1) and none is "escalation": escalation is what the COUNTER branch triggers, and it is named as such. Price, re-derived from 06.28's re-tag because the arena arms are priced at the shape's cell: \(\approx53.3\) s for the three ChaCAL arms at \(N=8\) (DERIVED, \(3\times8\times1.71990+3\times4.0\) fixed, three invocations — the source's \(\approx52\) s is \(3\times8\times1.680+12.0\) at the struck cell, READ docs/PLAN.md:594-600 @ 99777ab), escalation \(\approx45.3\) s (DERIVED, \(3\times8\times1.71990+4.0\); the source's \(\approx44\) s is \(3\times8\times1.681+4\)), \(2\) evenings. Planted negative: with \(\mathcal A\neq\emptyset\) the downstream \(\|\Pi_{\rm shape}-\Pi_{\rm ChaCAL\text{-}diag}\|_\infty\) must exceed \(0.1\) on \(100\%\) of admitted draws (B-E1's rejection half), so a sink arm that matched the shape by being the shape would be caught at construction. If killed (the counter holding at \(N=16\)). Tree B's sentence in full: "Consequence-Equilibrium Attention is a re-parameterisation of ChaCAL's causal resolvent read with absorbing boundary rows on the record's three-corner base; \([n]\) of its identities are machine-checked; the committor head is the exact solve at \(\gamma=1\), matching the bed's own Dirichlet solve to \(0.0\); BED-S is registered with an exact oracle at \(0.0\), the exact zero-information floor \(0.875\) at \(m=8\), and a printed paired sd \([\mathrm{sd}]\); a column sink reproduces the boundary-row read within \(\mathrm{MDE}_{16}=[\cdot]\); no capability sentence is licensed." The replacement claim is the delta narrowed to what a column device cannot carry: the certificate (\(\delta=0\) on the exact route), the Lean containment, and the interventional re-solve (06.23) — Hypotheses: 06.23's prediction; Evidence: READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:2860-2866 (component (g)); Kill: 06.23's counter, \(\approx35\) s, cheaper than the escalation. Terminal. A property paper about a published operator with a certificate discipline, a registered bed and its negatives; book 01's boundary-row theorems stand as theorems about weights downstream of a row and license no capability.

docs.title: 06.23 — The cached mixture (Bet H, K-G1)
docs.text: Statement. Prediction: the cached arm \(O_{\rm cached}=\hat P_{\rm base}(I-\gamma\hat P_{\rm base})^{-1}V_{\rm int}\) fails on \(P\)-changing plants by more than one seed sd on at least 6 of 8 and matches the shape within one seed sd on \(V\)-only plants. Counter: within one seed sd on \(P\)-changing plants on at least 6 of 8 — the re-solve is a per-row control wearing a name, component (g)'s re-solve sentence dies, and the consequence channel is repriced as a cost statement. SPLIT: \(3/8\) to \(5/8\). Deciding number: the two per-seed cosine gaps in seed-sd units (S-33). Hypotheses. Both plant classes non-empty with at least 64 draws each (S-17); moves are query-side row clamps on the environment chain (\(u^\top\mathbf 1=0\), non-negative edited row on \(100\%\)); the operational form of a cached successor representation (momennejad-2017-sr, russek-2017-predictive, mechanism [U]). Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:607-612 @ 99777ab (S-33, the cached-mixture arm on the two plant classes; the pin :599-604 at filing named the S-31 tail and S-32 and is corrected here, P-6), :401-407 (S-17), :917 (Bet H); the precedent — a "signed" pivot arm that was the unsigned arm renamed (READ workdonenew.md:379 @ 99777ab). Mechanism. D-2, P-7 (MISTAKES.md:375), V-9. Kill. The prediction dies at within one seed sd on \(P\)-changing plants on \(\ge6/8\), or worse than one seed sd on \(V\)-only plants; the counter at the two-way separation; \(\approx35\) s, \(1\) evening. Planted negative: a corpus with no \(P\)-changing move must make S-33 unscorable (S-17's kill), so the instrument cannot report a separation that has no rejection region. If killed (the counter). The displacement identity stays as algebra and the channel as a cost statement (one extra solve, or one column at \(m/d\) — 06.33). Hypotheses: none beyond Proposition 7. Evidence: READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:456-476. Kill of the replacement: 06.33's counter (\(\ge8\times\)) turns the cost statement into "\(m\) solves", seconds. Terminal. No interventional-channel sentence; the canon licenses the identity \(\Delta z=(I-\gamma P')^{-1}(\Delta V+\gamma\Delta Pz)\) and its price.

docs.title: 06.24 — The parity half by equivalence (S-65)
docs.text:
Statement. This verse is filed as three rows at one cell each, because a prediction and a counter read at different \(N\) can both hold or both fail and are not of equal specificity (L-SIGN).

Row C-33 — the tier, decided first and on its own number. Deciding number \(r=\mathrm{sd}_d/\sigma\), both read from S-62's realised sds. Prediction: \(r\le0.7071\) and the paired tier \(N=36\) is selected. Counter: \(r>0.7071\) and the two-sample tier \(N=70\) is selected — pairing bought nothing. No SPLIT: \(r\) is a number, not a band. The threshold \(1/\sqrt2=0.7071\) is frozen here (M-2) and is conservative by construction: the paired design reaches power \(0.8014\) at \(N=36\) against a \(0.5\sigma\) margin when \(\mathrm{sd}_d=\sigma\) (Monte Carlo \(200{,}000\) draws), only \(0.0014\) above target, so the tier boundary is set where the paired design still holds power under a \(\sqrt2\) error in the realised sd.

Row C-20 — the equivalence reading, both halves at the tier C-33 selects. Prediction: the shape at \(\hat\gamma\) against ChaCAL-diag at the same \(\hat\gamma\) with \(\mathcal A=\emptyset\) lies inside the \(\pm0.5\sigma\) margin on the 90 per cent interval at that tier. Counter: outside the margin at that same tier — the "same operator" sentence is withdrawn at trained \(\hat\gamma\) and narrowed to the \(\gamma=0\) bind. No SPLIT: inside and outside exhaust the cell.

Row C-34 — the \(N=70\) two-sample reading, filed as its own row and never as C-20's counter. Deciding number: the \(N=70\) two-sample 90 per cent interval against \(\pm0.5\sigma\); prediction inside, counter outside. Where C-33 selects \(N=36\), C-34 is a second reading of the same contrast at a different design and is scored separately; where C-33 selects \(N=70\), C-20 and C-34 read the same cell and C-34 is filed VOID as a duplicate, with the duplication recorded rather than scored twice.

Any "parity" sentence resting on \(N=8\) is struck regardless, and the arithmetic that strikes it is this verse's own design, which is paired. The paired half-width at \(N=8\) is \(t_{.95,7}/\sqrt8=1.894579/2.828427=0.669835\,\mathrm{sd}_d\) (DERIVED; \(0.6698\) at four places, filed by MARS as \(0.6699\) — the same quotient rounded up), which is above the \(0.5\) margin, so two bit-identical arms return NO VERDICT at \(N=8\) on the paired arithmetic and the conclusion stands where it always stood. The \(0.8807\sigma\) this verse printed at filing is the two-sample half-width, \(t_{.95,2N-2}\,\sigma\sqrt{2/N}=1.7613\times0.5=0.88065\) at \(N=8\) (READ MISTAKES.md:1216-1219 @ 99777ab, whose sentence names it as the two-sample contrast's), imported into a paired verse: V-17, a threshold carried out of its units, with M-13 and M-9 behind it. Both numbers are printed here, each named for the design it belongs to, and the \(N=8\) strike rests on the paired one. The tier arithmetic is unchanged by the correction — the paired form first drops below \(0.5\) at \(N=13\) and reaches power \(0.80\) at \(N=36\), the two-sample form at \(N=23\) and \(N=70\) — because those four integers were always read from their own designs. Hypotheses. 06.16 MOVED (otherwise the half is softmax against softmax and every row here is VOID); the margin \(\pm0.5\sigma\) and the tier threshold \(0.7071\) both fixed here, before any cell (M-2); C-33 is read and its verdict recorded before C-20's interval is computed, so the tier is never chosen from the interval it decides; fixed-\(N\) Schuirmann (schuirmann-1987-tost [V]); the sequential anytime-valid form NOT FOUND at [V]; the two tier prices are both registered so the selection changes no budget decision. Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:688-699 @ 99777ab (S-65, the TOST parity half; the pin :706-712 at filing named census lines 12/13 and M-4.5 and is corrected here), :956 @ 99777ab (R-22, the parity-by-underpowering row that prints the \(0.8807\sigma\) half-width; the pin :958 at filing named R-25/K-G1 and is corrected here — both P-6); READ MISTAKES.md:1210-1230 (M-13, the reachability arithmetic: \(0.8807\) at \(N=8\), \(0.6001\) at \(16\), below \(0.5\) first at \(23\); power \(0.80\) first at \(N=70\)). Mechanism. M-13, M-9, M-2, V-5. Kill. C-33: the prediction dies at \(r>0.7071\), the counter at \(r\le0.7071\); \(0\) GPU-s beyond S-62 (a journal read). C-20: the prediction dies at the interval outside the margin at the tier C-33 selected, the counter at inside at that same tier — one cell, two exhaustive outcomes, so the two halves cannot both hold and cannot both fail; \(119\) s at the paired tier or \(228\) s at the two-sample tier, \(1\) evening. C-34: the prediction dies at outside at \(N=70\), the counter at inside at \(N=70\); \(228\) s. Planted negative: the identity half of B-E1 — torch.equal at \(\mathcal A=\emptyset\) — is the construction plant; an equivalence test on two bitwise-identical arms must read inside at \(N=36\) and NO VERDICT at \(N=8\), both printed; and a tier row fed \(\mathrm{sd}_d=\sigma\) must select \(N=70\) (since \(1>0.7071\)), so the tier rule is known to refuse the paired tier at the sd where its power is only \(0.8014\). If killed (the counter). The identity is claimed at \(\gamma=0\) only (gamma_zero_is_softmax [M]; RUN[coord] torch.equal True) and "the same operator at trained \(\hat\gamma\)" is withdrawn. Hypotheses: none. Evidence: 06.13. Kill of the replacement: 06.13's torch.equal False, \(\approx1.7\) s — cheaper and bitwise. Terminal. Parity is the Lean row and the bitwise cell at \(\gamma=0\); no equivalence sentence at any \(\hat\gamma>0\).

docs.title: 06.25 — The dials vary (M-3.7, D-3)
docs.text: Statement. Prediction: across the seven design points — centre \((8,2,8)\), \(t^\star\in\{2,32\}\), \(K\in\{3,4\}\), \(m\in\{4,16\}\) — the argmin error moves with \(t^\star\) by more than \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\) between \(t^\star=2\) and \(8\), and every point is admitted by its own census. Counter: error flat within \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\) across \(t^\star\) — the dial is decoration and only the centre is reported; \(t^\star=32\) unreachable inside the causal window is recorded, never forced. No SPLIT. Deciding number: the S-62 statistics per point with the exact floor per \(m\) (\(0.75\), \(0.875\), \(0.9375\)). Hypotheses. 06.7 admits at the centre; each point re-censused; \(t^\star\) placed by depth, never by a kill rate. Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:648-655; RUN of the floors at docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:2491. Mechanism. D-3, P-8, V-25, V-10. Kill. The prediction dies at flat error within \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\) across \(t^\star\in\{2,8\}\); the counter at a move larger; \(\approx3.5\) to \(4.0\) min DERIVED (\(7\times\) one pair), \(2\) evenings. Planted negative: the depth-1 control across the same points must move with \(t^\star\) in the opposite direction (worse at larger \(t^\star\)), so a flat reading on the shape is distinguishable from a flat instrument. If killed (the counter). Only the centre is reported; the difficulty dial is removed from every capability sentence and the bed is described at one point. Hypotheses: the centre admitted. Evidence: 06.7. Kill of the replacement: 06.7's counter at the centre, \(0\) GPU-s. Terminal. One design point, one bed, no scaling sentence in \(t^\star\).

docs.title: 06.26 — The certificate (Bet J, dormant)
docs.text: Statement. Prediction, when a mask exists: zero exceedances of \(\varepsilon\|V\|_\infty/(1-\gamma)+\delta_\Pi\|V\|_\infty\) on \(1{,}024\) draws and \(\delta\|V\|_\infty\) below the label sd. Counter: one exceedance, or \(\delta\|V\|_\infty\) at or above the label sd — the mask is refused and the exact solve ships. No SPLIT. Deciding numbers: the exceedance count and the ratio (N-15, K-I). Hypotheses. \(P\) row-stochastic on the cell (S-42's row-sum guard; at \(\hat\beta\ne1\) rows sum \(1.31\) to \(10.29\) and the field is written refused); the mask amplification \(1/(1-\gamma)\) carried (Proposition 4(ii), RUN[J] \(0.5263157894736843\) against the naive \(0.1\) at \(s=3\), \(\gamma=0.9\), \(\varepsilon=0.1\)). Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:919 (Bet J), :959 @ 99777ab (R-10 / K-I, the certificate row; the pin :964 at filing is a blank line and is corrected here, P-6); READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:2628-2639 (A.9); no mask exists (B15), so the row is dormant. Mechanism. L-CERT, V-10, V-17. Kill. The prediction dies at any exceedance or ratio \(\ge1\); the counter at \(0\) and \(<1\); \(\approx2.6\) s (\(1{,}024\) forward passes at \(n=2048\)), \(0.5\) evening. Planted negative, on the quantity the Kill reads: the Kill decides the mask certificate \(\varepsilon\|V\|_\infty/(1-\gamma)+\delta_\Pi\|V\|_\infty\), so the plant that must fire it is a mask plant and not a truncation plant (V-15: no condemning rule without a planted negative that fires it; L-CERT; V-10). The must-fire plant: a mask whose realised perturbation is \(\varepsilon^\star\) but whose journalled \(\varepsilon\) is set to \(\varepsilon^\star/10\) with \(\delta_\Pi\) left at its true value — the certificate is then understated by construction and the exceedance count must read strictly greater than \(0\) on the \(1{,}024\) draws, with the largest realised \(\|z-\hat z\|_\infty\) printed beside the bound it exceeded. The must-not-fire plant: the zero-perturbation mask, \(\Pi=I\) so \(\varepsilon=0\) and \(\delta_\Pi=0\) — the exact route, whose certificate is \(0\) and whose realised deviation is \(0\) — must read an exceedance count of exactly \(0\) on all \(1{,}024\) draws; a count above \(0\) there is an instrument fault and the cell is refused, not scored. The two together give the counter a rejection region and the prediction a floor, on the same number the Kill reads. The truncation plants are kept and relabelled: rows scaled to \(1.5\) at \(\gamma=0.6\), \(K=2\) reading \(7.29\) against \(0.54=\gamma^{K+1}/(1-\gamma)=0.216/0.4\), and the \(\gamma=0.7\) plant reading \(119.37\) against \(1.143=0.343/0.3\), are plants on N-15's other bound — the Neumann truncation bound of the \(K\)-hop read, not this verse's mask certificate — and are printed as such, the first convergent and reported, the second a divergent series labelled and never counted. Neither is this verse's negative and neither is counted as one. If killed (the counter). The exact solve ships — cheaper than one Neumann hop at \(s=64\) (\(2.514\) ms against \(3.001\) ms, RUN[NEPTUNE] at docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:431) — and every long-context price of book 03 is a dense-per-chunk price. Hypotheses: the solve's per-op floor holds under the dispatch gap. Evidence: 06.28. Kill of the replacement: 06.28's counter, \(\approx1.7\) s. Terminal. No mask, no certificate sentence; the exact route with \(\delta=0\) is the only certified route.

docs.title: 06.27 — The ladder on a survivor (M-5.3)
docs.text: Statement. Prediction: the \(N=8\) verdict of every scored bet survives the \(9{,}600\)-step ladder within its own \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\). Counter: a verdict reverses at the ladder — the ladder's verdict is filed and the 150-step cell is marked a pilot (M-3); what dies is the 150-step sentence, not the bed. No SPLIT. Deciding number: the same statistics at step \(9{,}600\); the crossing and residual curves. Hypotheses. The shape alive on at least one creditable contrast after S-63 to S-65; \(64\times\) the 150-step law. Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:775-780; price \(32\) to \(36\) min per pair [FITTED] at \(64\times\) (READ docs/PLAN.md:981). Mechanism. M-3, M-6, P-8. Kill. The prediction dies at any reversal; the counter at none; \(32\)–\(36\) min per pair, \(1\) evening. Planted negative: the depth-1 control's own 150-step reading must reproduce at the ladder's step 150 within the identical-seed floor (bitwise in one lane), so a reversal is a change in the arm, not in the harness. If killed (the counter). Every 150-step number in books 01 to 05 is re-tagged "pilot" and the ladder's number is the reported one; T1/T2 of 06.29 to 06.31 are re-read at the ladder's \(\tau\). Hypotheses: the ladder is the record's largest budget ever spent on one pair. Evidence: READ docs/PLAN.md:981. Kill of the replacement: none cheaper exists; the ladder is the Terminal instrument. Terminal. The paper quotes ladder numbers only, and the 150-step cells as pilots with their sd.

docs.title: IV. Faster to train (B25)
06.28 — The per-step cost statement, DERIVED until RUN
docs.text:
Statement. The shape has no measured whole-step law. Every step number below for the shape is DERIVED, with its steps printed, and is re-tagged here from the [FITTED + RUN] tag it carried at filing — that tag priced a two-arm sum at one arm's rate, which is M-8, the very mechanism this verse is designed against.

Per step at \(n=2048\), \(s=64\), \(d_{\rm model}=16\), forward plus backward plus Adam.step:

quantity value class steps depth-1 softmax, whole step \(0.010165\) s [FITTED] \(R^2=0.999998\) over five points exp(-12.1852)·n^0.9963 at \(n=2048\), READ COSTS.md:73-74 @ 99777ab depth-1 softmax, whole step, measured point \(0.010142\) s [MEASURED] results/k_cert_local.json throughput.points solve increment at RHS width \(16\) \(1.041\) ms RUN[NEPTUNE] \(2.514-1.473\) ms, READ 08_ARCHITECTURE.md:138 (the Evidence line that carries the subtraction; the increments at \(n=2048/4096/8192\) read \(1.041/2.312/4.542\) ms at READ 03_KERNEL.md:178) solve increment at the shipped RHS width \(20\) \(1.30125\) ms DERIVED \(1.041\times20/16\); forward substitution is \(s^2/2\) MACs per right-hand column, so the increment is linear in the column count, and book 08 ships \(\tilde V\in\mathbb R^{s\times(d+K+2)}\), \(d+K+2=20\) at \(d=16\), \(K=2\) (READ 08_ARCHITECTURE.md:115 for \(\tilde V\)'s width, :510 for out.z float32[B, h, s, d+K+2]) the shape on the softmax corner, whole step \(0.011466\) s DERIVED \(0.010165+0.00130125\) ratio shape over depth-1 base \(1.1280\) DERIVED \(0.011466/0.010165\) the shape's \(150\)-step cell \(1.71990\) s DERIVED \(150\times0.011466\); not the \(1.680\) s the sources print — see the re-tag below the record's only measured CEQ-family whole step \(0.093052\) s [MEASURED] arm_smprime, complex64, \(n=2048\); RUN this session on results/k_cert_local.json, throughput.laws.arm_smprime.y[0] \(=0.09305229999881703\), whose law is READ COSTS.md:73-74 @ 99777ab (exp(-10.0187)·n^1.0026); the ratio against the softmax measured point is \(0.093052/0.010142=9.1745\times\) (DERIVED, one division) and is printed here in place of the bare "\(9.2\times\)", which had no producer in this book

The \(0.093052\) s row is printed in this same row-set and is not the shipped base: the record's arm is complex64 while the shipped base is the softmax corner at \(4\) B/element, which book 08 states as a property of the shipped shape rather than of the record's arm (READ 08_ARCHITECTURE.md:592, the float32-operator Hypothesis and the ceq/arm_smprime.py::operator reading; :850, the \(g\equiv0\) real branch).
