It is carried here because it is the only whole-step number in the record produced by an arm of this family, and because the DERIVED \(0.011466\) s has no measured whole-step number of its own to stand beside — it is a two-term sum, not a reading. The pins this paragraph and the table carried at the previous writing — 08_ARCHITECTURE.md:518 four times, :513 for the MAC table, :462 for the \(R^2\), :477 for the shipped channel count — are all drifted or empty at the working tree's book 08 and are corrected above and below; :518 is book 08's out.gamma/out.beta comment line, :513 its out.dz_degenerate comment, :462 a horizontal rule and :477 a row of the task-supply table, and none of them carries the number it was cited for (P-6). The \(0.093052\) s figure is not in book 08 at all: its producer is results/k_cert_local.json, read this session.

The \(1.680\) s shape cell is re-tagged, and the re-tag moves every price in this book. The sources price the shape's \(150\)-step cell at "\(1.680\) s per cell [FITTED + RUN]" (READ docs/PLAN.md:594-600 @ 99777ab, S-31; the same tag for the same quantity at READ 09_CHESS_AND_MARKETS.md:148). That tag is the one this verse strikes, and the number carries it: \(1.680/150=0.011200\) s per step, which is the superseded step \(0.011206\) s to five places, so pricing anything at \(1.680\) s prices it at the struck step under the struck tag (M-8, P-8, P-3, M-2). COSTS.md:73-74 @ 99777ab carries the two \(n\)-laws and no cell price, so the [FITTED + RUN] pin behind \(1.680\) s has no producer either. The shape's \(150\)-step cell is therefore DERIVED at \(150\times0.011466=1.71990\) s, and every GPU-second price in this book that multiplies a shape cell is re-derived from \(1.71990\) s in the verse that carries it and in the cheapest-first table. The softmax cell is unaffected: \(150\times0.010165=1.52475\) s, DERIVED from a law that does have a producer (READ COSTS.md:73-74 @ 99777ab), and agreeing with the sources' \(1.524\) s [FITTED] to three places. Book 09's verse at 09_CHESS_AND_MARKETS.md:148 still carries [FITTED + RUN] for \(1.680\) s per shape cell; that book is born and may not be edited here, so the disagreement is owed to CORRECTIONS.md as a row against 09_CHESS_AND_MARKETS.md:148 and against docs/PLAN.md:594-600, naming this verse's re-tag as the one in force.

The depth-\(L\) skyline at \(L\cdot0.010165\) s ([ASSUMED linear in depth]): \(0.030495\), \(0.050825\), \(0.071155\) s at depth \(3/5/7\), so the shape's step is \(0.2256\times\) the depth-5 stack's (DERIVED under the assumption, \(0.011466/0.050825\)). InfSA-16's step is \(0.034133\) s, which is NOT MEASURED — needs S-32's cell, and the \(2.977\times\) it gives against the shape's DERIVED step inherits that tag. The only derivation the source supports is one division: the source prices the InfSA-16 cell at \(\approx5.12\) s per \(150\)-step cell "DERIVED from the \(25.409\) ms hop microbenchmark" (READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:1926 @ 99777ab; the same \(\approx5.1\) s at :2510), and \(5.12/150=0.034133\) s per step (DERIVED, one division). The step below that — how \(5.12\) s follows from a \(25.409\) ms hop — is not printed at the source and does not reproduce from this book's constants: \(0.034133-0.025409=0.008724\) s is neither the softmax law's \(0.010165\) s nor the solve increment's \(0.001301\) s, and \(0.010165+0.025409=0.035574\) s is not \(0.034133\) s. So the number is carried as an unreproduced source figure with its class printed, not as a derivation (P-1, M-8).

Prediction, in the four branches that exhaust \([0,\infty)\) exactly as 06.13's do, and now centred on the re-tagged cell: the S-20 cell lands inside \([-1.8,+14.4]\) per cent of the DERIVED \(1.71990\) s (multiplier in \([0.982,1.144]\), i.e. \([1.68894,1.96757]\) s), so the ratios above are the ratios. Counter, two named branches: COUNTER-dear, the cell at or above \(2.2\times\) the DERIVED cell (\(\ge3.78378\) s); COUNTER-cheap, the cell below \(0.982\times\) (\(<1.68894\) s) — the hole this verse carried at filing, closed here for the reason 06.13 states in full, since 06.36's Kill declares the tree refuted when a scored outcome has no branch (M-7, D-7, M-20). Either branch re-derives every ratio from N-02's producer before a T1 number is quoted. The signs are corrected here and run the other way from the previous writing. 06.1 defines the sign of a miss against the project — + credits the project more than the measurement supports (READ V16_CALIBRATION.md:24-31) — and what is scored is the claim, not the outcome. A cell dearer than the claim means the claim was too cheap, so the claim credited the project more than the measurement supports: COUNTER-dear is +. A cell cheaper than the claim means the claim was too dear, so the claim credited the project less: COUNTER-cheap is −. The reason printed before — "a cell cheaper than the law flatters every price in this book" — scored the outcome instead of the claim and is deleted; it inverted both signs and, since C-9 and C-24 are two of the rows in 06.4's tree-C pool, it inflated by up to two the + count the eighth-row test reads. SPLIT: \((1.144,2.2)\), i.e. \((1.96757,3.78378)\) s. Deciding number: the cell wall-clock over the DERIVED \(1.71990\) s, synchronize() bracketed. Hypotheses. Each arm at its own law (M-8); the increment measured at the shipped \(s=64\), never scaled from a smaller \(s\) (M-3); the RHS width is a Hypothesis, not a measurement: the \(1.041\) ms increment was read at a \(d=16\) right-hand side and the shipped solve carries \(d+K+2=20\) channels, so the \(1.30125\) ms figure assumes the forward substitution is linear in the column count, and the kill below is frozen on that linearity claim and on nothing else. The bracket \([1.041,1.561]\) ms this Hypothesis carried at the previous writing is struck: its lower endpoint is the width-\(16\) increment itself, so an increment with no width dependence at all — the exact negation of the linearity being tested — sat inside the band and restored the struck \(0.011206\) s step (\(0.010165+0.001041\)) and the struck \(1.1024\) ratio without striking anything (V-10, a gate satisfied by construction; V-11; M-2). The point prediction of linearity is \(1.041\times20/16=1.30125\) ms, and the admissible spread around it is the same \(\pm12\%\) clock non-stationarity these Hypotheses already declare, so the band is \([1.14510,1.45740]\) ms (DERIVED, \(1.30125\times0.88\) and \(1.30125\times1.12\)). At \(1.041\) ms the kill now fires, as it must, and the two-sidedness is real; a per-op floor under a \(2.0\times\)–\(6.6\times\) dispatch gap (P-8); the clock non-stationary at \(\pm12\%\); no price crosses the device boundary (V-22); the depth-linear assumption is the ASSUMED tag and is retired only by S-35's cell. The shape's own throughput law is NOT MEASURED — needs N-02's producer on the shipped arm (book 03); until it exists no number in this verse is a whole-step measurement of the shape. Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:967-983 (the basis and the price table); READ COSTS.md:73-74 @ 99777ab (both laws: softmax exp(-12.1852)·n^0.9963 \(R^2=0.999998\) over five points, arm_smprime exp(-10.0187)·n^1.0026 over three points because at \(n=16384\) and \(32768\) the allocator reserves \(10.578\) and \(13.969\) GiB on an \(8\) GiB card and the loop times the PCIe bus); READ 08_ARCHITECTURE.md:138 (the increment \(2.514-1.473=1.041\) ms/step fwd+bwd at \(n=2048\), \(s=64\), \(d=16\) float32, RUN NEPTUNE, per-op floor) and READ 03_KERNEL.md:178 (the three increments \(1.041/2.312/4.542\) ms at \(n=2048/4096/8192\)); READ 08_ARCHITECTURE.md:592 and :850 (the shipped shape's float32 operator against the record's complex64 arm, so the corner-3 base is not the shipped base); READ 08_ARCHITECTURE.md:115 (\(\tilde V\in\mathbb R^{s\times(d+K+2)}\)) and :510 (out.z float32[B, h, s, d+K+2], the shipped \(20\) channels); READ 08_ARCHITECTURE.md:553-559 (the per-row MAC table and its total); READ results/k_cert_local.json (throughput.points: softmax medians \(0.010142\), \(0.020291\), \(0.040525\) s at \(n=2048/4096/8192\) — the third is \(0.040524899999581976\) at throughput.laws.softmax.y[2], printed \(0.040521\) at filing, a transcription error corrected here; throughput.laws.arm_smprime.y[0] \(=0.09305229999881703\), the \(0.093052\) s row above; the law's \(R^2\) is \(0.9999975361960808\) in the file and is printed \(0.999998\) at READ COSTS.md:73 @ 99777ab, which is the pin that carries it — the 08_ARCHITECTURE.md:462 pin this verse cited for the same figure is a horizontal rule at the working tree and is struck here, P-6); the dispatch gap READ scale/m3_flops.py:101-121; the shape's whole-step law NOT MEASURED — needs N-02. Mechanism. M-8, M-3, P-8, V-22, C17 (git show 99777ab:V20_R15_JOURNAL.md:53: no torch.cuda.synchronize() in scripts/v15_r1.py; run order the strongest correlate of seconds at \(\rho=+0.7029\), \(p=0.0024\)). Kill. The prediction dies at the cell \(\ge2.2\times\) the DERIVED \(1.71990\) s cell (\(\ge3.78378\) s, COUNTER-dear) or below \(0.982\times\) it (\(<1.68894\) s, COUNTER-cheap, frozen here); the counter at inside the band; a second, independent kill fires on the width Hypothesis, frozen on the linearity claim itself: a measured solve increment at RHS width \(20\) outside \([1.14510,1.45740]\) ms — \(1.30125\) ms \(\pm\) the declared \(12\) per cent clock spread — strikes the \(0.011466\) s step, the \(1.71990\) s cell and every ratio derived from them, whatever the S-20 cell reads. A measured \(1.041\) ms at width \(20\) (no width dependence whatever) fires this kill, which is the point of freezing it at the point prediction rather than at the width-\(16\) reading. Price \(\approx1.72\) s for the cell, seconds for the width, \(0.2\) evening. Planted negative, restated on a number with a producer: the InfSA-16 cell contains a \(25.409\) ms hop, so its measured whole step must read at or above \(0.025409\) s — \(\ge1.95\times\) the shape's DERIVED step (\(0.025409/0.011466=2.2160\), less the \(12\%\) clock spread) — and a timer reporting it faster than the hop it contains is refused. The \(\ge2.62\times\) plant this verse carried at filing rested on the \(0.034133\) s figure and is deleted with it: a plant may not rest on a number tagged NOT MEASURED. The arm_smprime cell must read \(\ge8.07\times\) the softmax cell (\(9.1745\times\) less the \(12\%\) spread, DERIVED), a known-\(9.1745\times\) arm the timer must report as such; the depth-1 control run twice in interleaved order must agree within \(12\%\). If killed (the counter, or the width kill). Every ratio in 06.29 to 06.31 is replaced by the measured ratio from N-02, and until N-02 exists the shape's step is quoted as the DERIVED sum with both terms printed and the measured \(0.093052\) s beside it as the family's only reading. The replacement statement is the MAC law alone, with no wall-clock and no fit — and it counts the softmax head the shape itself executes, which the previous writing omitted. The shape does not replace a softmax layer; it contains one and adds a solve, so pricing the solve alone against \(L\) whole layers priced the arms at different rates (M-8) and contradicted book 08's own table, which book 08 was itself convicted of and repaired. At \((s,d,K,m)=(64,16,2,8)\), per head per sequence:

\[\underbrace{s^2d}_{\text{the head the shape executes}}+\underbrace{s^2(d+K+2)/2}_{\text{the solve, all }20\text{ columns}}=65{,}536+40{,}960=106{,}496\ \text{MACs}=1.625\times\ \text{the head},\]

and the read layer's total, which is what an engineer pays, is \(\approx s^2(d\cdot\tfrac32+K+2+m/2)+msd=139{,}264\) MACs \(=2.125\times\) the head — against \(L\) softmax layers at \(L\,s^2d=65{,}536\,L\) (READ 08_ARCHITECTURE.md:553-559, the per-row table: head \(s^2d=65{,}536\); the solve's \(K+2\) indicator channels \(s^2(K+2)/2=8{,}192\); the committor head at \(\gamma=1\) on \(T\) at \(\le8{,}192\); the \(m\) clamp moves at \(16{,}384+8{,}192\); total read layer \(139{,}264\), \(2.125\times\) the head). Book 08's "\(+50\%\) causal MACs" is the head plus the \(d\) value columns alone, \(65{,}536+s^2d/2=98{,}304=1.5\times\) the head (READ 08_ARCHITECTURE.md:182, :460), and is not the layer total; both figures are printed here so the smaller cannot be quoted for the larger. The sentence "\(40{,}960\) against \(65{,}536\,L\)" — which at \(L=1\) reads the shape at \(0.625\times\) one softmax layer while the shape contains that layer — is struck. Hypotheses: the MAC count is arithmetic over the shipped channel counts and row costs of book 08's budget table, and no clock enters it; \(L\) is the skyline depth, and at \(L=1\) the honest reading is \(1.625\times\) on the \(z\) channel and \(2.125\times\) on the read layer, not a number below \(1\). Evidence: READ 08_ARCHITECTURE.md:553-559 (the per-row MAC table and its total), :460 (the Terminal that prints both figures), :115 and :510 (the shipped \(d+K+2=20\) channels), READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:583-603 (§2.5). Kill of the replacement — a different number, a different instrument, a different object from the verse's, and now read on the total rather than only on the channel count, because a correct channel count with an omitted head passes a channel audit as the previous replacement did: the read layer's total recomputed from 08_ARCHITECTURE.md:553-559 at the shipped \((s,d,K,m)\) differing from \(139{,}264\), or the shipped channel width read off :115 and :510 differing from \(d+K+2\); either makes the MAC arithmetic wrong at its own shapes. Decided by a shape audit at \(0\) GPU-s with no timer at all, cheaper and more decisive than the wall-clock band. It does not rest on 06.32's exponent, whose own deciding statistic 06.32 records as confounded until normalised. Terminal. Prices are quoted as measured points, never as laws; the only measured whole-step number of this family is \(0.093052\) s on an arm that is not the shipped base; "faster to train" has no per-step referent and 06.29 to 06.31 are VOID.

docs.title: 06.29 — T1 and T2 against depth-1 base self-attention
docs.text:
Statement. Let \(\tau_1\) be the depth-1 control's \(\varphi\)-NRMSE at step 150 on a seed (median over 8 seeds), and let \(t_{\rm shape}(\tau_1)\) be the shape's wall-clock from initialisation to the first eval at or below \(\tau_1\) in the same lane, timers synchronised, arms interleaved. \(T1_{d1}=t_{\rm shape}(\tau_1)/t_{d1}(\tau_1)\) with \(t_{d1}(\tau_1)\) the control's own 150-step wall-clock; \(T2_{d1}\) the same ratio in draws (steps \(\times2048\)). Prediction: \(T1_{d1}\le0.50\) and \(T2_{d1}\le0.45\) — the shape passes the one-hop error by step \(66\). Both mappings are printed so the two halves and the frozen kill agree at one integer (M-2; V-17): \(T1_{d1}=k\times0.011466/(150\times0.010165)=k\times0.011466/1.52475=0.00751992\,k\) (DERIVED to six places), and \(T2_{d1}=k/150\) exactly, since \(n_{\rm train}\) is the same for both arms. The two halves bind at different integers and the smaller governs: \(T1_{d1}\le0.50\) requires \(k\le0.50/0.00751992=66.49\), i.e. \(k\le66\) (\(0.49631\) at \(k=66\), \(0.50383\) at \(k=67\)), while \(T2_{d1}\le0.45\) alone would allow \(k\le67\) (\(0.44667\) at \(k=67\), \(0.45333\) at \(k=68\)). \(T1\) is the binding half at \(k\le66\), and the Kill below is frozen there, so no integer satisfies the prediction while the kill fires and none fires the kill while both halves hold. The kill this verse carried at filing, "\(>68\)", is corrected here: at \(k=68\) the \(T2\) half is already false (\(0.45333>0.45\)) and the \(T1\) half more so (\(0.51135>0.50\)), so a kill at \(68\) would have let two integers, \(67\) and \(68\), score HOLDS on a prediction one or both of whose halves is false there. Counter, split in two named branches exactly as 06.13's and 06.28's are, because the counter as filed had a far end that carried no token: COUNTER-slow, \(T1_{d1}\in[0.89,1.44]\) — under 06.16's counter the shape is softmax at the increment, \(1.1280\times[0.7857,1.2727]\) for the clock, with \(T2_{d1}\in[0.90,1.10]\) printed beside it as the companion reading; and COUNTER-overrun, \(T1_{d1}>1.44\) — the increment realised above the clock spread, which is 06.28's COUNTER-dear branch read from the clock, signed +. The region \((1.44,\infty)\) was named in this verse's own list of numbers that make the counter range wrong and was absent from the frozen Kill, so a reading there scored COUNTER on a counter whose filed range excludes it (M-7; M-2; D-7; 06.36's Kill: "The tree is refuted if a scored outcome has no branch"). SPLIT: \(T1_{d1}\in(0.50,0.89)\).

Every integer \(k\) carries exactly one token, printed at the constant \(0.00751992\). \(k\in[1,66]\) HOLDS (\(T1_{d1}\le0.49631\)); \(k\in[67,118]\) SPLIT (\(0.50383\) to \(0.88735\), both inside \((0.50,0.89)\)); \(k\in[119,191]\) COUNTER-slow (\(0.89487\) at \(k=119\), the first integer at or above \(0.89\); \(1.43630\) at \(k=191\), the last at or below \(1.44\)); \(k\ge192\) COUNTER-overrun (\(1.44382\) at \(k=192\)). All DERIVED by multiplication. The partition is on \(T1\) alone, its binding half, and \(T2\) is the companion reading: \(T2_{d1}=k/150\), so \(T2_{d1}\in[0.90,1.10]\) is \(k\in[135,165]\), a strictly narrower window than COUNTER-slow's, and the conjunction "\(T1\in[0.89,1.44]\) and \(T2\in[0.90,1.10]\)" the counter carried at the previous writing is unsatisfiable at every \(k\) in \([119,134]\cup[166,191]\) — the SPLIT clause "\(T2_{d1}\in(0.45,0.90)\)" was a second, disagreeing partition of the same axis and is deleted. A \(k\) in \([119,191]\) whose \(T2\) lies outside \([0.90,1.10]\) is COUNTER-slow with the \(T2\) reading printed beside it. Every \(T1\) number in this verse inherits 06.28's re-tag: the step \(0.011466\) s and the ratio \(1.1280\) are DERIVED with their two terms printed, not [FITTED + RUN], and the shape has no measured whole-step law (06.28). The numbers that make the prediction range wrong: a crossing step above \(66\); the numbers that make the counter range wrong: \(T1_{d1}<0.89\) (\(k\le118\), the shape faster in seconds despite the increment) or \(T1_{d1}>1.44\) (\(k\ge192\), COUNTER-overrun), and both ends are frozen in the Kill below. Deciding number: the crossing step read from the journal's per-step eval curve — the logger is specified: eval_trace (per-step eval NRMSE, for T2) with secs_sync and run_index (for T1) are mandatory journal fields and a missing declared field is a refusal (READ 04_BEDS_AND_INSTRUMENTS.md:238, the field list — the pin :233 this verse carried at the previous writing is 04's W2 arm_phase Kill line and is corrected here, P-6; :171, the crossing step read off that trace, likewise corrected from :170, which is 04.10's Spearman Kill). The sampling rate is reconciled here in favour of book 04's field: every step, not every tenth. At every step the crossing-step resolution is \(1\) step, so \(k=66\) and \(k=67\) are separable and this verse's kill is decidable; at every tenth step the resolution is \(10\) steps, which cannot separate 06.31's \(k=30\) boundary from \(k=39\) nor this verse's \(k=66\) from \(k=75\), and a journal sampling at ten would make both kills undecidable. The value itself is NOT MEASURED — needs S-62 run witheval_tracepopulated and book 03's synchronised, interleaved timer. Hypotheses. Both arms reach \(\tau_1\) by construction (the control defines it); at matched parameters — the pre-head \(4{,}769\) of READ CEQ_V20_R15_CONTRACT.md:119 @ 99777ab, with the post-head count NOT MEASURED — needs book 04's recount (06.19); the ratio is against base self-attention at depth 1 and is the T1 form of CHARTER.md §1 only when the floor is a fixed distance-to-floor — here \(\tau_1\) is a distance the control attains, printed with the exact floor \(0.0\) beside it (L-FLOOR); a comparison at the shape's own floor is VOID against depth 1 because one softmax layer does not reach it at \(t^\star=8\) (obstruction 2, lineage) and a ratio with an infinite denominator is not a number. Evidence. DERIVED from 06.28 (and re-tagged with it); the logger READ 04_BEDS_AND_INSTRUMENTS.md:238 (eval_trace, secs_sync, run_index, floor_exact, floor_zeroinfo, ceiling_hop_k, and the parenthesis striking floor_fano_k1; a missing declared field is a refusal) and :171 (the crossing step read off the trace, identical-seed floor \(0.0\) so the crossing step is exact per seed); the crossing curve itself NOT MEASURED; the record's only cost ratios were withdrawn at C17 (B25). Mechanism. D-1, M-8, C17, V-17 (two units of "depth"), B12 (the corner descent decides which half), M-20 (this book claimed the logger unspecified while book 04 specified it; the two are reconciled here in book 04's favour). Kill, with both counter ends frozen. The prediction dies at a crossing step \(>66\) on \(\ge4\) of 8 seeds. The counter dies at either end: at \(T1_{d1}<0.89\) (\(k\le118\)) on \(\ge6/8\), or at \(T1_{d1}>1.44\) (\(k\ge192\)) on \(\ge6/8\), which is the COUNTER-overrun branch and was named in the Statement's list but absent from this field at the previous writing. Inside the arena, \(0\) GPU-s beyond it once eval_trace is populated, \(1\) evening. Planted negative: the depth-1 control against itself in reversed run order must read \(T1=1.00\pm0.12\) and \(T2=1.00\) exactly; ChaCAL-diag at fixed \(\gamma=0.9\) (a fellow approximator with the same increment) must read \(T1\ge0.89\) against the control by construction of its step, so the instrument reports the increment where the increment is all there is; a journal whose eval_trace carries one entry per ten steps must be refused by the adjudicator, not read at resolution \(10\). If killed (the counter). The sentence: "Against depth-1 base self-attention on BED-S the shape reaches the control's 150-step error at \([T1]\) of its GPU-seconds and \([T2]\) of its draws: it is the control at the price of one solve." The replacement is the per-step statement of 06.28 with no "to floor" clause — Hypotheses, Evidence and Kill as in 06.28 (the band check, \(\approx1.7\) s, cheaper than the arena). Terminal. "Faster to train" in form T1 or T2 against depth-1 base is withdrawn on BED-S; the canon licenses "\(1.1280\times\) the step at \(n=2048\), DERIVED as \(0.010165+0.001301\) s, a per-op floor under a \(2.0\times\)–\(6.6\times\) dispatch gap, with no measured whole-step law for the shape".

docs.title: 06.30 — T1 against the depth skyline
docs.text:
Statement. Let \(\tau_5\) be the depth-5 stack's \(\varphi\)-NRMSE at step 150 per seed and \(T1_{\rm sky}=t_{\rm shape}(\tau_5)/t_{\rm sky}(\tau_5)\), where \(t_{\rm sky}(\tau_5)=150\times0.050825=7.62\) s ([ASSUMED linear in depth]) and \(t_{\rm shape}(\tau_5)=k\times0.011466\) s at crossing step \(k\) (06.28's DERIVED step, re-tagged there), so the mapping constant is \(0.011466/7.62375=0.00150398\) (DERIVED to six places) and \(T1_{\rm sky}=0.00150398\,k\): \(0.0511\) at \(k=34\) (\(0.05113545\)) and \(0.2256\) at \(k=150\) (\(0.22559764\)). The constant \(0.0015047\) this verse printed at filing is corrected here: it reads \(0.225705\) at \(k=150\), outside the very band the verse files, so the printed constant and the printed range disagreed at the upper end (M-2, a threshold frozen inconsistently; V-17). The range and the crossing-step window now map into each other at both ends and at every integer between them. Prediction: \(T1_{\rm sky}\in[0.0511,0.2256]\) — the shape reaches the skyline's 150-step error within the cell and not before its first \(34\) steps, i.e. \(k\in[34,150]\), on at least 6 of 8 seeds. Counter: the shape does not reach \(\tau_5\) within 150 steps on at least 6 of 8 — \(T1_{\rm sky}\) undefined at the cell, filed COUNTER: at the 150-step budget the learned hops reach an error the exact solve does not, which is 06.16's counter seen from the clock.

One seed count, keyed on the in-band count, and a catch-all so no configuration falls through. Each of the eight seeds is placed in exactly one of three categories by its crossing step: in band (\(34\le k\le150\)), below band (\(k<34\)), not reached (\(k>150\)). The verse and row C-26 are frozen at one count, \(\ge6/8\) — the count the prediction itself already used — and the SPLIT band is re-keyed on the in-band count rather than on the "reached" count, because the reached count does not separate in-band from below-band and left a hole. The four branches:

branch reading (of the eight seeds) verdict HOLDS in band on \(\ge6/8\) prediction COUNTER not reached on \(\ge6/8\) counter LOW below band (\(k<34\)) on \(\ge6/8\) refutation of the prediction, scored SPLIT and signed + — the optimistic outcome carries a verdict SPLIT no category reaches \(6/8\) SPLIT, with the ordered triple (in band, below band, not reached) printed

The \(\ge4/8\) count the Kill carried at the previous writing is struck: it disagreed with row C-26's \(\ge6/8\) (M-2, a threshold frozen inconsistently; M-20), and even taken together the two left the configuration (5 in band, 3 below band, 0 not reached) in no branch at all — the prediction fails at \(5<6\), the counter fails at \(0\), the old SPLIT was keyed on "reached on \(3/8\) to \(5/8\)" while \(8/8\) are reached, and the old Kill needed \(\ge4/8\) outside while only \(3\) are. Under the table above that configuration is SPLIT with the triple \((5,3,0)\) printed. The old SPLIT clause "reached on \(3/8\) to \(5/8\)" is deleted with it.

The range is frozen at both ends and both ends kill. \(k<34\) on \(\ge6/8\) — the shape crossing before the first \(34\) steps — refutes the prediction exactly as \(k>150\) does, and is scored COUNTER-side, never HOLDS. The clause this verse carried at filing ("filed HOLDS with the range corrected in a superseding row") is deleted: it made every \(k\in[1,150]\) score HOLDS, so the whole region \(T1_{\rm sky}<0.0511\) was unfalsifiable and the row predicted both outcomes (M-20), and it refitted the threshold to the data that judges it (M-2). Under L-G2 a superseding row records a corrected reading, never a corrected range; a range corrected after the cell is a new prediction that may not be scored against this cell at all. The optimistic outcome \(k<34\) is the one the canon most wants and is therefore the one whose kill is frozen hardest: it is filed here, before the cell, as a refutation of this verse.

Deciding number: the crossing step \(k\) per seed, read from eval_trace at one entry per step (06.29) — NOT MEASURED — needs S-62 witheval_tracepopulated (READ 04_BEDS_AND_INSTRUMENTS.md:233) and the S-35 cell. Hypotheses. The unmatched depth-5 stack at \(d_{\rm model}=16\) (R-SKY control) is the denominator; the matched-parameter stack of 06.20(i) is read beside it when it exists; the depth-linear step is ASSUMED and retired by S-35's own wall-clock; the exact floor \(0.0\) printed beside \(\tau_5\). Evidence. DERIVED from 06.28; READ docs/PLAN.md:619-625 @ 99777ab (S-35's price \(\approx7.6\) s per cell, \(\approx64.8\) s at eight seeds, [ASSUMED]). Mechanism. R-SKY, D-1, M-8, P-8, V-17. Kill, at one seed count. The prediction dies at in band on \(\le5/8\) — that is, whenever the in-band count fails to reach \(6/8\), which covers the LOW branch (\(k<34\) on \(\ge6/8\)), the COUNTER branch (\(k>150\) on \(\ge6/8\)) and the SPLIT catch-all alike; the counter dies at not-reached on \(\le5/8\). Both are frozen at \(\ge6/8\), the same count row C-26 carries, and the \(\ge4/8\) of the previous writing is struck. Price \(\approx65.0\) s for the skyline cell (DERIVED, \(8\times5\times1.52475+4.0\) fixed; S-35's printed \(\approx64.8\) s uses \(7.6\) s per cell, READ docs/PLAN.md:619-625 @ 99777ab) plus the arena, \(1\) evening. Planted negative: an arm initialised at the exact solve (the copy plant of 06.15) must cross at \(k=1\) and fire the lower kill, so the lower end is known to be reachable on the bed as registered and is not decoration; the depth-3 stack (at \(t^\star=2\), M-3.7's point) must reach the depth-5 stack's \(\tau_5\) later than the depth-5 stack itself on a \(t^\star=8\) bed, so the instrument orders a known-shallower arm behind a deeper one. If killed (the counter). The sentence: "At 150 steps the depth-5 stack reads \([\tau_5]\) and the shape reads \([e]>\tau_5\) on \([k]\) of 8 seeds; the shape's step is \(0.2256\times\) the stack's (DERIVED over an [ASSUMED] depth-linear denominator) and no GPU-seconds-to-floor ratio is defined at this budget." The replacement is the ladder reading of 06.27 with \(\tau_5^L\) the stack's error at step \(9{,}600\) — Hypotheses: the stack's ladder at \(\approx65\) min [ASSUMED] (\(9{,}600\times0.050825\times8\) s) plus the pair's \(32\)–\(36\) min; Evidence: READ docs/PLAN.md:981; Kill: not reached at step \(9{,}600\) on \(\ge6/8\) — more decisive because the budget is exhausted, and the only link whose price exceeds the verse's, which the depth rule permits because it is strictly more decisive. Terminal. No T1 sentence against the depth skyline; the canon licenses the MAC law with the head the shape executes inside the count ("one head plus one solve at \(s^2d+s^2(d+K+2)/2=65{,}536+40{,}960=106{,}496\) MACs, \(1.625\times\) the head, and \(139{,}264\) MACs, \(2.125\times\) the head, for the read layer's total at \((s,d,K,m)=(64,16,2,8)\), against \(L\) layers at \(Ls^2d=65{,}536\,L\)", READ 08_ARCHITECTURE.md:553-559) and prints both wall-clocks as points, the shape's as a DERIVED sum with no measured whole-step law behind it (06.28).

docs.title: 06.31 — T2, draws-to-floor, both controls (B25)
docs.text: Statement. \(T2\) is the ratio of training draws (steps \(\times n_{\rm train}\)) to a fixed target: \(T2_{d1}\) at \(\tau_1\) (06.29) and \(T2_{\rm sky}\) at \(\tau_5\) (06.30). Prediction: \(T2_{\rm sky}\le0.20\) — the shape needs at most a fifth of the stack's draws to reach the stack's 150-step error, because one parameter set (\(\hat P\), one \(\gamma\)) is identified from next-state labels while five layers must each learn a hop (book 02's identifiability verse); equivalently \(k\le30\) at \(n_{\rm train}=2048\). Counter: \(T2_{\rm sky}\ge1.0\) or undefined — the shape needs at least as many draws, because under the corner descent the first draws are spent leaving \(\gamma=0\) (06.16's counter) and the sample-efficiency half is the same as depth-1's. SPLIT: \(T2_{\rm sky}\in(0.20,1.0)\). The number that makes the prediction wrong: \(k>30\) on \(\ge4\) of 8 seeds. What this row inherits from 06.28's re-tag, and what it does not: \(T2\) is a ratio of draw counts, \(T2_{\rm sky}=k/150\) at fixed \(n_{\rm train}\), so no re-tagged second enters it and its numbers stand unchanged; what it does inherit is the source of \(k\), which is the same eval_trace curve, and the fact that its companion \(T1\) rows are DERIVED and not fitted. Deciding number: the crossing step \(k\) — the logger is specified as a mandatory journal field, eval_trace per step (READ 04_BEDS_AND_INSTRUMENTS.md:233; the crossing step read off it at :170), and the value is NOT MEASURED — needs S-62 witheval_tracepopulated; the ratio is the T2 form of CHARTER.md §1 and is the only "faster" number that survives an unsynchronised clock, which is why it is filed separately from T1. Hypotheses. Draws are counted, never timed, so C17's confound does not reach this row; the same \(\tau\) definitions; \(n_{\rm train}=2048\) for every arm; the identifiability statement is book 02's and its kill (identification at \(\ge10^{-2}\), 06.15's counter) is upstream of this row. Evidence. DERIVED; the record holds no draws-to-floor number for any arm (B25); READ CHARTER.md:75-86. Mechanism. M-3, M-9, D-1, B12. Kill. The prediction dies at \(k>30\) on \(\ge4/8\); the counter at \(k\le150\) on \(\ge6/8\) with \(T2_{\rm sky}<1.0\); inside the arena and the S-35 cell, \(0\) GPU-s beyond them once the logger exists, \(0.5\) evening. Planted negative: the depth-1 control against itself must read \(T2=1.00\) exactly (draws are integers), and an arm whose learning rate is set to \(0\) must never reach any \(\tau\) and be reported "undefined", not "\(\infty\) rounded". If killed (the counter). The sentence: "The shape reaches the depth-5 stack's 150-step error at \([T2]\) of its draws, or not within 150 steps on \([k]\) of 8 seeds; no sample-efficiency sentence is licensed." The replacement is book 02's fixed-\(\gamma\) regime re-read on the same curves (06.16's replacement), whose T2 is defined from step \(0\) without the descent — Hypotheses: \(\gamma_{\rm env}\) registered; Evidence: 06.16; Kill: \(k>150\) on \(\ge6/8\) at fixed \(\gamma\) as well, inside one pair, \(\approx34\) s, cheaper than the skyline cell. Terminal. "Faster to train" in form T2 is withdrawn; the canon licenses "one parameter set" as a count of parameters, not of draws, and B25 is closed by the two undefined ratios printed with their crossing steps.

docs.title: 06.32 — The cost exponent in \(s\) (Bet L, S-66)
docs.text:
Statement. The fitted quantity is seconds per step divided by \(n\) — seconds per step per unit \(n\) — and not seconds per step. Prediction: the fitted exponent of \(\mathrm{sec}/(\mathrm{step}\cdot n)\) in \(s\) over \((s,n)\in\{(64,2048),(256,2048),(1024,128),(4096,8)\}\) has an interval containing \(2\) and excluding \(3\), and the Spearman correlation of seconds against run index is insignificant at \(\alpha=0.05\). Counter: the interval excludes \(2\) toward \(3\) — depth \(s\) is visible past \(s=64\) and every long-context price is a band; or \(\rho\) comparable to the record's \(+0.7029\). SPLIT: the interval contains both \(2\) and \(3\). Deciding number: the exponent interval of the normalised statistic, and \(\rho\) (S-66; book 03's harness with a seq_len flag, two synchronize() calls and randomised order — the fifth edit no office priced).

Why the statistic is normalised, with the arithmetic that forces it. The four points do not hold \(n\) fixed: \(n\) falls from \(2048\) to \(8\), a factor of \(256\), because the residency rule refuses the dense operator at \(n=2048\), \(s=4096\) (\(137\) GB against \(7.996\) GiB). On the un-normalised statistic that variation swamps the exponent it is supposed to read. Take a solve whose cost is exactly quadratic in \(s\), \(\mathrm{cost}=c\,n\,s^2\) — the prediction's own hypothesis. Then \(\log_2\mathrm{cost}\) at the four points is \(23,27,27,27\) against \(\log_2 s=6,8,10,12\), and the OLS slope is \(S_{xy}/S_{xx}=12/20=0.60\) (DERIVED). A perfectly quadratic arm reads \(0.60\): the prediction ("contains \(2\), excludes \(3\)"), the counter ("excludes \(2\) toward \(3\)") and the SPLIT ("contains both") all fail at \(0.60\), and no half of the bet nor its band has a branch — which is D-3 and M-8 in one statistic, and is exactly what this verse's own planted negative asserts about an instrument that reads the allocator instead of the arm. Normalised, the same four points read \(\log_2(\mathrm{cost}/n)=12,16,20,24\) against \(\log_2 s=6,8,10,12\) and the slope is exactly \(2\) (DERIVED), so the prediction band is well posed on the normalised statistic and on no other. The alternative — timing at fixed \(n\) — is unavailable: the residency refusal at \((2048,4096)\) removes the point, and where that route is taken the refused point is recorded as missing, never imputed. Hypotheses. The deciding statistic is \(\mathrm{sec}/(\mathrm{step}\cdot n)\), declared here before the sweep (M-2); the per-step cost is linear in \(n\) at fixed \(s\), which the record's own two laws assert at \(n^{0.9963}\) and \(n^{1.0026}\) (READ COSTS.md:73-74 @ 99777ab) and which the normalisation therefore assumes to within those exponents — a departure from linearity in \(n\) larger than \(\pm0.01\) in the exponent strikes the normalisation and the row with it; \(n\) declared per \(s\) from the residency model (the dense operator at \(n=2048\), \(s=4096\) is \(137\) GB against \(7.996\) GiB and is refused, and the refusal is journalled as a missing point); \(N=8\); every price quoted before the sweep is struck (K-9). Evidence. READ docs/PLAN.md:725-731, :1074 ("S-66 K-9 (band)"); the band \(206\)–\(537\) GPU-s git show 99777ab:V20_R15_THEORY_TABLE.md:104-109; the record's \(\rho=+0.7029\), \(p=0.0024\) (C17). Mechanism. D-3, P-8, C17, M-3, K-9. Kill. The prediction dies at an interval on the normalised statistic excluding \(2\), or at a significant \(\rho\); the counter at containing \(2\), excluding \(3\), \(\rho\) n.s.; a third kill fires on the normalisation itself — a fitted exponent in \(n\) at fixed \(s\) outside \([0.99,1.01]\) strikes the statistic and every reading taken on it. Price \(206\)–\(537\) GPU-s, band only, \(3\) evenings. docs.title: 06.24 — severity repair; replacement survives as filed: true
docs.text:
Flaw (verbatim). "The 0.8807 sigma half-width used to strike every N=8 parity sentence is the two-sample formula, applied inside a verse whose declared design is paired."

Mechanism (verbatim). "V-17 (a threshold imported out of its units); M-13; M-9"

Number (verbatim). "MISTAKES.md:1216-1219 @ 99777ab: \"The 90% confidence interval for a two-sample contrast has half-width t(.95, 2N-2) . sigma . sqrt(2/N) ... at N = 8 the half-width is 0.8807\". Check: t(.95,14)=1.7613, sqrt(2/8)=0.5, product 0.88065. The paired half-width at N=8 is t(.95,7)/sqrt(8) = 1.8946/2.8284 = 0.6699 sd_d — still above the 0.5 margin, so the conclusion survives, but the printed number is from the other design."

Repair applied — 06.24, 06.10. The paired half-width is printed as the number that strikes the \(N=8\) parity sentence: \(t_{.95,7}/\sqrt8=1.894579/2.828427=0.669835\,\mathrm{sd}_d\), above the \(0.5\) margin, so two bit-identical arms return NO VERDICT at \(N=8\) on the verse's own paired design. \(0.8807\sigma\) is kept and named for what it is, the two-sample half-width \(t_{.95,14}\,\sigma\sqrt{2/8}=1.7613\times0.5=0.88065\) of READ MISTAKES.md:1216-1219 @ 99777ab, imported out of its units at filing. The quotient is written \(0.669835\) rather than the finding's \(0.6699\) because \(1.894579/2.828427=0.6698345\) — the same number, rounded up at the fourth place in the finding and printed to six here so the two designs cannot be confused by a rounding; 06.10's copy of it is corrected to match. The conclusion is unchanged and is not softened: no parity sentence at \(N=8\), on either design.

docs.title: 06.10 — severity repair; replacement survives as filed: true
docs.text:
Flaw (verbatim). "The counter — which sends the whole canon down tree C, the most destructive branch — fires on a failure to reject at the widest interval in the book, and the book refuses exactly this reading two verses later."

Mechanism (verbatim). "M-13 (an equivalence margin registered without a reachability check); M-9; V-5"

Number (verbatim). "06.10 counter: \"the 0-hop MLP inside the half-width, or \(p>0.05\)\" where the half-width is the shape's Clopper-Pearson at N=8. MISTAKES.md:1216-1222 @ 99777ab records that at N=8 the half-width (0.8807 sigma two-sample; 0.6699 sd_d paired) exceeds the 0.5 sigma margin, and \"TOST power at a true difference of zero ... reads 0.000 at N = 8\". 06.22 files the opposing rule: \"never 'within TOST' at \(N=8\) (M-13)\"."

Repair applied — 06.10, and the cheapest-first table. The seed-level equivalence reading at \(N=8\) is deleted from the deciding number and the kill is moved onto McNemar at the eval draw count, with the minimum detectable difference fixed in the verse before any cell: on \(n_{\rm eval}=4096\) paired draws, rejection at \(\lvert b-c\rvert/\sqrt{b+c}>1.96\) and power \(0.80\) at \(\ge2.8016\), so \(\mathrm{MDE}_{\rm McN}=2.8016\sqrt{d/4096}=0.04378\sqrt d\) — \(0.01384\) at a discordant fraction \(d=0.10\), \(0.03095\) at \(d=0.50\). A non-rejection now carries a detectable-effect size and may fire tree C; a non-rejection with no printed \(\mathrm{MDE}_{\rm McN}\) may not; and no non-rejection at \(N=8\) seeds may fire tree C at all, which is the rule 06.22 files and which this verse now files in the same words. The verse body carried this from batch 1; what this finding closes is the stale row in the cheapest-first table, which still read "0-hop MLP inside the half-width or \(p>0.05\)" and would have sent a reader down tree C on the very reading the verse refuses. The row now prints the McNemar form and the M-13 prohibition.

docs.title: 06.29 — severity repair; replacement survives as filed: true
docs.text:
Flaw (verbatim). "The two halves of one prediction disagree with each other and with the frozen kill at the crossing step the verse itself names."

Mechanism (verbatim). "M-2 (a threshold frozen inconsistently); V-17"

Number (verbatim). "T1_d1 = k0.011206/(1500.010165) = 0.0073494k; T2_d1 = k/150. At k=68: T1 = 0.49976 <= 0.50 (prediction holds) but T2 = 0.453333 > 0.45 (prediction fails). The Kill reads \"The prediction dies at a crossing step \(>68\)\", so k=68 does not kill a prediction one of whose halves is false there. T2 <= 0.45 requires k <= 67."

Repair applied — 06.29. Both mappings are printed in the verse: \(T1_{d1}=k\times0.011466/1.52475=0.00751992\,k\) and \(T2_{d1}=k/150\) exactly. The two halves bind at different integers and the verse now says which governs: \(T1\) binds at \(k\le66\) (\(0.49631\) at \(66\), \(0.50383\) at \(67\)) while \(T2\) alone would allow \(k\le67\) (\(0.44667\) at \(67\), \(0.45333\) at \(68\)), so the frozen kill is \(k>66\) and no integer satisfies the prediction while the kill fires, nor fires the kill while both halves hold. The finding's arithmetic used the pre-batch-1 step \(0.011206\) s, where the binding half was \(T2\) at \(k\le67\) and the filed kill at \(>68\) let two integers score HOLDS on a false prediction; at the current step the binding half is \(T1\) and the integer is \(66\). The defect the finding names — the two halves and the kill agreeing at no single integer — is closed by printing both mappings and naming the binding half, which is exactly its required repair, and the verse records the filed kill "\(>68\)" and why it was wrong rather than deleting it.

docs.title: 06.26 — severity repair; replacement survives as filed: true
docs.text:
Flaw (verbatim). "The planted negative exercises a different bound from the one the Kill decides, so the plant cannot make the verse's own kill fire (V-15)."

Mechanism (verbatim). "V-15 (no condemning rule without a planted negative that fires it); L-CERT; V-10"

Number (verbatim). "Statement's certificate: epsilon||V||_inf/(1-gamma) + delta_Pi||V||_inf. Planted negative: \"rows scaled to \(1.5\) at \(\gamma=0.6\), \(K=2\) must read \(7.29\) against the bound \(0.54\)\" — 0.54 = gamma^{K+1}/(1-gamma) = 0.216/0.4, the Neumann truncation bound, not the mask certificate; and 7.29 = 0.9^3/(1-0.9), the tail of the row-sum-1.5 series. The gamma=0.7 plant's 1.143 = 0.343/0.3 is the same truncation bound."

Repair applied — 06.26. Two plants on the quantity the Kill actually reads are added. Must fire: a mask whose realised perturbation is \(\varepsilon^\star\) but whose journalled \(\varepsilon\) is \(\varepsilon^\star/10\) with \(\delta_\Pi\) at its true value — the certificate is understated by construction, the exceedance count must read strictly above \(0\) on the \(1{,}024\) draws, and the largest realised \(\|z-\hat z\|_\infty\) is printed beside the bound it exceeded. Must not fire: the zero-perturbation mask, \(\Pi=I\), \(\varepsilon=0\), \(\delta_\Pi=0\) — the exact route, certificate \(0\), realised deviation \(0\) — must read an exceedance count of exactly \(0\); a count above \(0\) there is an instrument fault and the cell is refused, not scored. The truncation plants are kept and relabelled in place as N-15's other bound: \(0.54=\gamma^{K+1}/(1-\gamma)=0.216/0.4\) and \(1.143=0.343/0.3\) are the Neumann truncation bound of the \(K\)-hop read, not this verse's mask certificate, the first convergent and reported, the second divergent and never counted — and the verse says in the open that neither is its negative.

docs.title: 06.12 — severity repair; replacement survives as filed: true
docs.text:
Flaw (verbatim). "A RUN-class negative result is asserted with neither the command nor the keys it searched, so it cannot be reproduced, and the boundary null it disqualifies still gates Bet C with no admissible citation."

Mechanism (verbatim). "P-1 (a number with no live producer); P-2; L-EQ"

The exact commands and their outputs are printed, RUN this session: grep -c 'chernoff' docs/references.bib \(=0\); grep -c 'self-liang' docs/references.bib \(=0\); grep -niEc 'chernoff|self.?liang|chibar|chi-bar' docs/references.bib \(=0\). The theorem is named so a reader can supply the reference: the asymptotic null of a likelihood ratio at a parameter-space boundary is the half–half mixture \(\tfrac12\chi^2_0+\tfrac12\chi^2_1\), \(95\) per cent point \(2.705543\), classically Chernoff (1954) and Self and Liang (1987, boundary case 5), both NOT FOUND at [V-eq] in this tree. It does not block the MOVED threshold: \(\ln4096=8.317766\) is read off the declared held-out size \(n_{\rm eval}=4096\) and stands without the null — the finding's sentence that both rest on it is narrowed here to the one that does, with the arithmetic for the other printed.

docs.title: 06.28 (second finding, repair) — severity repair; replacement survives as filed: true
docs.text:
Flaw (verbatim). "InfSA-16's per-step figure is tagged DERIVED from a stated hop time, but no arithmetic on the book's own constants reproduces it."

Mechanism (verbatim). "P-1; M-8"

The step below that — how \(5.12\) s follows from a \(25.409\) ms hop — is not printed at the source, and the verse now says so with the finding's own arithmetic printed as the demonstration: \(0.010165+0.025409=0.035574\neq0.034133\), and \(0.034133-0.025409=0.008724\) s is neither the softmax law nor the solve increment. The dependent plant is deleted, not weakened: a plant may not rest on a NOT MEASURED number, so "the InfSA-16 cell must read \(\ge2.62\times\) the shape's cell" is replaced by a plant on a number with a producer — the cell contains a \(25.409\) ms hop, so its measured whole step must read at or above \(0.025409\) s, \(\ge1.95\times\) the shape's DERIVED step (\(0.025409/0.011466=2.2160\) less the \(12\%\) clock spread), and a timer reporting the arm faster than the hop it contains is refused.

docs.title: 08 — ARCHITECTURE: the module as an engineer builds it
docs.text: NEPTUNE-II · LINUS (systems), MYCROFT's derivations cited by proposition number and never re-derived. Written 2026-09-05 at HEAD 99777ab under CHARTER.md. Pin: READ path:line @ 99777ab; docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md's own READ class is pinned to 207e7b9. Books 01–06 did not exist in docs/canon/ when this book was written (RUN ls docs/canon/ → CHARTER.md, CORRECTIONS.md), so every attachment to them cites docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md (hereafter SHAPE) and docs/PLAN.md by section and names the book that will own it.

docs.title: Preface — what this book decides, and the verse that decides it first
docs.text:
1. This book states one module, Consequence–Equilibrium Attention (CEQ), completely enough to build from the page: interfaces, tensor shapes, parameters, the forward pass, the solve, the boundary rows, the heads, the training objectives with their weights, the optimiser regime, the data interface, the inference call, the budget on the certified device and on a Kaggle card, and the determinism hooks.
  2. The first decision is verse 08.1: the layer is a causal row-stochastic softmax head with an exact-propagation corner, and every other object in this book is a read of one lower-triangular solve on that head. If 08.1 dies, the book collapses to its Terminal — a softmax stack — and the remaining verses are withdrawn in the order of the closing table.
  3. The second decision is 08.3: boundary conditions are identity rows of the same \(P\), never a second matrix, so that \(I-\gamma P\) stays a unit on the causal class by a diagonal read (SHAPE §2.2 Prop. 10).
  4. The third is 08.4: there is one solve, \(z=(I-\gamma P)^{-1}V\) with \(K+2\) indicator channels appended to \(V\), and every read — state, committor, displacement, safest move, phase, certificate — is a linear functional of \(z\) or of one further solve.
  5. Nothing in this book is a result. No CEQ arm has been trained (CHARTER §5 B5); every capability number is NOT MEASURED and every price at \(s>64\) is a per-op floor under a \(2.0\times\)–\(6.6\times\) dispatch gap (B14).
  6. "Faster to train" appears only in 08.17 (Kill and Terminal) and in the closing B25 row, always as T1/T2 with the floor, \(N=8\), the bed, the matched count and the depth skyline \(\lfloor\log_2t^\star\rfloor+2=5\) named in the same row (CHARTER §1). "More accurate" is claimed in no verse of this book, and no A1 or A2 sentence is written here; its one occurrence is 08.6's Hypotheses, which quotes the phrase to withdraw it ("no 'more accurate' reading is licensed from it at any geometry this verse names"), and an item-6 sentence that ignored that occurrence would repeat the defect this item was rewritten to close. A1 and A2 are licensed at no geometry of this canon and this book writes neither form: 06_PREDICTIONS.md:302's Terminal reads "No 'more accurate' sentence in form A2 on any bed of this canon", and a Preface item that licensed A2 at the LM shape would contradict a neighbouring book's Terminal on the identical object. T1 and T2 are licensed at the LM shape only, and only under the counting rule 08.15's Statement now fixes and prints — a parameter that can receive no gradient in the shipped module is a buffer, applied to \(g_h\) and to the two gate heads, which 08.2's blend makes provably constant in the forward at \(g\equiv0\). Under that rule the LM pair reads \(192\) added parameters, \(0.00074627\%\), matched with \(42.9\times\) of margin under Ruling 3, with no re-architecting of the control and no widening of any MLP; the widening move the previous round wrote into 08.15 is deleted, because at \(8\times1025=8{,}200\) parameters it is \(5.47\times\) the size of the act Ruling 3 forbids by name (READ V17K_RULINGS.md:56-59 @ 99777ab: "Do NOT re-architect to close 1.5k params"). At \(d_{\rm model}=16\) the pair is unmatched under both counting rules (\(0.0629\%\) and \(0.7758\%\), \(1.97\times\) and \(24.2\times\) the bar), so T1 and T2 are unlicensed there (08.15).
  7. Every verse ends in a Terminal within three replacements; each replacement's kill is cheaper or more decisive than the one before it.
  8. Struck constants of STRUCK.md appear nowhere; a number without a class is a defect of this book.
  9. Census rows closed here: B26 (the whole book, anchored at 08.1); attachment points for B13 (08.22), B14 (08.17, 08.20), B15 (08.20, 08.21), B25 (08.17, 08.20) — the same mapping the closing table prints, and the only one. The book has exactly \(22\) verses, 08.1 through 08.22 (RUN grep -c '^### 08\.' docs/canon/08_ARCHITECTURE.md \(\to\) 22); there is no 08.23 and no 08.24, and no verse cites one.
  10. The reading order for a builder is 08.1 → 08.4 → 08.14 → 08.21 → 08.22; the reading order for a refuter is the closing table "Kills, cheapest first".

docs.title: Part I — The layer
08.1 — The CEQ attention layer: interface and shapes
docs.text:
Statement. One layer maps \((X, \mathrm{pos}, \mathcal M, i_q, \mathcal D)\) to \((O, z, q, \Delta z, a^\dagger, \phi, \delta)\) where \(X\in\mathbb R^{B\times s\times d_{\rm model}}\) are token embeddings, \(\mathrm{pos}\in\{0,\dots,s-1\}\), \(\mathcal M\in\{0,1\}^{B\times(K+2)\times s}\) are the set masks in the fixed channel order \((\mathrm{sink},\ \mathcal A_0,\ \mathcal A_1,\dots,\mathcal A_K)\), \(i_q\in T\) is the query position, and \(\mathcal D\) is the list of \(m\) candidate moves. Per head the layer forms \(P=W_{\beta,qk,g}\) (08.2), overwrites the boundary rows (08.3), solves once (08.4), and reads (Part II). Shapes at the design geometry and at the planned long-context geometry:

tensor symbol \(s=64,d=16,h=1,K=2,m=8\) LM shape (\(s=512\), \(d_{\rm model}=512\), \(h=8\), \(d=64\)) S-66 long point (\(s=4096\), \(d=16\), \(h=1\), \(n=8\)) queries, keys, values \(Q,K,V\) \([B,1,64,16]\) each \([B,8,512,64]\) \([B,1,4096,16]\) gate heads \(u,\theta\) \([B,64]\) each \([B,512]\) \([B,4096]\) operator \(P\) \([B,1,64,64]\) \([B,8,512,512]\) \([B,1,4096,4096]\) set masks \(\mathcal M\) \([B,4,64]\) \([B,K+2,512]\) \([B,K+2,4096]\) stacked right-hand side \(\tilde V=[V\,\|\,\mathbb 1_{\mathcal A_\bullet}]\) \([B,1,64,20]\) \([B,8,512,64+K+2]\) \([B,1,4096,16+K+2]\) state \(z\) \([B,1,64,20]\) \([B,8,512,64+K+2]\) \([B,1,4096,16+K+2]\) per-head read, pre-concatenation \(O^h\) \([B,1,64,16]\) \([B,8,512,64]\) \([B,1,4096,16]\) layer read, post-concatenation \(O\) \([B,64,16]\) \([B,512,512]\) \([B,4096,16]\) committor vector (head \(0\)) \(q\) \([B,4,64]\) \([B,K+2,512]\) \([B,K+2,4096]\) displacement per move (head \(0\)) \(\Delta z\) \([B,8,64,16]\) \([B,m,512,64]\) \([B,m,4096,16]\) move scores (head \(0\)) \(\max_{k\ge1}q^{(k)}(\mathrm{do}\,a)\) \([B,8]\) \([B,m]\) \([B,m]\) phase (head \(0\)) \((\arg\max_k q_{i_q}^{(k)},\ \text{margin},\ \hat\tau)\) \([B]\), \([B]\), \([B]\) same same certificate \(\delta\) per head, route-dependent \([h]\) \([8]\) \([1]\)

Rank convention, fixed here and printed identically in 08.13 and 08.19. \(O^h\) is the per-head read at \([B,h,s,d]\); \(O\) is \(O^h\) with the head axis concatenated, \([B,s,d_{\rm model}]\), which is what CEQAttention(...).O returns and what o_proj consumes (08.13). The API row out.O float32[B, s, d_model] (08.19) is this same object; only \(O^h\) carries a head axis, and it is tabulated so the budget of 08.20 can price it.

Head convention, fixed here and carried by 08.14. \(P\), \(\gamma_h\), \(\beta_h\), \(\kappa_h\) and \(\delta\) are per head; \(q\), \(\phi\), \(\mu\), \(\hat\tau\), \(\Delta z\) and the move columns are not, because in a boundary layer only head \(0\) carries the boundary rows and the committor head, and heads \(1..h-1\) run at \(\mathcal A=\{0\}\) (sink only). At \(h=8\) there is therefore one committor chain per boundary layer, not eight, and no reduction over heads is defined or needed (08.14, whose Kill decides the designation). Without this rule the eight per-head \(Q,R_k\) produce \(h\) distinct committor vectors and 08.9's argmin, 08.10's phase and 08.19's API are unbuildable at the LM shape — which is why the rule is a Statement and not a convention.

Certificate row, in full. \(\delta=0\) on route = solve_triangular, the shipped route (08.4); \(\delta=\gamma^{K'+1}/(1-\gamma)\) on route = neumann_K, where \(K'\) is the journalled truncation order with registered support \(K'\in\{1,2,4,8,16\}\) (08.11). \(K'\) (the Neumann order) and \(K\) (the number of constraint sets, hence \(K+2\) value channels) are two objects; CHARTER §6's scope sentence writes both with one letter, and this book does not.

The LM shape is ceq/hf/train.py::DEFAULTS (hidden_size=512, n_layers=8, n_heads=8, seq=512, batch=8, READ @ 99777ab); the S-66 points are \((s,n)\in\{(64,2048),(256,2048),(1024,128),(4096,8)\}\) (SHAPE §5.3 S-66, book 03).

Hypotheses. \(\beta=1\) (regime S, SHAPE §2.1 Def. 2); \(\gamma\in[0,1)\) per head; \(0\in\mathcal A_{\rm sink}\); every set precedes \(i_q\) and \(i_q\in T\) (F1, F2); \(K\ge2\) (\(K=1\) makes the committor constant to \(1.11\times10^{-14}\), SHAPE §5.3 S-11, RUN); \(m\ge2\).

Evidence. The constructor and the three switches: READ ceq/arm_smprime.py::ArmSMPrime.__init__ @ 99777ab (wq, wk, m_head, theta_head, beta, qk, g, all nn.Parameter). The block interface: READ ceq/hf/modeling_ceq.py::CEQAttention.__init__ @ 99777ab. The dense operator at the long point is refused: \(n\cdot s^2\cdot4\,\mathrm B=2048\cdot4096^2\cdot4=1.374\times10^{11}\) B \(\approx137\) GB against \(7.996\) GiB (DERIVED; SHAPE §2.4(c), B15), which is why \(n\) is declared per \(s\).

Mechanism. B26 (no architecture page); D-3 (every dial in the interface has a registered support); V-12 (\(K\ge2\)); V-8 (F2 as an input contract).

Kill. A forward call at the design geometry whose output tuple is missing any of the seven fields, or whose shapes disagree with the table, on the first FOUND record of the arm's kind (FOUND-not-NAMED, CHARTER §4). Instrument: the manifest field check of SHAPE §A.10 (book 04, S-01). Price: \(0\) GPU-s. Planted negative: a record from ceq/arm_smprime.py::ArmSMPrime.forward, which returns [n] (one scalar at \(s-1\), READ @ 99777ab) — it must fail the check, and does, because it carries no \(z\), \(q\), \(\Delta z\) or \(\phi\) (D-1, the label class the record could not leave).

If killed. The interface is reduced to the two-head form of SHAPE §2.1 Def. 7: (H-q) the committor vector by the exact solve at \(\gamma=1\) on the transient block and (H-z) the state/displacement channel at \(\hat\gamma\), with the move, phase and certificate fields computed outside the layer from \(q\) and \(z\) by the formulas of 08.9–08.11. Hypotheses: the same. Evidence: Def. 7 is the judged apparatus (SHAPE §A.2). Kill, with its dtype named (V-17): an (H-q, H-z) record whose \(q\) does not satisfy the conservation row to \(10^{-12}\) in float64 on the identity cell, or to \(\epsilon_{32}=1.5\times10^{-4}\) in float32 on the shipped forward — decided on one draw, \(0\) GPU-s, more decisive than the field check because it tests the arithmetic and not the plumbing. The float32 bar is the same DERIVED quantity 08.3 freezes and is restated here rather than carried, because a bar stated once in float64 and applied in float32 is a threshold imported out of its units: float32 unit roundoff is \(2^{-24}=5.960464\times10^{-8}\) (DERIVED), so a single rounding of a value near \(1\) exceeds \(10^{-12}\) by \(5.96\times10^{4}\) and the replacement would die on its own kill at every real draw (V-11 inverted). Without both dtypes printed the (H-q, H-z) form is not a replacement (V-9) and 08.1's chain has one link.

Terminal. A causal softmax head with a learnable \(\gamma\) and one triangular solve, exposing \(z\) only; the canon licenses "the layer contains softmax bitwise at \(\gamma=0\)" and withdraws every read-side sentence.

docs.title: 08.2 — The causal row-stochastic three-corner operator \(P=W_{\beta,qk,g}\)
docs.text:
Statement. Per head, with \(q_i=W_Qx_i\), \(k_j=W_Kx_j\), \(qk_{ij}=\kappa\,q_i\cdot k_j/\sqrt d\), gate magnitudes \(m_k=\mathrm{clamp}(\mathrm{lerp}(1,u_k,g),0,1)\) and phases \(\vartheta_k=g\,\theta_k\) from two per-position scalar heads \((u,\theta)=(\mathrm{Linear}_{d\to1}(x),\mathrm{Linear}_{d\to1}(x))\), $\(W[i,j]=\mathbb 1[j\le i]\ \mathrm{pathProd}(m,\vartheta)_{ij}\ e^{qk_{ij}}/Z_i^{\beta},\qquad \mathrm{pathProd}(m,\vartheta)_{ij}=\prod_{k=j+1}^{i}m_ke^{\mathrm i\vartheta_k},\qquad Z_i=\sum_{j\le i}\Big(\prod_{k=j+1}^im_k\Big)e^{qk_{ij}},\)$ with three scalar switches \((\beta,\kappa,g)\). The corners: \(\beta=1,g=0\) is causal softmax (\(m\equiv1,\vartheta\equiv0\) exactly by the blend, so \(W\) is real and row-stochastic); \(\beta=0,g=0\) is linear attention; \(\beta=0,\kappa=0\) is the path product. The module ships in regime S at the frozen pair \((\beta=1,\ g\equiv0)\), and only there is \(P\) real, causal and row-stochastic with \(P_{ii}>0\) for \(i\ge1\) and \(P_{00}=1\); \(g_h\) is non-learnable in the shipped module (08.13's Replacement 1 made the Statement of 08.13). The masking is applied before the exponential with \(-\infty\) so the upper triangle is \(e^{-\infty}=0\) exactly and the backward meets no inf; the division by \(Z_i^\beta\) is done on real and imaginary parts separately so the real corners are bitwise. At \(g\equiv0\) the operator is built and stored real — the branch if g == 0: return num.real / zb — which is what makes the \(\gamma=0\) corner bitwise anyway and which fixes the byte width at \(4\) B/element for 08.20 and 08.21.

Why \(\beta=1\) alone does not give a row-stochastic \(P\). DERIVED, three lines. (i) READ ceq/arm_smprime.py::operator @ 99777ab: num, mod = numerator(...), zb = mod.sum(-1, keepdim=True) ** beta, return torch.complex(num.real/zb, num.imag/zb); numerator returns (gh * e, rh * e) where gh = path_product(gate(m, th)) carries \(e^{\mathrm i\vartheta}\) and rh = path_product(m) does not. (ii) The row sum at \(\beta=1\) is therefore \(\sum_{j\le i}m_{ij}e^{\mathrm i\vartheta_{ij}}e^{qk_{ij}}\big/\sum_{j\le i}m_{ij}e^{qk_{ij}}\) — the numerator carries the phase, the normaliser \(Z_i\) does not — a complex number of modulus \(\le1\), equal to \(1\) iff \(\vartheta\equiv0\), i.e. iff \(g=0\). (iii) The departure is \(O(1)\), not roundoff: this verse's own manifest reads the \(g\) switch's effect size at \(0.673101\) (Evidence below). Every verse in Parts II–IV that assumes a real row-stochastic \(P\) therefore carries \(g=0\) in its Hypotheses by name: 08.3 (identity rows and the conservation identity), 08.4 (the hull bound and \(\Pi_\gamma\)'s row sums), 08.7 (\(q\in[0,1]\) and \(\sum_\bullet q^{(\bullet)}=\mathbb 1\)), 08.11 (the certificate's row-stochastic hypothesis), 08.12 (the absorbing-chain reading). If \(g\) is ever unfrozen, none of those hypotheses hold and the operator needs a derived row-sum guard with its own frozen kill before any of them may be restated — that guard is not written in this book and is NOT MEASURED — needs the complex row-sum instrument (book 03/04).

Hypotheses. Finite logits; \(\beta=1\) and \(g\equiv0\) for every row-stochasticity sentence above (the two together are regime S as this book ships it); \(d\) the head width; the gate is read from the key-side position \(k\) (the product runs over \(k\in(j,i]\)); one \((u,\theta)\) pair per position shared across heads, which is the arm's own shape (READ ceq/hf/modeling_ceq.py::CEQAttention docstring @ 99777ab).

Evidence. READ ceq/arm_smprime.py:144 @ 99777ab (hop), ceq/arm_smprime.py::operator, ::numerator, ::blend @ 99777ab; LEAN lean/CEQ/V16Domain.lean:92-97 @ 99777ab (pathProd), three_corners_containment :433, corners_are_distinct :445, no_prefix_scan_represents_a_zero_gate :165 (READ via SHAPE §2.1 Def. 1). The corner is bitwise against the lane's own softmaxAttn: RUN[coord] torch.equal(O(0),PV)=True at \(s=64,d=16\) (SHAPE §2.2 Prop. 1); the record's other softmax routine is \(1.110223\times10^{-16}\) off on \(19/64\) entries (READ V16_ARM_SMPRIME.md:266-293 @ 99777ab), so "bitwise" is always stated against a named routine. Effect sizes of the two switches in the manifest: \(3.522037\) (QK), \(0.673101\) (\(g\)) (SHAPE §A.10, RUN).

Mechanism. V-24 (the corner bind has a non-empty rejection region: \(\gamma=0.5\) reads \(2.3002850040264393\), \(\beta=0\) at the softmax corner reads a gap \(>0.5\)); V-25 (the gate has a subject only in this base); P-7.

Kill. torch.equal(P_{\beta=1,g=0}, \mathrm{softmax}_{\rm causal}(qk)) reads False on any draw at \(s=64,d=16\) in float32 on the certified device, against the lane's own softmaxAttn (ceq/lm.py::Attention, kind softmax). Instrument: bind B-J (SHAPE §5.3 S-20; book 04). Price: \(\le1.7\) s for one cell [FITTED+RUN]. Planted negatives that must fail at \(O(1)\): \(\beta=0\) (gap \(>0.5\)), route exp_scan on a draw with a zero gate (nan, READ ceq/arm_smprime.py::hop_scan @ 99777ab).

If killed. The gate is deleted from the shipped operator: \(P=\mathrm{softmax}_{\rm causal}(qk)\) with \(\beta\equiv1\), \(g\equiv0\) frozen (not learnable), and the only remaining parameters per head are \(W_Q,W_K,W_V\) and \(\gamma\). Hypotheses: finite logits. Evidence, as [V-eq], because the replacement operator is load-bearing and [V] is inadmissible for it (L-EQ, P-10) — the statement, its hypotheses, one numeric instance: statement — for a row-stochastic causal \(P\) and \(\gamma\in[0,1)\), the ChaCAL layer's output is \((1-\gamma)P(I-\gamma P)^{-1}V\) (fagnou-2024-chacal Eq. 5); hypotheses — \(P\) causal row-stochastic, \(\gamma<1\), the diagonal convention declared (ChaCAL removes it, the record's variant keeps it, SHAPE §A.4, and the two are different operators, B22); one numeric instance — at \(\gamma=0\) the expression collapses to \(PV\) and the lane reads torch.equal(O(0),PV)=True at \(s=64,d=16\) (RUN[coord], SHAPE §2.2 Prop. 1), while at \(\gamma=0.6\) every row of the bare \(P(I-\gamma P)^{-1}\) sums to \(1/(1-\gamma)=2.5\) (RUN[J], 08.3 Evidence), which is the same identity with the \((1-\gamma)\) factor stripped. The diagonal convention is the one line this instance does not settle and it decides two controls (B22, book 01/04). Kill: torch.equal against F.scaled_dot_product_attention(is_causal=True) reads False at \(\gamma=0\) — the same bind at the same price but now with no gate in the rejection region, hence strictly more decisive about the softmax half.

Terminal. The operator is standard causal softmax; the canon withdraws every gated-corner sentence (segmentation, F0 dividend, corner 3) and keeps the resolvent read of 08.4 on it.

docs.title: 08.3 — Boundary rows: the goal set, \(K\) constraint sets and the declared sink as identity rows
docs.text:
Statement. Given disjoint position sets \(\mathcal A_{\rm sink}=\{0\}\), \(\mathcal A_0\) (goal), \(\mathcal A_1,\dots,\mathcal A_K\) (constraints), \(\mathcal A=\bigsqcup\mathcal A_\bullet\), \(T=[s]\setminus\mathcal A\), the layer overwrites \(P_{a,\cdot}\leftarrow e_a\) for every \(a\in\mathcal A\) after the softmax, by a masked row assignment P[a,:]=0; P[a,a]=1. In canonical order \(P=\begin{pmatrix}Q&R\\0&I\end{pmatrix}\) with \(Q=P_{TT}\), \(R_k=P_{T\mathcal A_k}\). The sink's two channel groups are separate objects and this Statement separates them. The \(d\) value columns of \(\tilde V\) are zeroed at position \(0\), so BOS contributes nothing to \(O\); the \(K+2\) indicator columns are the set memberships unmodified, so \(\mathbb 1_{\mathcal A_{\rm sink}}[0]=1\) and the sink is a full absorbing target of the committor read. The sink is not a goal member. Conflating the two — "the sink carries value \(0\) on every indicator channel" — sets \(R_{\rm sink}=0\), hence \(\hat q^{(\rm sink)}_T=(I-Q)^{-1}R_{\rm sink}\mathbb 1=0\) identically and \(\sum_\bullet q^{(\bullet)}=1-q^{(\rm sink)}\), which on the judge's own draw is as low as \(0\) because the sink share reads \([0.362,1.000]\) (RUN[SATURN], Evidence below): 08.7's conservation kill would then fire on \(100\) per cent of draws.

The object this Statement overrides, named, with the record's own inconsistency printed rather than absorbed (V-22, D-4, M-2). The sentence just called a defect is not this book's invention: it is the bed's registration, verbatim in two places. READ docs/CEQ_SHAPE.md:1673 @ 207e7b9, S-10: "BED-S therefore declares \(\mathcal A_{\rm sink}=\{0\}\) with value \(0\) on every indicator channel — not a goal member". READ 04_BEDS_AND_INSTRUMENTS.md:27 @ HEAD: "boundary sets \(\mathcal A_{\rm sink}=\{0\}\) (value \(0\) on every indicator channel)", carried again at 04_BEDS_AND_INSTRUMENTS.md:186 as a live Hypothesis of that book's own If-killed link 1. So after this Statement book 08 specifies \(\mathbb 1_{\mathcal A_{\rm sink}}[0]=1\) and book 04 and S-10 specify \(\mathbb 1_{\mathcal A_{\rm sink}}[0]=0\) for the same bed, and the sink share \([0.362,1.000]\) that 08.3, 08.4, 08.9 and 08.10 all cite is a RUN[SATURN] reading taken on book 04's convention. The record contradicts itself and this is decidable, not a matter of preference: DERIVED, one line — under \(\mathbb 1_{\mathcal A_{\rm sink}}[0]=0\) the escape row is \(R_{\rm sink}=0\), so \(q^{(\rm sink)}_T=(I-Q)^{-1}\cdot0=0\) on every transient position, and a sink share of \(0.362\) — let alone \(1.000\) — cannot be produced by any draw of any generator under that convention. S-10's own measure line reports both the convention and the share, and the two are inconsistent inside one card. This book therefore ships the carries convention (\(\mathbb 1_{\mathcal A_{\rm sink}}[0]=1\)), because it is the only one of the two under which S-10's own measured number exists.

What this book cannot close, stated as the loss it is. Which convention the canon ships is a CORRECTIONS.md row and a repoint of 04_BEDS_AND_INSTRUMENTS.md's 04.2 Statement and its :186 Hypotheses; CORRECTIONS.md is the canon's only door (CHARTER §0, §7) and no book writes into another book. That row is NOT WRITTEN — needs the coordinator's CORRECTIONS.md row naming sink_indicator_convention and repointing 04.2 (CHARTER §7). Until it exists, every committor number of this book — the sink share \([0.362,1.000]\), the conservation reading \(4.4\times10^{-16}\), the \(\mathcal S\)-discard and \(\mathcal F\)-emptiness censuses of 08.9, the conditioned margin of 08.10 — is read under carries and is NOT MEASURED on the bed as registered under zeroed, which is what books 04 and S-10 currently register. sink_indicator_convention ∈ {carries, zeroed} is a mandatory manifest field (08.22), and a cell that does not journal it is a refusal, so no reader can take a number of this book for a number on the bed as registered. This half of the defect is recorded OPEN in "Attacks answered" and this verse's Terminal is in force for it. \(I-\gamma P\) is then lower-triangular with diagonal \(1-\gamma P_{ii}\in[1-\gamma,1)\), a unit for every \(\gamma<1\); at \(\gamma=1\) the transient block \(I-Q\) is a unit iff \(0\in\mathcal A\), because \(\rho(Q)=\max_{i\in T}P_{ii}\) on the causal class.

Hypotheses. \(\beta=1\) and \(g\equiv0\), so \(P\) is real and row-stochastic and \(P_{a,\cdot}\leftarrow e_a\) leaves it so (08.2: at \(g\ne0\) the rows are complex of modulus \(\le1\) and none of the sentences below hold). F1: row 0 of any causal softmax at \(\beta=1\) is \(e_0\), so position 0 is absorbing whether or not declared. F2: walks descend, so a set after \(i_q\) has committor exactly \(0.0\). Every set precedes \(i_q\); \(i_q\in T\); sets are given as masks, never as positions derived from any solve (D-2).

Evidence. SHAPE §2.1 Def. 3 and §2.2 Prop. 10 (DERIVED + RUN): \(\rho(Q)=0.6926596893360386\) read both as spectral radius and as \(\max_TP_{ii}\) (RUN[J]); undeclared BOS gives \(\det(I-Q)=0.0\) (RUN[J]); with \(\mathcal A_{\rm sink}=\{0\}\) declared, the conservation row holds to \(4.4\times10^{-16}\) and the sink share reads \([0.362,1.000]\) on the judge's draw (RUN[SATURN], SHAPE §5.3 S-10); a set at position 20 read from query 12 gives \(q=0.0\) exactly (RUN[SATURN]). The bare read \(P(I-\gamma P)^{-1}\) has every row sum \(1/(1-\gamma)\) with or without the sets (\(2.5\) at \(\gamma=0.6\), RUN[J], RUN[M]), so the \((1-\gamma)\) factor is a property of the class (SHAPE §2.1 Def. 4). Boundary rows change weights downstream, never the support: \(\mathrm{supp}\,\Pi_\gamma=\mathrm{supp}\,P\) (RUN[J] True, SHAPE §2.2 Prop. 5(c)). Column sink and row condition are distinct objects that coexist (V15Fork.Asink, lean/CEQ/V15Fork.lean:67-70 @ 99777ab; xiao-2023-attentionsinks [V]).

Mechanism. V-25 (a theorem whose hypothesis no draw satisfies — F1/F2 are the two census lines); V-12 (a single absorbing target makes the label constant); V-8; C8 (regime N admits no absorbing row: one_not_nilpotent, lean/CEQ/Nilpotent.lean via SHAPE §2.1 Def. 2).

Kill, with one bar per dtype, because a bar stated once and applied in two dtypes decides nothing (V-17, M-2). On the bed's own generator with \(\mathcal A_{\rm sink}=\{0\}\) declared, any draw with \(\rho(Q)=1\) (a second undeclared absorbing row), or the conservation residual \(|q^{({\rm sink})}+q^{(0)}+\sum_kq^{(k)}-1|_\infty\) above the bar of the dtype the cell ran in, on any declared draw:

cell dtype frozen bar how the bar is fixed the identity cell (08.3, 08.7) float64 \(\epsilon_{64}=10^{-8}\) the record's own reading is \(4.4\times10^{-16}\) (Evidence), eight orders below the bar the shipped forward (08.4's solve_triangular on CUDA) float32 \(\epsilon_{32}=1.5\times10^{-4}\) DERIVED below the operator row sum \(\|\mathrm{rowsum}(P)-1\|_\infty\) (08.17's per-step guard) — a different quantity, not the conservation residual float32 \(\epsilon_{\rm rs}=s\cdot2^{-24}=3.815\times10^{-6}\) at \(s=64\) DERIVED below, in its own units; never \(\epsilon_{32}\)

The third row exists because the first two bars carry an amplification the third does not, and the two were the same number until this round (V-17, V-22). DERIVED, four lines. (i) \(\epsilon_{32}\) is the bar on the conservation residual of the forward substitution and its whole content is the amplification factor \(|T|\cdot\|(I-Q)^{-1}\|_\infty=63\times23.81=1{,}500\); the operator's row sum carries no substitution and no such factor. (ii) With \(\mathrm{rowsum}(P)=1+\eta\) on \(T\), \(Q\mathbb 1+R\mathbb 1=(1+\eta)\mathbb 1\), so \(\sum_\bullet q=(I-Q)^{-1}R\mathbb 1=\mathbb 1+(I-Q)^{-1}\eta\) and the conservation residual is \(\|(I-Q)^{-1}\|_\infty|\eta|\le23.81|\eta|\). (iii) Freezing the row-sum guard at \(\epsilon_{32}=1.5\times10^{-4}\) therefore admits a conservation residual of \(23.81\times1.5\times10^{-4}=3.5715\times10^{-3}\), which is \(23.81\times\) this table's own float32 bar and \(3.57\times10^{5}\) times its float64 bar \(\epsilon_{64}=10^{-8}\) — a cell would pass the row-sum guard at every one of 08.17's \(150\) steps and fire this verse's and 08.7's conservation kill on the same operator. (iv) The bar in the row sum's own units is the roundoff floor of the softmax normaliser: the row sum is \(s\) additions of terms of modulus \(\le1\), each carrying \(2^{-24}=5.960464\times10^{-8}\), so \(\epsilon_{\rm rs}=s\cdot2^{-24}=3.8147\times10^{-6}\) at \(s=64\) and it is re-derived at any other \(s\), never carried (V-22). Consistency, printed: at \(|\eta|\le\epsilon_{\rm rs}\) the induced conservation residual is \(\le23.81\times3.8147\times10^{-6}=9.083\times10^{-5}=0.606\times\epsilon_{32}\), inside this table's first two rows, which is the property the guard must have and did not. The propagated alternative \(\epsilon_{32}/\|(I-Q)^{-1}\|_\infty=1.5\times10^{-4}/23.81=6.300\times10^{-6}\) is \(1.65\times\) looser than \(\epsilon_{\rm rs}\); the tighter of the two is frozen, so both readings are satisfied.

DERIVED, the float32 bar, three lines: (i) float32 unit roundoff is \(2^{-24}=5.960464\times10^{-8}\); (ii) forward substitution over \(|T|\) rows amplifies it by at most \(|T|\cdot\|(I-Q)^{-1}\|_\infty\), and \(\|Q\|_\infty=0.958\) (08.7 Evidence, RUN[I]) gives \(\|(I-Q)^{-1}\|_\infty\le1/(1-0.958)=23.81\); (iii) at \(|T|=63\) (\(s=64\), one declared sink) the residual is of order \(c\cdot63\cdot23.81\cdot2^{-24}=c\cdot8.94\times10^{-5}\), so \(\epsilon_{32}=1.5\times10^{-4}\) freezes \(c=1.68\) of headroom [ASSUMED: \(c\) is the one constant of this bar and is `NOT MEASURED — needs one float32 identity cell on the certified device (book 04, S-22); until it is read, \(c=1\) is the derivation and \(1.68\) the headroom]. The bar rescales with \(|T|\) and \(\|(I-Q)^{-1}\|_\infty\) and is re-derived, never carried, at any other geometry (V-22). Applying \(\epsilon_{64}=10^{-8}\) to a float32 cell fires on every honest draw — one rounding already exceeds it — and decides nothing. Instrument: bind B-E2 (SHAPE §5.3 S-22; book 04). Price: \(0\) GPU-s. Planted negatives: drop BOS from every set — the solve must raise (\(\det(I-Q)=0.0\)), never return a number (V-16); a set after the query — \(q=0.0\) exactly and the draw discarded; and, for the dtype bar itself, a float32 cell run at a geometry with \(|T|=1200\) must read a residual above \(\epsilon_{32}\) and be repriced rather than failed, or the bar is being carried out of its units.

If killed. Replacement 1 — the column-sink token. Delete the row overwrite; prepend one token per set whose key is trained so that softmax mass flowing to it is the absorption read, with value \(0\) on the \(d\) value columns and its own membership set to \(1\) on its indicator column (V15Fork.Asink_computes_chain, the K-E1 control ChaCAL-with-sink-token, SHAPE §5.3 S-31). The channel separation of the Statement is inherited verbatim: a replacement that zeroes the indicator inherits the defect and is not a replacement (V-9). Hypotheses: \(\beta=1\); the sink tokens precede \(i_q\). Evidence: Bet F's counter predicts exactly this — component (e) is a parameterisation of a column sink (SHAPE §5.5 Bet F). Kill: the committor \(\varphi\)-NRMSE of the sink-token arm not within \(\mathrm{MDE}_8\) of the row-boundary arm on at least \(6\) of \(8\) seeds (the sink token is then not a replacement and the row condition stands); price \(\approx52\) s at eight seeds, escalation \(\approx44\) s at \(N=16\) — cheaper than nothing new but more decisive than the residual check because it is paired. Replacement 2 — the separate committor head. The layer carries no boundary rows; the committor is a second module: the exact Dirichlet solve \(\hat q=(I-\hat Q)^{-1}\hat R_k\mathbb 1\) on the transient block of the learned \(\hat P\) with the sets applied only inside that solve (SHAPE §2.1 Def. 7 (H-q)). Hypotheses: \(0\in\mathcal A\) inside the head; \(\mathbb 1_{\mathcal A_{\rm sink}}[0]=1\) on the indicator column (the Statement's separation, inherited). Evidence: bed_1.committor's form (READ ceq/beds/bed_1.py:188-198 @ 99777ab). Kill, per dtype: the head's \(\hat q\) differs from the Dirichlet solve on the same \(\hat Q\) by more than \(10^{-12}\) in float64, or by more than \(\epsilon_{32}=1.5\times10^{-4}\) in float32 — \(0\) GPU-s, a pure identity. A single \(10^{-12}\) bar applied to the shipped float32 path is \(5.96\times10^{4}\) below one rounding and can never be met (the Kill's DERIVED block).

Terminal. A causal softmax with a declared value-zero BOS sink and no reach-avoid read; the canon licenses "the layer computes \(E_i[\gamma^{\tau-1}]\) toward position 0" and withdraws "safest move under \(K\) constraints".

docs.title: 08.4 — One lower-triangular solve with \(K+2\) value channels, and the read
docs.text:
Statement. With \(\tilde V=[V\,\|\,\mathbb 1_{\mathcal A_{\rm sink}}\,\|\,\mathbb 1_{\mathcal A_0}\,\|\,\mathbb 1_{\mathcal A_1}\,\|\cdots\|\,\mathbb 1_{\mathcal A_K}]\in\mathbb R^{s\times(d+K+2)}\), the \(d\) value columns forced to \(0\) at position \(0\) and the \(K+2\) indicator columns left unmodified (08.3: \(\mathbb 1_{\mathcal A_{\rm sink}}[0]=1\), so \(R_{\rm sink}=P_{T,0}\ne0\) and \(q^{(\rm sink)}\) is the escape mass, not identically zero), $\(z=(I-\gamma P)^{-1}\tilde V\quad\text{by forward substitution},\qquad O=(1-\gamma)\,P\,z_{[:,:d]},\qquad \Pi_\gamma=(1-\gamma)P(I-\gamma P)^{-1}.\)$ Specification of the solve (pseudocode, one head, one sequence):

# Vtilde: [s, d + K + 2].  Column groups are DISTINCT objects (08.3).
Vtilde[:, :d]   = V                     # the d VALUE columns
Vtilde[0, :d]   = 0                     # BOS contributes nothing to O
Vtilde[:, d:]   = masks.T               # the K+2 INDICATOR columns, UNMODIFIED
                                        # so Vtilde[0, d + 0] == 1  (sink membership)
                                        # R_sink = P[T, 0]  is the escape row, non-zero

M = I - gamma * P                       # lower-triangular, diag in [1-gamma, 1)
z = solve_triangular(M, Vtilde, upper=False, unitriangular=False)
O = (1 - gamma) * (P @ z[:, :d])

The row \(R_{\rm sink}=P_{T,0}\), printed explicitly: with \(\mathcal A_{\rm sink}=\{0\}\) its entries are the causal-softmax weights from each transient position onto BOS, strictly positive on the whole of \(T\) because the mask admits \(j=0\) from every \(i\); zeroing the sink's indicator column would set this row's contribution to \(0\) and make \(q^{(\rm sink)}\equiv0\), against a measured sink share of \([0.362,1.000]\) (08.3 Evidence, RUN[SATURN]).
