docs.title: 0.4 What fits in 7.996 GiB and what does not (READ COSTS.md:109-116; DERIVED model in §5.0)
docs.text: Measured: softmax resident to n = 32768 at s = 64 (4.908 GiB reserved); arm_smprime resident to 8192 (3.777 GiB) and not to 16384 under a training loop (10.578 GiB, Ruling 8 READ V17K_RULINGS.md:328-339); the shape adds 8 · (n/2048) MiB for z and keeps its [S, S] operand at 4.0 B/elem because solve_triangular has no bf16 path in torch 2.5.1 ([U]). So on the softmax corner every arena card below is resident with ≥ 8× headroom (0.9224 GiB measured for the arm cell, READ V17_R4_RETAKE_PRICE.md:139); on the corner-3 base n ≤ 8192. Past s = 64 the explicit operator decides (§5.0): the dense resolvent at n = 2048, s = 4096 is 137 GB and does not run anywhere; n is declared per s.

docs.title: 1. Phase 0 — free (0 GPU-s): theorems, manifests, the price ledger
docs.text:
M0.1 — Build the ten [M] Lean targets with their refusals. Phase 0. Prereq none. Independent-of every other card. Build: lean/CEQ/Shape.lean declaring rows 1–10 of judge/sec_shape.md §4.6 (gamma_zero_is_softmax, bos_row_is_absorbing at β = 1, later_boundary_unreachable, softmax_corner_not_nilpotent, lower_triangular_isUnit + diag_one_sub_smul_pos, resolvent_fromBlocks + segmentation_blockdiag on StrictlyLower, cut_makes_segment_head_absorbing, displacement_identity, lowerTriangular_ne_symmSupport, committor_is_resolvent_read (a)/(b-causal)) each with the refusal named in that table; #print axioms on every declaration. Prove: the ten statements as written, grade [M]; any [M] resting on a [U] Mathlib name (Matrix.det_of_lowerTriangular, inv_fromBlocks_zero₂₁_of_isUnit_iff) is [S] until it builds. Measure: lake build exit code, grep -c sorry, the axiom list. PASS: exit 0, 0 sorry, axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] only, 169 + 10 declarations. KILL: a sorry or a sorryAx demotes that row to [S], and no paper sentence cites it (L-LEAN, P-11 — the contract's #18/#19/#22 [M] with no declaration, sec_proved.md §2.0). Price: 0 GPU-s. Mechanism: P-11, L-LEAN, V-25. Deliverable: lean/CEQ/Shape.lean; docs/PLAN.md §P0 row with the build log. Evenings: 1. [cheapest-decisive 1 of 5]

M0.2 — Extend the identity manifest and plant its drift test. Phase 0. Prereq none. Independent-of all. Build: the field list of sec_apparatus.md §A.10 (beta/qk/g, gamma init/final/Λ/verdict, diag_convention, committor_route, route + K + chunk C, boundary_sets/goal_set/sink_set + sha256, K/m/t_star, S/D/d_model/n_train/n_eval/steps, seed/rng_plan, device/threads/dtype/cublas_workspace/deterministic_regime, instrument_hash/manifest_hash, producer_cmd, delta_vec/delta_bare/one_over_1mg/V_inf, census, the four floors, the skyline settings, void_contrasts, supersedes); a missing declared field is a refusal, not absent (READ scale/identity_manifest.py:141-151 reports; the shape lane raises). Prove: nothing. Measure: flip each of beta/qk/g/gamma/boundary_sets by one unit; count hash moves. PASS: 5/5 moves, and a run with one declared field missing raises. KILL: any flip that leaves manifest_hash unchanged (the L-2 defect: 0 of 24 attributable, READ V20_R15_LEAP_LEDGER.md:23). Price: 0 GPU-s. Mechanism: L-2, P-1, V-16, M-10, M-16. Deliverable: docs/MANIFEST_SHAPE.md (field table + the flip counts). Evenings: 1.

M0.3 — Freeze the price ledger and the obstruction census lines. Phase 0. Prereq none. Independent-of all. Build: docs/PRICE_LEDGER.md carrying §0.1–0.4 verbatim with provenance, plus the three vacuity inequalities printed beside their citations — h·m·p = 512 ≥ 64 (sanford-2024-inductionheads Thm 1), n log₂ n = 384 < 544 (peng-2024-transformer-limitations Thm 1), 64^{1/16} = 1.2968 (chen-2024-multilayer Thm 1.1) — all vacuous at s = 64, d = 16, p = 32; conditional bounds (sanford-2024-logdepth Cor 4.3) labelled conditional in the same sentence. Prove: nothing. Measure: nothing. PASS: every price in the ledger carries a tag and a producer; every obstruction carries its inequality. KILL: any price without [FITTED R²]/[RUN]/[ASSUMED], or any "cannot" sentence outside the skyline table (K-10). Price: 0. Mechanism: P-1, P-8, V-25, P-10, K-10, K-11. Deliverable: docs/PRICE_LEDGER.md. Evenings: 1.

M0.4 — Close the six [S] Lean targets. Phase 0. Prereq M0.1. Independent-of every Phase 1–5 card (off the critical path). Build: rows 11–16 of §4.6 (pathprod_is_chain_resolvent, neumann_truncation_bound + neumann_tail_attained + mask_amplification with the s = 3 witness 0.5263, resolvent_is_triangular_solve + mixing_matrix_rowStochastic, causal_forward_only + suffix_resolve_eq_full + sherman_morrison_row, isUnit_one_sub_of_perron + reach_avoid_sum_one, masked_sink_finite_sum), one file each of the V15Source.lean scale (201 lines, 7 declarations). PASS/KILL: as M0.1 per file. Price: 0. Mechanism: P-11, V-3 (neumann_tail_attained is declared definitional), V-24 (nonstochastic_breaks_bound at a convergent γ). Deliverable: lean/CEQ/ShapeS.lean (or one file per target). Evenings: 4.

docs.title: 2. Phase 1 — BED-S construction and census (0 GPU-s; CPU seconds)
docs.text:
M1.1 — Write the BED-S generator specification. Phase 1. Prereq none. Independent-of M0.x, M2.0, M2.1. Build: docs/BED_S_SPEC.md — the environment is a random DAG in token order with self-loops only on declared absorbing positions (sec_apparatus.md §A.1); 𝒜_sink = {0} (BOS, value 0 on every indicator channel), 𝒜_0 the goal, 𝒜_1..𝒜_K the constraints, all before the query (F1/F2, THESIS_CORRECTIONS_2.md §1); node tokens carry out-adjacency multi-hot, membership flags, nothing from a solve; m query-side row clamps P_env[v_a, :] ← e_{u_a}; oracle = the Dirichlet solve of bed_1.committor's form at γ = 1 on the transient block, Δz by Δz = (I − γP')^{-1}(ΔV + γΔP z) on P_env; label [m, K+2] reach-avoid tensor + argmin + z* + Δz(a); dials t* ∈ {2, 8, 32} (tolerance dial, E2_DIAL_TOL, READ scale/negation_scope.py:264), K ∈ {2, 3, 4}, m ∈ {4, 8, 16} default 8; journal fields = the M0.2 manifest + census. Prove: nothing. Measure: nothing yet. PASS: the spec names every field a developer needs and the D-4 registration triple (M3_TASKS entry, E_T_STAR, calibrate_bar hooks) on the same commit. KILL: a spec that lets the transition matrix or any q into x (D-2, C2(c)). Price: 0. Mechanism: D-2, D-3, D-4, V-12, V-8. Deliverable: docs/BED_S_SPEC.md. Evenings: 2.

M1.2 — Run the BED-S construction census on 512 draws. Phase 1. Prereq M1.1. Independent-of M0.x, M2.0. Build: the fifteen lines of sec_apparatus.md §A.7 printed per draw batch. Measure: row sums |Σ − 1| ≤ 1e-12; 0 ∈ 𝒜_sink on 100 %; ρ(Q̂) = max_T P_ii < 1; sets before the query on 100 %; label sd per coordinate over the admitted region; sink share; argmin class frequencies; disagreement fraction; discard count; Var(Δz) > 0 over coordinates ≥ i_min; the move census. PASS: every sd > 0.05, every class frequency in (0.05, 0.95), disagreement > 0, 0 ∈ 𝒜_sink and sets-before-query on 100 %, discard fraction printed. KILL: any sd = 0 (V-8/V-12: the record's 1.11e-14), any class outside the band, disagreement 0 (only one rule may then be named, C4), ρ(Q) = 1 on any draw (BOS undeclared — the solve must raise, V-16). The bed is not admitted and no arm runs (D-4). Price: 0 GPU-s; the oracle is m factorisations with K + 2 right-hand sides, |T|³/3 = 5.8e8 MACs at |T| = 1200, under a second per draw in float64 (sec_beds.md §6.D.5). Mechanism: V-8, V-12, V-25, D-3, D-4, V-16. Deliverable: results/bed_s_census.jsonl + the table in docs/BED_S_SPEC.md §census. Evenings: 1. [cheapest-decisive 2 of 5]

M1.3 — Register the VOID list, the metrics and the floors before any cell. Phase 1. Prereq M1.1. Independent-of M1.2. Build: docs/BED_S_SPEC.md §registration — VOID as capability numbers: shape − softmax, shape − skyline on the committor head; creditable: shape − ChaCAL-diag, shape − ChaCAL-published, shape − ChaCAL-with-sink, shape − InfSA-K16, shape − 0-hop MLP, shape − 1-hop softmax, ‖P̂ − P_env‖_∞ per seed; metrics: position-matched NRMSE vector, harmonic residual with σ_min and ‖I − γP_env‖_∞ printed, Fisher–Rao φ = 2 arcsin √p, field cosine with masked zero-variance coordinates, CP (clopper-1934-binomial) and McNemar on the sign column only (mcnemar-1947-correlated); floors: exact oracle 0.0, zero-information 1 − 1/m = 0.875 at m = 8, tight Fano (ln m − ln 2)/ln(m − 1) = 0.7124 only where I(X_{≤k}; a*) > 0 (cover-2006-elements §2.10 [U] on the theorem number); the weak Fano 0.6667 struck. PASS: the list exists in a commit dated before M3.1's first cell. KILL: any contrast or threshold first written after a cell exists (M-2, M-7). Price: 0. Mechanism: D-2, M-2, M-7, V-26, L-FLOOR, V-10, V-17. Deliverable: docs/BED_S_SPEC.md §registration. Evenings: 1.

M1.4 — Run the BED-S zero-hop control before any arm. Phase 1. Prereq M1.2, M1.3. Independent-of M0.x, M2.0. Build: (a) the untrained-arm read (0-step RED gate) on the admitted draw; (b) the 0-hop per-position MLP on the candidate's context row at matched 4,769 parameters (Ruling 3, count re-printed per arm), N = 8, 150 steps; (c) the corpus-alone probes x → q at order 0. Measure: argmin accuracy of (a) within 1/m ± CP; committor NRMSE of (a) ≥ 1 − GATE_TOL; (b)'s argmin accuracy with CP; (c) R². PASS: (a) at chance, (c) R² < 0.5, and (b)'s CP-upper on accuracy sits at or below the zero-information floor 0.875 error, i.e. the label is not readable from the candidate's own row. KILL: (b) reading above the zero-information floor by more than its CP half-width ⇒ BED-S is a third static task (C8, READ D1.md:286-291) and is struck before any number; (c) R² ≥ 0.5 ⇒ the one-read claim is void on this bed (leak kill (c)). Price: ≤ 8 × 1.525 + 4 = 16.2 s (the MLP costs no more than the softmax cell, DERIVED). Mechanism: V-10, D-5, C8, V-24 (the planted leak of M1.5 is its rejection half). Deliverable: results/shape_bed_s.jsonl (kind = mlp0, kind = untrained) + docs/PLAN.md §P1 verdict line. Evenings: 1.

M1.5 — Plant the leak and fire the detector both ways. Phase 1. Prereq M1.2. Independent-of M1.4. Build: a move token carrying its own q (planted positive); the E4′ local-feature decoder re-derived for BED-S (FAIL_BAR/PASS_BAR of READ scale/rips_gate.py:60-61 are E4′'s and are marked V-22, not BED-S bars). Measure: corpus-alone probe R² with and without the plant. PASS: planted R² ≥ 0.99, honest R² < 0.5. KILL: a detector that reads the same on both (V-24, V-7). Price: 0 GPU-s (linear probes on CPU). Mechanism: V-24, V-7, V-22, D-2. Deliverable: results/bed_s_census.jsonl rows leak_plant, leak_honest. Evenings: 1.

docs.title: 3. Phase 2 — the arm, the smoke tests, the front-door binds (seconds)
docs.text:
M2.0 — Build the shape arm as a registered kind. Phase 2. Prereq none (building is not training; L-LEAN gates M2.2, not M2.0). Independent-of M1.x, M0.x. Build: one module exposing the corners β/qk/g, a learnable γ ∈ [0, 1) (init 0), boundary_sets/goal_set/sink_set as identity rows, diag_convention ∈ {kept, removed}, route ∈ {solve_triangular, neumann_K}, committor_route ∈ {dirichlet_gamma1, discounted_gamma}, the read O = (1 − γ) P (I − γP)^{-1} V (the (1 − γ) factor carried, fagnou-2024-chacal Eq. 5 [V]), heads (H-q) the exact triangular solve at γ = 1 on the transient block and (H-z) the state/displacement channel at γ̂; make_arm branch, optimiser path, journal emit — the W2 lesson (READ V20_R15_WING_MANIFEST.md:115-123: a three-line branch was the whole gap). Prove: nothing. Measure: the arm produces a journalled record with its kind under results/ (FOUND, not NAMED, READ V20_R15_WING_MANIFEST.md:59-63). PASS: one FOUND record. KILL: a kind with 0 records at the end of Phase 2 is STRUCK (the R15 kill). Price: 0 GPU-s to build; the first record is M2.2's. Mechanism: FOUND-not-NAMED, P-4, L-2. Deliverable: the author's module (a .py the author writes; not written here) + docs/PLAN.md §P2 FOUND line. Evenings: 3.

M2.1 — Take the ~6 GPU-s capped run at seeds 2, 3, 7 on BED-M. Phase 2. Prereq none. Independent-of every card in this plan. Build: nothing new — arm_pl on e3_t2, n = 2048, s = 64, the three NO-READING seeds (READ V15_R1.md:177-188: 1.113403 / 1.139404 / 1.152430, â_max 20.31 / 49.66 / 285.07), with the capped gate (1.884 s per cell), torch.cuda.synchronize() bracketing, randomised order. Prove: nothing. Measure: eval_nrmse and â_max per seed against the uncapped values. PASS (Q3/W3 LEAPABLE reading): all three cross floor₁ = 0.7071 when capped — the divergence was the cause of NO READING, sign(λ̂) is not fixed by initialisation. KILL (TERMINAL reading): any capped seed still > 1.0 ⇒ the causal direction is unidentified from n = 8 and the it.35 MARS verdict stands (READ V20_R15_IT35_MARS.md:27-34). Price: 9.65 s (3 × 1.884 + 4.0, DERIVED). Mechanism: M-6 (a partial run read as a verdict — the record read a mean no seed produced), D-6 (the repair written and never started), C17 (timed synchronised). Deliverable: results/v20_capped_seeds237.jsonl + docs/PLAN.md §P2 row. Evenings: 1. [cheapest-decisive 3 of 5]

M2.2 — Smoke-test the solve path: ChaCAL-diag at γ = 0.9 on BED-M. Phase 2. Prereq M0.1 (L-LEAN), M2.0. Independent-of M1.x, M2.1. Build: the arm with 𝒜 = ∅, γ fixed 0.9 (ChaCAL's own setting, fagnou-2024-chacal App. C [V]), diag_convention = kept, on e3_t2, N = 8, 150 steps; beside it the B-J and B-P5 plants: γ = 0.5 ⇒ max|O − PV| = 2.3003 (RUN[coord]), β = 0 at the softmax corner ⇒ > 0.5 (READ V16_ARM_SMPRIME.md:336-339), ChaCAL-published's A_s ⇒ O(1) at any γ > 0, a dense M with upper=False disagreeing with the dense inverse. Prove: nothing (P1 is M0.1's). Measure: the cell price against the band; torch.equal(O(0), PV); the plant residuals; determinism forward and backward over 8 repeats under strict mode. PASS: cell within [−1.8 %, +14.4 %] of 1.681 s or flagged as the P-8 floor if above 2.2×; torch.equal True; every plant fails at O(1); max|Δ| = 0.0 over 8 repeats forward and backward. KILL: torch.equal False at γ = 0; a plant that passes; a backward that raises under strict mode (then the solve route is not the first deterministic gated wing, V-23). No capability number is read: BED-M is contained (P2, D-2). Price: 17.4 s (8 × 1.681 + 4). Mechanism: V-24, V-3, M-8, P-8, V-16, D-2. Deliverable: results/shape_bed_m.jsonl (kind = chacal_diag) + the plant table in docs/PLAN.md §P2. Evenings: 1. [cheapest-decisive 4 of 5]

M2.3 — Give the solve increment and the determinism reading a live producer. Phase 2. Prereq M2.0. Independent-of M1.x, M2.1, M2.2. Build: the one code edit the judges owe (C-1, proposition_ledger.md): scripts/k_cert.py::determinism_at_64 gains a fourth quantity (solve_triangular forward/backward bitwise over 8 repeats, flag ON and OFF) and a solve_increment block (solve+Pz vs PV, fwd+bwd, median of 14 after 2 warm-ups, n ∈ {2048, 4096, 8192}, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 exported before process start). Measure: the four numbers above regenerated into results/k_cert_local.json. PASS: increment within ±12 % of 1.041 / 2.312 / 4.542 ms; solve bitwise both ways; cumsum still raises (the three-outcome table). KILL: an increment outside the band ⇒ every shape price in §0.2 is re-derived before any card past M3.1 runs; a "pass" on an operator that raised is V-16 and is refused. Price: ≈ 60 s [ASSUMED: the increment block alone] or 523.9 s [MEASURED] for the full k_cert rerun. Mechanism: P-1, V-16, M-8, M-3. Deliverable: results/k_cert_local.json (regenerated, git_head updated) + COSTS.md §1.6 row (author's edit). Evenings: 1.

M2.4 — Run the front-door binds on BED-S's real draw, each plant a FOUND cell. Phase 2. Prereq M1.4 (admitted bed), M2.0, M0.1. Independent-of M2.1, M2.3. Build: B-E1 (𝒜 = ∅ ⇒ torch.equal with ChaCAL-diag; 𝒜 ≠ ∅ ⇒ ‖Π_shape − Π_ChaCAL-diag‖_∞ = O(1) downstream, a weight gap), B-E2 (conservation q^{(0)} + Σq^{(k)} + q^{(sink)} = 1 to 1e-15; BOS dropped ⇒ raise), B-G1 (V ≡ 1 ⇒ max|Δz| ≤ 1e-15; Gaussian V ⇒ O(1), 0.1096 / 0.363 / 1.127 on three draws; Sherman–Morrison vs re-solve ≤ 1e-12; non-causal P ⇒ Δz[:i] ≠ 0, 0.0761 / 0.0868), B-G2 (permuted oracle ≠ 0; +0.1σ preferred; −Δz distinguished), B-H1 (committor vs bed_1.committor on real sets 0.0; wrong-set plant O(1); Kirchhoff < 1e-10 at K = 2), B-H2 (argmin identity V-3 declared; planted leak R² ≥ 0.99), B-K (segmentation zeros by torch.equal; −30 logit leaves the block non-zero), each through bed_s.build → arm.forward → journal row → verdict() with its own kind and manifest_hash (V-14). Measure: the residuals and the plant failures, counts printed. PASS: every honest half passes and every plant fails at O(1) — the 0.9749 / 0.9165 / 1.000 / 0.4845 pattern (READ workdonenewseal.md:114-122). KILL: any bind with an empty rejection region is struck (V-24); the B-I certificate bind stays dormant until a mask ships (D-4). Price: ≈ 20 s (nine plant cells at ≤ 1.681 s + 4.0, DERIVED; float64 identities on CPU are free). Mechanism: V-24, V-3, V-14, V-16, D-5, V-26, D-2. Deliverable: results/shape_bed_s.jsonl (kind ∈ {plant_*}) + docs/PLAN.md §P2 bind table. Evenings: 2.

docs.title: 4. Phase 3 — the arena on BED-S (t* = 8, m = 8, K = 2, N = 8, 4,769 params, 150 steps, one thread lane)
docs.text:
M3.1 — Run the ChaCAL control before the shape: ChaCAL-diag + softmax, N = 8. Phase 3. Prereq M1.4, M2.2, M2.4. Independent-of M2.1, M2.3, M3.6. Build: two invocations, the fellow approximator with 𝒜 = ∅ at the shape's γ initialisation rule and the depth-1 softmax with the same [m, K+2] head; synchronised, randomised order; every M0.2 field journalled. Measure: per seed φ-NRMSE, harmonic residual with its two unit factors, argmin accuracy + CP, γ̂, Λ; the paired sd of the contrast. PASS: eight FOUND records per arm; verdict() accepts (N = 8 distinct seeds). KILL: ChaCAL-diag's residual ratio against softmax ≥ 10 before the shape runs ⇒ "joint consistency" is ChaCAL's property, not the boundary rows', and Bet E is re-filed against ChaCAL-diag (V-3 in prospect). Price: 34 s. Mechanism: D-1, R-SKY, V-3, M-2 (order stated: control first), M-16. Deliverable: results/shape_bed_s.jsonl (kind ∈ {chacal_diag, softmax}). Evenings: 1.

M3.2 — Run the shape, N = 8: the pair that fixes the realised sd. Phase 3. Prereq M3.1. Independent-of M3.6. Build: the shape with the declared sets, γ learnable, both heads. Measure: everything in M3.1 plus ‖P̂ − P_env‖_∞, 1/(1 − γ̂), the field cosine, the sign column; the realised paired sd against softmax and against ChaCAL-diag fills the MDE row (0.039827 is the record's row-2 instance, not BED-S's). PASS: eight records; realised sd ≤ 0.034451 (then MDE₈ ≤ 0.039827) — otherwise the K-P reprice fires: sd 2.18× the pilot (M-3's precedent) ⇒ N is re-derived from the RUN table before any bet is scored. KILL (D-2 learnability): ‖P̂ − P_env‖_∞ < 1e-3 on ≥ 6/8 ⇒ the arm copied the environment; registered as a learnability reading, no capability number. Price: 17.4 s (softmax already banked) — 34 s if re-run as a pair. Mechanism: M-3, D-2, V-17, M-9. Deliverable: results/shape_bed_s.jsonl (kind = shape) + the MDE row in docs/PLAN.md §P3. Evenings: 1. [cheapest-decisive 5 of 5 is the LR-instrument spec M4.3; this card is the sixth]

M3.3 — Run the remaining fellows: ChaCAL-published, ChaCAL-with-sink, InfSA-K16, 1-hop softmax, majority/random/mean. Phase 3. Prereq M3.2. Independent-of M3.4–M3.6. Build: ChaCAL-published (diagonal removed in the inverse, sub-stochastic, [V-fetched] by one HTML read — re-read against the PDF first); ChaCAL-with-sink-token at the shape's trained γ̂ (order stated, M-2); InfSA-style Neumann K = 16 no boundaries (roffo-2026-infsa [V]) with δ · ‖V‖_∞ printed and ‖V‖_∞ journalled; the three free argmin controls. Measure: the creditable contrasts of M1.3. PASS: the K-E1 reading at N = 8 is reported as "separated / not separated at MDE₈", never as parity (M-13). KILL (K-E1, first tier): ChaCAL-with-sink within MDE₈ of the shape's committor read on ≥ 6/8 seeds and residual within 2× ⇒ escalate to M4.1; (K-H2): McNemar p > 0.05 shape vs 1-hop softmax on the argmin ⇒ BED-S struck. Price: 2 × 17.4 + 44.9 + 17.4 ≈ 97 s ≈ 1.6 min (the free controls 0). Mechanism: V-24, D-1, M-13, C8, L-CERT (the K = 16 δ in vector units), P-10. Deliverable: results/shape_bed_s.jsonl (five more kinds). Evenings: 1.

M3.4 — Run the depth-5 softmax skyline (Bet D). Phase 3. Prereq M3.2. Independent-of M3.3, M3.5, M3.6. Build: a ⌊log₂ 8⌋ + 2 = 5-layer softmax stack at unmatched parameters, depth chosen by analogy with sanford-2024-logdepth Thm 4.2 (the hop_k → committor reduction is NOT FOUND); width and CoT skylines (yehudai-2025-depthwidth, merrill-2024-cot) stay NOT MEASURED and the table says so. Measure: acc_shape − acc_sky against MDE₈ of the realised sd. PASS (prediction): within MDE₈ — the shape's claim is exactness, one-read consistency as a cost statement, and the boundary mechanism. KILL (counter): short by > MDE₈, sign logged (D-7 calibration column). Price: 64.8 s [ASSUMED linear in depth]; the first cell replaces the assumption. Mechanism: D-1, R-SKY, D-7, P-10. Deliverable: results/shape_bed_s.jsonl (kind = sky_depth5) + the calibration row. Evenings: 1.

M3.5 — Run the cached-mixture arm on ΔP and ΔV plants. Phase 3. Prereq M3.2. Independent-of M3.3, M3.4, M3.6. Build: O_cached = P̂_base (I − γ P̂_base)^{-1} V_int with P̂ frozen from the un-intervened context (momennejad-2017-sr, russek-2017-predictive, mechanism [U]); two draw batches, one where moves change P_env, one where only V changes. Measure: field cosine and residual per batch, paired by seed. PASS: fails on ΔP plants (cosine below the shape by > MDE₈(cos)) and passes on ΔV plants. KILL (K-G1): within one seed sd of the shape on ΔP plants on ≥ 6/8 ⇒ the interventional channel is a per-row control wearing a name (C5-type). Price: 2 × 17.4 ≈ 35 s. Mechanism: D-2, V-9, D-5. Deliverable: results/shape_bed_s.jsonl (kind ∈ {cached_dP, cached_dV}). Evenings: 1.

M3.6 — Run the first-ever BED-K cell: the native delay control. Phase 3. Prereq M2.0, M0.1. Independent-of every BED-S card. Build: hard_delay_attention (READ ceq/beds/bed_k.py:311-336, reproduces the delay to (n − 1)e^{−45}) beside the shape at γ > 0 on build_delay(n = 500, d = 4, seed = 7) (the pinned generator, sha 15de94b4…, READ COSTS.md §0); N = 8. Measure: NRMSE against the Hankel ceiling 1/d. PASS: the shape within MDE₈ of the native control — "not worse than one head at a fixed offset" (R-SKY). KILL: the shape claiming a delay advantage (V15Kernel.first_order_cannot_delay says a resolvent with γ > 0 has none); or the shape short by > MDE₈ ⇒ a capability gap the paper states. This is also the Q2/W1 admission condition (READ V20_R15_THEORY_TABLE.md:304-306: zero cells of BED-K's shape ever run). Price: 34 s. Mechanism: R-SKY, V-3, D-3 (the d dial), F4→NOT-PUT lifted. Deliverable: results/shape_bed_k.jsonl. Evenings: 1.

M3.7 — Vary the dials: the one-factor-at-a-time sweep. Phase 3. Prereq M3.2 admitted and not killed. Independent-of M3.3–M3.6. Build: seven design points — centre (8, 2, 8) plus t* ∈ {2, 32}, K ∈ {3, 4}, m ∈ {4, 16} — each a shape + softmax pair with the census re-run per point (t* placed by the DAG's depth, read off the hop ladder, never a kill rate). Measure: the M3.2 statistics per point; the exact zero-information floor per m (0.75 / 0.875 / 0.9375). PASS: every point admitted by its census and the argmin error moves with t* (D-3: a dial that does not vary describes nothing). KILL: a point that cannot be placed (t* = 32 unreachable inside the causal window) is recorded, not forced; error flat across t* ⇒ the dial is decoration and only the centre is reported. Price: 3.46 min at 29.6 s per pair (3.97 min at 34 s). Mechanism: D-3, P-8, V-25, V-10. Deliverable: results/shape_bed_s_dials.jsonl + the t*/K/m table. Evenings: 2.

M3.8 — Open the vector-label lane on BED-M (return z, not z[:, s−1]). Phase 3. Prereq M2.2. Independent-of every BED-S card. Build: a separate lane and journal (a vector label voids PUBLISHED_SOFTMAX_8192, READ MISTAKES.md:701-708); the vector_readout plumbing (READ scale/m3_quintuple.py:368,483); label z* ∈ ℝ^{s} from equilibrium_oracle with the last-coordinate discard removed; shape vs softmax with the vector readout, N = 8, e3_t8. Measure: position-matched NRMSE vector, harmonic residual with P_env = the chain; B-G2's three plants. PASS: a journalled vector, histogram and quantiles (the Q6 census read 0 of 40, READ V20_R15_THEORY_TABLE.md:213). KILL: the permuted oracle scoring 0 on the chosen metric ⇒ metric struck (V-26); shape − corner-3 on this lane is VOID by registration (P2, D-2). Price: 34 s. Mechanism: D-1, M-1, V-26, D-2. Deliverable: results/shape_bed_m_vector.jsonl. Evenings: 1.

docs.title: 5. Phase 4 — verdicts (journal reads; two priced runs)
docs.text:
M4.1 — Score the E1 kill at MDE₈; escalate to N = 16 if unseparated. Phase 4. Prereq M3.3. Independent-of M4.2, M4.3. Build: the K-E1 rule frozen in bind_ledger.md §5: fires at within-MDE₈ on ≥ 6/8 and residual within 2×; unseparated-and-unfired ⇒ eight more seeds for shape, ChaCAL-with-sink and ChaCAL-diag. Measure: the contrast at N = 16 against MDE₁₆ of the realised sd (0.025820 at sd 0.034451). PASS: separated at N = 16 by > MDE₁₆. KILL: K-E1 fires ⇒ component (e) is a parameterisation of ChaCAL's sink; the paper's delta collapses to "ChaCAL + certificate + Lean containment + bed" (the median sentence of design_falsify.md §6.2) and every later card runs under that sentence. Price: 44 s (3 × 8 × 1.681 + 4). Mechanism: M-13, M-7, D-7, M-9. Deliverable: docs/PLAN.md §P4 verdict row + calibration column entry. Evenings: 1.

M4.2 — Score Bets A, B, E from the journal (residual ratio, cosine, argmin floor). Phase 4. Prereq M3.2, M3.3. Independent-of M4.1, M4.3. Build: nothing new; the three deciding numbers — cos_shape − cos_softmax vs MDE₈(cos) (its own realised sd, V-17); CP_upper(err_shape) vs floor_exact(k = 1) with CP_lower < floor ≤ CP_upper as SPLIT; r_softmax / r_shape with ≥ 10 confirm, ≤ 2 refute, (2, 10) SPLIT, both unit factors printed. PASS/KILL: as filed in bind_ledger.md §6 (frozen before M3.1). Price: 0. Mechanism: D-7, L-SIGN, V-26, V-17, M-2. Deliverable: docs/PLAN.md §P4 calibration column (checked / wrong / sign) — the record's own is 7 of 8 optimistic (READ V16_CALIBRATION.md:96-100). Evenings: 1.

M4.3 — Write the γ-pinning LR instrument and read the verdict. Phase 4 (the spec is a first-evening item). Prereq none for the spec; M3.2 for the verdict. Independent-of M4.1, M4.2. Build: docs/LR_GAMMA.md — Λ = 2[LL(γ̂) − LL(γ ≡ 0)] on a declared held-out set (n_eval = 4096), null ½χ²₀ + ½χ²₁ (95 % point 2.706, not 3.841; Ruling 10′ was stated for β, READ V17K_RULINGS.md:389-436), PINNED Λ ≤ 2.706, MOVED Λ > 8.318, interval verdict between; the seed-count rule "MOVED on ≥ 6/8", SPLIT 3/8–5/8; 1/(1 − γ̂) printed beside every δ; the ablation (I − γ̂P̂)^{-1} → I at trained weights; the |γ̂| < 0.05 rule deleted (two verdicts for one cell, M-20). Measure: Λ per seed from M3.2. PASS (Bet C): MOVED on ≥ 6/8. KILL: PINNED on ≥ 6/8 ⇒ softmax wearing a name on this bed; the equilibrium sentence is withdrawn; ChaCAL-with-sink at γ̂ = 0 is unrunnable and M4.1 is void (dependency stated in design_falsify.md §5). Mirror kill: γ̂ > 0.99 on ≥ 6/8 ⇒ the certificate is vacuous on the z/Δz channel. Price: 0 (journal read); the ablation ≤ 17.4 s. Mechanism: V-9, M-2, V-17, M-20, C5. Deliverable: docs/LR_GAMMA.md + the verdict row. Evenings: 1. [cheapest-decisive 5 of 5 — the spec half]

M4.4 — Schedule TOST on the 𝒜 = ∅ parity half — not waived. Phase 4. Prereq M3.2, M4.3 (MOVED, else the half is softmax vs softmax). Independent-of M4.1, M4.2. Build: shape at γ̂ with 𝒜 = ∅ vs ChaCAL-diag at the same γ̂, margin 0.5σ fixed here (M-2), α = 0.05 per side (schuirmann-1987-tost [V]); the realised sd_d from M3.1/M3.2 chooses the tier: paired N = 36 if sd_d ≈ σ (power 0.8014, RUN), two-sample N = 70 if pairing buys nothing (power 0.8049, RUN); the sequential (anytime-valid) form is NOT FOUND at [V] (sweep_methods.md S8) and fixed-N stands. Measure: the 90 % CI of the contrast against ±0.5σ. PASS: CI inside the margin ⇒ the identity half of B-E1 is confirmed by equivalence, not only by bitwise identity. KILL: CI outside ⇒ the "same operator" sentence is withdrawn and diag_convention is inspected first. Price: 119 s (paired N = 36) or 228 s (two-sample N = 70); both under 4 GPU-min; M-13's N = 70 is affordable and is on the schedule. Mechanism: M-13, M-9, M-2, V-3. Deliverable: results/shape_tost.jsonl + docs/PLAN.md §P4 TOST row. Evenings: 1.

M4.5 — File the leap dossier and the two honest sentences. Phase 4. Prereq M4.1–M4.4. Build: the R15 template's Phase-E items with the beds replaced (READ CEQ_V20_R15_CONTRACT.md:153-169): candidate built with identity binds, manifests, certificates, param-matched, verdict by the registered clauses, purge, prognosis; both sentences of design_falsify.md §6 with every bracket filled from journals or left NOT MEASURED. PASS: every number in the dossier points at a results/ row. KILL: a bracket filled from prose (P-1, P-2). Price: 0. Mechanism: P-1, P-3, D-7, L-G2 (journals never move; a superseded cell gets a marker). Deliverable: docs/CEQ_SHAPE_DOSSIER.md. Evenings: 1.

docs.title: 6. Phase 5 — the cost law and the memory ceiling (the s-sweep is the precondition for any cost law)
5.0 The residency model that sets n per s (DERIVED; [ASSUMED] band on C_OPERATOR)
docs.text:
Bytes ≈ 1.256 × [C_OP · n·s²·4 + 2·n·s·d·4 + 17.874·n·s·d·4], with 1.256 the worst reserved/allocated ratio over resident shapes (READ COSTS.md §3.2), C_RESIDUAL = 17.874 (R² 0.996373, READ COSTS.md:89), C_OP ∈ [3.823, 5.823] — the signed arm's 3.823 (R² 0.996373, :90) plus 1…2 retained tensors for M and M̄ (sec_cost.md §4.x.7, [ASSUMED]; M2.3's memory census replaces it), budget 0.90 × 7.996 = 7.20 GiB. Largest power-of-two n that fits (RUN, the one-liner of §0.3):

s n at C_OP = 3.823 n at C_OP = 5.823 (carried) check 64 32768 (5.52 GiB) 32768 (6.78 GiB) softmax measured resident at 32768, 4.908 GiB (READ COSTS.md:112) 256 4096 (6.36) 2048 (4.44) — 1024 256 (5.19) 128 (3.85) — 4096 16 (4.90) 8 (3.71) dense at n = 2048: 137 GB — refused (sec_apparatus.md §A.6)

So the sweep runs at (s, n) ∈ {(64, 2048), (256, 2048), (1024, 128), (4096, 8)}; any n above the carried column is attempted only after M2.3's measured C_OP licenses it. The corner-3 base (complex64, 8 B/elem) halves every n and is not swept.

M5.1 — Run the synchronised, randomised s-sweep. Phase 5. Prereq M2.3 (the producer), M2.0. Independent-of every Phase 3–4 card (it can run first; it must run before any cost law is quoted — K-9). Build: the harness edits the record priced and never made: a --seq-len flag (S, D = 64, 24 is a module constant at READ scripts/v15_r1.py:137; seq_len does not occur — RUN[MERCURY] grep in sec_state.md S.5), one substitution, two torch.cuda.synchronize() calls, and a randomised cell order (the fifth edit, never priced); shape and softmax at the four (s, n) points above, N = 8, 150 steps, torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved journalled per cell. Prove: nothing. Measure: s/step and peak reserved per (arm, s, n); the run-order correlation ρ(secs, order) recomputed. PASS: ρ(secs, order) with p > 0.05 (the confound removed; C17's +0.7029 was the disease); the increment's exponent in s fitted with a CI. KILL (K-9): the fitted exponent's CI excludes 2 toward 3; or the solve does not beat QKᵀ at the s where the paper claims it; or any price quoted before this card runs. Price: 206–537 GPU-s band (READ V20_R15_THEORY_TABLE.md:104-109), no point; the randomised order adds no GPU time. Mechanism: D-3, P-8, C17, M-3, K-9. Deliverable: results/shape_s_sweep.jsonl + docs/COST_LAW.md §sweep. Evenings: 3.

M5.2 — Refit the cost law with s as a variable and re-price every card. Phase 5. Prereq M5.1. Independent-of M5.3. Build: s/step = a · n^b · s^c per arm with R² and the CI on c; the increment law Δ(s, n); the memory law C_OP re-solved against the allocator (the 3.823 is retired from [ASSUMED]). Measure: R² per law; the [ASSUMED] tags of §0.2 and §5.0 that the fit closes. PASS: every shape price in docs/PRICE_LEDGER.md carries a fitted law with R² ≥ 0.99 and no [ASSUMED] remains on a Phase 3–4 card. KILL: R² < 0.99 at any s ⇒ that s is quoted as a measured point, never as a law (the record's own R² gate refused paged points, READ COSTS.md:76-79). Price: 0. Mechanism: M-8, P-8, V-22, P-1. Deliverable: docs/COST_LAW.md + docs/PRICE_LEDGER.md (revised, superseding rows kept with a marker, L-G2). Evenings: 1.

M5.3 — Spend the 9,600-step ladder on a survivor only. Phase 5. Prereq M4.1–M4.4 with the shape alive on at least one creditable contrast. Independent-of M5.1, M5.2. Build: the R1′ ladder (×64 steps) for the surviving pair. Measure: the same statistics at the ladder's end; the crossing and residual curves. PASS: the N = 8 verdict survives the ladder within its own MDE₈. KILL: a verdict that reverses at the ladder is filed as the ladder's, and the 150-step cell is marked a pilot (M-3). Price: 32–36 min per pair. Mechanism: M-3, M-6, P-8. Deliverable: results/shape_ladder.jsonl. Evenings: 1.

M5.4 — Price the chunked and Neumann paths past s = 64 (optional; NOT MEASURED). Phase 5. Prereq M5.1. Independent-of all. Build: a chunk-size sweep of the intra-chunk primitive (yang-2024-deltanet Eq. 10 pattern [V]; no d × d inter-chunk state exists for softmax P, hu-2025-ssdtheory [V]); the Neumann K-hop route at s ∈ {1024, 4096} with δ · ‖V‖_∞ printed. PASS/KILL: the MAC law of sec_cost.md §4.x.9 reproduced in wall-clock within the dispatch gap; a chunked kernel that is not faster than solve_triangular at any s is reported as such (V-9). Price: NOT MEASURED — needs a chunked kernel; the Neumann route ≈ K × a solve cell. Mechanism: M-8, P-4, V-9. Deliverable: docs/COST_LAW.md §kernel. Evenings: 4 (spec 1 + kernel 3, the author's code).

docs.title: 7. Phase 6 — deferred instruments and the Kaggle gate
docs.text:
M6.1 — The Kaggle gate: certify the card before any cell, after the author's yes. Phase 6. Prereq the author's explicit yes (a node, not a formality); Gate 0 (READ V17K_RULINGS.md:3-22, open rulings = 0, with G0.10's circularity — rows 1–2 blocked on numbers only the Kaggle run produces — resolved by the author). Independent-of every local card (nothing local depends on it). Build: python scripts/k_cert.py --out results/k_cert_kaggle.json unchanged on the card (P100-16GB or 2×T4-16GB, recorded which), then scripts/k_cost.py --cert results/k_cert_kaggle.json; the M2.3 fourth quantity and solve increment included. Measure: the fifteen empty rows of READ COSTS.md §2. PASS: the local laws describe the Kaggle card within the tolerance stated by the author before reading it (the reproduction rule, READ COSTS.md §2). KILL: any threshold carried across the device boundary (V-22); any launch, upload or training start without the yes (memory rule). Price: ≈ 8.7 GPU-min on Kaggle [ASSUMED = the local 523.9 s, READ COSTS.md:62]; against the 12 h session / 30 GPU-h week limits (READ COSTS.md §3, [INHERITED]). Mechanism: V-22, P-8, the Kaggle-yes rule, G0.10. Deliverable: results/k_cert_kaggle.json; COSTS.md §2 filled (author's edit); docs/KAGGLE_GATE.md. Evenings: 1 + the yes.

M6.2 — The LM γ cell (component (j)) on the pinned enwik8 slice. Phase 6. Prereq M6.1, M4.3 (MOVED on BED-S, else the bet is retired first). Independent-of the topology cards. Build: the shape in ceq/hf/ (READ MODEL_CARD.md:73-79: no checkpoint ships; params 25,736,232 vs 25,728,000, +0.032 %, matched by Ruling 3) vs ChaCAL at fixed γ = 0.9, N = 8, on the 90/5/5 split (READ kaggle/README.md:31-43, sha 2b49720e…); the three unpinned sources (lichess_*, tinystories_cdla) make the hash cell raise kdata.MissingPin and are not used. Measure: Λ per seed with the boundary null; perplexity delta against ChaCAL within MDE₈. PASS: MOVED on ≥ 6/8. KILL: PINNED on ≥ 6/8 (consistent with ChaCAL's own LM result being worse than its baseline, 21.46 vs 20.15, digits [U]) ⇒ the LM γ claim is retired and γ stays a bed-side dial. Price: NOT MEASURED — no LM cell of the shape has run; the Q3 chunk shape reads 0.299 s/step for the control (READ COSTS.md §3.2, [MEASURED]), so eight 11 h chunks would be the ceiling and the author sets the step count. Mechanism: V-9, C5, V-22, M-13. Deliverable: results/shape_lm_kaggle.jsonl. Evenings: the author's Kaggle sessions; not on the local critical path.

M6.3 — Specify the two topological instruments that do not exist. Phase 6. Prereq none. Independent-of all. Build: T-1 a digraph β₀ instrument (connectivity notion, dissimilarity transform, Turner predicate as a checkable hypothesis on the filtered object, turner-2019-quasimetric-rips [V]; beta0_interleaving consumes point clouds, READ ceq/certs/topological.py:476-505); T-2 a Mapper-cover-to-tile quantiser with parameters fixed by the Reeb-estimator rule on a held-out relation (carriere-2018-mapper-statistics [V]), the do-nothing 0D-salience schedule (sharma-2026-kernels-22 [V]) and zhao-2026-structuredsparse [V] as the two controls, the F1 union certificate carrying 1/(1 − γ), n declared per s from §5.0. PASS: each spec names its null (row-permuted influence at the same logit scale for T-1; equal visited tiles for T-2) and its refusal (non-integer β₀; a mask without a certificate). KILL: the barcode inside the null's 95 % band on ≥ 6/8 ⇒ decoration; Mapper within MDE₈ of do-nothing ⇒ the exact dividend is segmentation's. Price: NOT MEASURED (kernels#22 has no backward, READ THEORY.md:223-224). Mechanism: M-15, M-2, V-16, V-9, L-CERT, P-4. Deliverable: docs/TOPO_INSTRUMENTS.md. Evenings: 2.

docs.title: 8.2 The order (cheapest decisive first; D-1 dependency law; the critical path)
docs.text:
First evening (THESIS_CORRECTIONS_2.md §0's five, marked above): M0.1 (Lean, 0), M1.2 via M1.1 (census, 0), M2.1 (the ~6 GPU-s capped run, 9.65 s), M2.2 (ChaCAL-diag smoke test on BED-M, 17.4 s), M4.3-spec (the LR instrument, 0). Each settles something alone and none blocks another.

Then, in DAG order with the four sequencing rules the coordinator set: (i) the BED-S zero-hop control (M1.4) before any arm trains on BED-S; (ii) the ChaCAL control (M3.1) before the shape (M3.2); (iii) M2.4's binds before M3.1 (V-14: plants through the front door first); (iv) TOST (M4.4) scheduled, not waived, at the tier the realised sd_d picks. Independent branches the author may take in any order: {M0.2, M0.3, M0.4}, {M2.1}, {M2.3, M5.1, M5.2} (the cost-law branch; it gates only prices, never verdicts), {M3.6, M3.8} (the other beds), {M6.3}, and every Phase-3 fellow after M3.2.

Critical path in evenings (serial depth of this file's own cards): M1.1 (2) → M1.2 (1) → M1.4 (1) → M2.4 (2) → M3.1 (1) → M3.2 (1) → M3.3 (1) → M4.1 (1) → M4.4 (1) → M5.3 (1) = 12 evenings to the ladder on a survivor; M2.0 (3) and M0.1 (1) run beside M1.x and do not lengthen it; the cost-law branch adds 3 (M5.1) + 1 (M5.2) if a cost law is demanded before the ladder — 15. The iteration count of any loop is this depth, never an agent's choice (D-3 of CONTRACT.md).

docs.title: 9. Limits (collected once)
docs.text: Every price is a floor from a per-op microbenchmark under a 2.0×–6.6× dispatch gap on a laptop clock that drifts ±12 %; the solve increment exists at s = 64 only, so every card past s = 64 is priced by a [DERIVED] residency model with an [ASSUMED] C_OPERATOR band until M2.3 and M5.1 replace it; the record's ≈ 34 s pair double-counts the fixed cost and this file carries it anyway as the conservative figure; the depth-5 skyline price is [ASSUMED] linear in depth; the InfSA cell is a K = 16 microbenchmark floor; the s-sweep has a band and no point; the ladder is ×64 of a fitted law. The MDE and TOST figures are RUN re-derivations that agree with VENUS and MARS to the printed digits, but BED-S's realised sd and sd_d do not exist and every seed count past N = 8 is conditional on them. The boundary-null 2.706 has no references.bib citation and is marked owed. Cards M2.0, M2.3, M5.1, M5.4 and M6.2 need code the author writes; this file specifies and does not write it. Nothing here was run on the GPU; the four one-liners computed and printed only; no git write, no Kaggle contact.

docs.title: PLAN — NEPTUNE (LINUS): the systems roadmap, as milestone cards
docs.text: NEPTUNE, 2026-09-03, HEAD 207e7b9, branch v17k-gate0. The judged sections (judge/sec_shape.md §4.5, judge/sec_apparatus.md §A.9–A.11, judge/bind_ledger.md) outrank every design and note where they differ; this file is the systems slice of the programme (THESIS_CORRECTIONS_2.md §0): the author develops it alone, slowly, on the certified RTX 4060 Laptop (7.996 GiB, torch 2.5.1+cu121, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8, READ COSTS.md:53-63), in any order the DAG allows. Evidence classes: RUN (a number executed on this box in the cost session, carried from sections/sec_cost.md with its section), RUN[this] (arithmetic re-executed this session with a Python one-liner), READ path:line, CITED [V] by canonical references.bib key, DERIVED with steps, [FITTED]/[ASSUMED] per COSTS.md:16-20. No card launches anything on Kaggle; the author's explicit yes is a node (READ kaggle/README.md:9-11; memory rule Kaggle launch requires yes). No card writes code here; every "what to build" is a specification a developer implements, and the one code edit the ledger names as owed (C-1) is card N-01.

docs.title: 0. The shape of this slice
docs.text:
The object priced is O = (1 − γ) P (I − γP)^{-1} V on a causal row-stochastic softmax P with identity rows on the declared sets, solved by one forward substitution (judge/sec_shape.md Prop. 5). Four facts fix the whole roadmap, each with its provenance:

  1. The exact path is cheaper than one Neumann hop at the shipped geometry. solve + Pz fwd+bwd 2.514 ms vs PV 1.473 ms vs one hop 3.001 ms at n = 2048, s = 64, d = 16, float32 (RUN, sec_cost.md §4.x.3, median of 14 after 2 warm-ups, synchronize-bracketed). Truncation never wins in MACs (K·s²d/2 < s²d/2 needs K < 1, DERIVED §4.x.3). The Neumann route survives as a certificate instrument, not as a cost path.
  2. No finite-state dual exists for softmax P (hu-2025-ssdtheory [V], rank T for rank-1 logits), so the chunked-WY inter-chunk state of yang-2024-deltanet [V] Eq. 10 is closed; the chunked path re-shapes the same s²d/2 MACs into s/C GEMMs (depth s/C, memory O(sC)), it does not reduce them (DERIVED §4.x.2). The subquadratic path is occupied: zhao-2026-structuredsparse [V], Õ(n^{4/3} d), exact on tiles, approximate across blocks.
  3. The shape inherits the O(S²) memory class unless the backward recomputes tiles (READ ceq/sizing.py:9-22: 3.9 tensors of [B,H,S,S] per layer; ratio 1.44× at seq 128 to 8.06× at seq 2048). solve_triangular has no bf16 CUDA path in torch 2.5.1 ([U], card N-19 verifies), so the solve's [S,S] operand stays at 4.0 B/elem where the softmax's autocast term reads 3.341 (READ COSTS.md:91).
  4. solve_triangular ran bitwise forward and backward under strict mode with no torch-documented guarantee (RUN §4.x.6), which makes the softmax-corner shape the first gated wing whose training step can run under use_deterministic_algorithms(True); cumprod's backward raises (READ COSTS.md:149-154). That line is not yet in any device certificate (P-1) — card N-01.

Phases: Ph0 certificate lines and must-fire batteries (0 GPU-s to seconds); Ph1 the exact path as the shipped route, priced end to end; Ph2 the cost law in s (the C9 harness debt); Ph3 chunked, blockwise, CSR and Mapper; Ph4 memory and sizing; Ph5 envelope, HF package, Kaggle gate. Every card names the MISTAKES.md mechanism it is built against. The five cheapest decisive cards are marked ★.
